name: Frontend
title: Frontend
description: The layer people directly see, click, and type into · On a sign-up page, the fields, submit button, and pending, success, or error messages belong to the frontend; whether the account was actually created must come from the backend result.
zhDescription: 用户在网页、小程序和软件里直接看到、点击和输入的那一层 · 例如，在注册页，输入框、提交按钮和“正在提交 / 注册成功 / 出错了”的提示属于前端；账号是否真正创建成功，要由后端处理后返回结果。
quote: People keep talking about the frontend and backend. What's the difference?
zhQuote: 老听人说前端、后端，这两个到底有什么区别？

name: Component
title: Component
description: A component is a unit that groups a reusable piece of interface with the behavior it owns. · For example, a product card can be shared by the home page, search results, and saved items when all show an image, price, and purchase action. An input field can also be a component. Components divide interface responsibility; not every tiny label needs to become one. Know first HTML
zhDescription: 组件是把一块可复用的界面和它负责的行为组织在一起的单元。 · 例如商品卡在首页、搜索结果和收藏页都显示图片、价格和购买按钮时，可以共用同一个组件；表单输入框也能作为组件复用。它划分的是界面责任，不等于页面里每一个小标签都必须单独成为组件。 先知道 HTML
quote: Turn this repeated product area into a component so one change updates every instance.
zhQuote: 把这个重复出现的商品区做成组件，改一个地方就能同步更新。

name: State
title: State
description: State is information the interface needs to remember right now and that can change from actions or results. · A form submitting, a modal being open, a cart count, and the active filter are all state. A component shows different output from those values. State is not the component itself, and not every long-lived record belongs only in page state. Know first Component
zhDescription: 状态是界面在当前时刻需要记住、并会随操作或结果变化的信息。 · 例如表单正在提交、弹窗是否打开、购物车数量和当前筛选条件都是状态；同一个组件会根据这些值显示不同画面。它不是组件本身，也不是所有长期数据都应只放在页面状态里。 先知道 组件 Component
quote: After the submit button is clicked, show Saving, then update the message on success or failure.
zhQuote: 提交按钮点下去先显示保存中，成功或失败后再更新提示。

name: Markdown
title: Markdown
description: Write structured text with lightweight punctuation · Markdown uses simple characters for headings, lists, links, code, and emphasis. It is convenient for documentation and content stored as plain text. Different renderers support different extensions, so preview the actual output and treat embedded HTML carefully.
zhDescription: Markdown 是用少量排版符号表示标题、列表和代码的结构化纯文本格式 · 例如，# 表示标题、- 表示列表、三个反引号可围住代码块。它适合 README、需求文档、知识库和笔记；需要精确布局、品牌视觉或复杂交互时，通常还要使用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript。
quote: The document AI wrote is full of # signs and asterisks. What is that, and can it turn into nicely formatted text?
zhQuote: AI 写的文档里全是 # 和星号，这是什么？能变成好看的排版吗？

name: HTML
title: HTML
description: Describe the structure and meaning of a web page · HTML organizes a page into headings, paragraphs, links, forms, images, and other meaningful elements. CSS controls appearance and JavaScript adds behavior. Choosing the right element improves accessibility, keyboard behavior, search, and maintenance.
zhDescription: HTML 是用标签描述网页内容结构、供浏览器渲染页面的标记语言 · 它用标签标出标题、段落、图片、链接和按钮。例如，产品页面的内容层级由 HTML 组织；视觉样式通常交给 CSS，复杂交互需要 JavaScript。
quote: The code AI wrote has a bunch of angle brackets and English words. What are those for?
zhQuote: AI 写出来的代码里一堆 < > 和英文单词，这些东西是干嘛的？

name: CSS
title: CSS
description: CSS is a style language that describes a web page's appearance, layout, and changes across available space. · For example, HTML may already contain a button while the button is still gray or overflows on a phone. The browser matches CSS rules and calculates a final style from their priority and order. CSS controls presentation; it does not implement the business logic that runs after a click. Know first HTML
zhDescription: CSS 是用规则描述网页外观、布局和不同空间下变化方式的样式语言。 · 例如 HTML 已经有按钮，但按钮仍是灰色或在手机上挤出页面时，浏览器会根据 CSS 选择器匹配规则，并按优先级和书写顺序算出最终样式。CSS 负责呈现，不负责按钮点击后的业务逻辑。 先知道 HTML
quote: The button works, but its color stays gray. Help me find which style is overriding the theme color.
zhQuote: 按钮能点但颜色一直是灰色，帮我找出是哪条样式把主题色覆盖了。

name: DOM
title: DOM
description: The DOM is the node tree the browser uses to represent and modify a web document. · For example, the source HTML may contain one task while a click adds another to the page. A script created a node and inserted it into the runtime DOM. That change affects the current page, but whether it survives a refresh depends on separate persistence in a backend or browser storage. Know first HTML JavaScript
zhDescription: DOM 是浏览器把网页文档表示成可读取和修改的节点树。 · 例如源 HTML 里只有一个任务，点击“新增”后页面却多出一项，这是脚本创建节点并把它插入运行时 DOM 的结果。DOM 的变化会立即影响当前页面，但刷新后是否还在，取决于有没有另外保存到后端或浏览器存储。 先知道 HTML JavaScript
quote: A task appears after I click Add, but it is not in the source HTML. Help me confirm what was inserted at runtime.
zhQuote: 点击新增后页面确实多了一条任务，但源 HTML 里找不到它，帮我确认运行时到底插入了什么。

name: Title Tag
title: Title Tag
description: The HTML title that identifies the current document · The browser uses it in a tab or window title, and a search system may use it when generating a result title. It should distinguish the current page, but the page H1 and a search result title are not the same field. Know first HTML
zhDescription: HTML 文档用来标识当前页面的标题 · 浏览器会把它显示在标签页和窗口标题中，搜索系统也可能参考它生成结果标题。它应准确区分当前页面，但不能把页面里的 H1 或搜索结果文案当成同一个字段。 先知道 HTML
quote: Give every product detail page a tab title containing its product name, while keeping the H1 in the page.
zhQuote: 每个商品详情页的浏览器标签都显示对应商品名，同时保留页面里的 H1。

name: Page Metadata
title: Page Metadata
description: Information about a page that is read outside its visible body · Page metadata lives in the document head and is read separately by browsers, search systems, sharing platforms, or install surfaces. It is not one completion switch; inspect the relevant field and rendered result for each consumer. Know first HTML Title Tag
zhDescription: 描述网页但不直接显示在正文中的页面信息 · 页面元数据放在文档 head 中，供浏览器、搜索系统、分享平台或安装入口分别读取。它不是一个“完成”开关，必须按消费方检查对应字段和实际呈现。 先知道 HTML 页面标题 Title Tag
quote: Check what this page shows in the tab, search snippet, shared link, and install entry separately.
zhQuote: 请分别检查这个页面在标签页、搜索摘要、链接分享和安装入口里显示了什么。

name: Favicon
title: Favicon
description: A small icon browsers use to identify a website · After a site opens, the browser can show it in tabs, bookmarks, and history so people can recognize the site among many pages. A working header Logo does not prove that the browser received a Favicon; inspect the actual browser surfaces. Know first HTML Image
zhDescription: 浏览器用来识别网站的小图标 · 打开网站后，浏览器会把它显示在标签页、书签和历史记录等位置，帮助用户在一串页面中认出站点。页头里的 Logo 正常，不代表浏览器已经读到了 Favicon；应直接检查这些浏览器界面位置。 先知道 HTML 图片 Image
quote: Replace the small site icon in tabs and bookmarks with our brand shape, but do not change the header Logo.
zhQuote: 把网站在标签页和书签里的小图标换成我们的品牌图形，但不要改页头 Logo。

name: Open Graph
title: Open Graph
description: og:* metadata that describes a shared-link preview · When an article link is sent through a chat or social platform, the platform can read og:title, og:description, og:image, and og:url to build a preview card. A page image working in the browser does not prove that the external platform received the share image, and platforms may cache an old result. Know first Page Metadata URL Image
zhDescription: 用 og:* 元数据描述链接分享预览的内容 · 当文章链接被发到聊天或社交平台时，平台可以读取 og:title、og:description、og:image、og:url 等字段生成预览卡。网页正文图片正确，不代表外部平台也拿到了分享图；平台还可能缓存旧结果。 先知道 页面元数据 Page Metadata URL 图片 Image
quote: Give the article share card the right title, description, absolute image URL, and canonical URL, then check it with a real share preview.
zhQuote: 文章页的分享卡要有正确标题、摘要、绝对图片地址和规范 URL，改完请用真实分享预览检查。

name: Web App Manifest
title: Web App Manifest
description: A JSON file that describes a Web app's name, icons, and launch behavior · A page links to this JSON file with a manifest link, and a browser can use its name, icons, start_url, and display to create an install entry and launch window. Having a Manifest does not by itself provide complete offline PWA behavior. Know first JSON HTML Deployment
zhDescription: 描述 Web 应用名称、图标和启动方式的 JSON 文件 · 网页通过 manifest link 关联这个 JSON 文件，浏览器可以用其中的 name、icons、start_url 和 display 等信息生成安装入口和启动窗口。有 Manifest 不等于已经具备完整的离线 PWA 能力。 先知道 JSON HTML 部署上线 Deployment
quote: Check the Web App Manifest name, icons, start_url, and display, then reinstall and verify the launch result.
zhQuote: 检查 Web App Manifest 的名称、图标、start_url 和 display，重新安装后验证启动结果。

name: Undo
title: Undo
description: Undo rolls your last action back exactly as it was—Ctrl+Z brings the wrongly deleted row back, no retyping. · Press Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on Mac) to step backward, and redo to step forward again if you go too far. It has limits: usually only the last several steps, and the history is gone after refresh or close—important deletions still deserve a confirmation rather than relying on undo. Know first CRUD
zhDescription: 撤销是把刚做的一步操作原样退回去——删错的东西按 Ctrl+Z 就回来，不用重做。 · 例如在表格里删错了一行，按 Ctrl+Z（Mac 上是 Cmd+Z），刚才消失的那行原样回来。撤销恢复的是「你动手之前的状态」，所以比重新手打快得多，也不会引入新错误。它有边界：通常只能退回最近几步，刷新或关掉页面后历史就没了——真正要紧的删除还是应该有确认。 先知道 增删改查 CRUD
quote: This change is wrong—undo it and put things back the way they were before I touched them.
zhQuote: 这个改动不对，把这一步撤销掉，回到我动手之前的样子。

name: Accessibility
title: Accessibility
description: Accessibility means more people can use your page in more situations—not only with a mouse, not only with perfect vision, and even read aloud by a screen reader. · You test with a mouse and good eyes, but visitors may use a keyboard, a screen reader, or squint at a phone in sunlight. Accessibility extends "works for me" to those situations: text alternatives on images, buttons reachable by Tab, sufficient text contrast. When an AI reply mentions a11y, it is the shorthand for this word (a plus 11 letters plus y). Know first Contrast Focus
zhDescription: 无障碍是让更多人在更多场景下都能用你的页面——不光靠鼠标、不光靠好视力、屏幕读出来也能懂。 · 你测试页面用的是鼠标和好眼睛，但访客可能在用键盘、屏幕阅读器，或在阳光下眯着眼看手机。无障碍就是把「我这里能用」扩展到这些场景。AI 回复里出现 a11y 就是这个词的缩写（a 加 11 个字母加 y）。 先知道 对比度 Contrast 聚焦 Focus
quote: I heard some people browse without a mouse, using a screen reader—check whether they can use this page properly.
zhQuote: 帮我检查一下页面的无障碍：图片有没有文字说明、所有按钮能不能用 Tab 键点到、对比度够不够。

name: Semantic HTML
zhName: 语义化标签与标题层级
title: Semantic HTML
zhTitle: 语义化标签与标题层级
description: HTML tags that mark each section's role in the document, such as headings, lists, and navigation · When structuring a web page, semantic HTML tags mark content roles, such as headings for sections, nav for navigation, and ul for lists. Screen readers can navigate by headings; font size is visual styling, not structure. HTML allows multiple H1 elements on a page. Heading levels should reflect the content hierarchy so the outline is easy to follow. Know first HTML
zhDescription: 用有含义的 HTML 标签标明这段内容在文档里的角色，例如标题、列表、导航 · 制作网页时，具有明确含义的 HTML 标签负责标明内容在文档中的结构角色，例如用标题标签组织章节、nav 表示导航、ul 表示列表。屏幕阅读器可以按标题浏览页面；字号只是外观，不会代替结构。HTML 允许一个页面有多个 H1；标题级别应反映内容从属关系，层级清楚会更容易浏览。 先知道 HTML
quote: The SEO check says my page is missing an H1. What does that mean?
zhQuote: SEO 检查说我页面缺少 H1，什么意思？

name: Mini Program
title: Mini Program
description: A lightweight app that runs inside a host app such as WeChat · A shop can share a booking mini program in a chat, letting customers choose a time inside WeChat. A browser booking page may look the same; its runtime and available capabilities differ. Know first Frontend
zhDescription: 运行在微信等宿主应用里的轻量应用 · 门店可以把预约小程序发到聊天里，顾客打开后就在微信内选择时段。浏览器里的预约网页也能长得一样，但运行环境和可用能力不同，不能把网页直接当成小程序。 先知道 前端 Frontend
quote: I want customers to book inside WeChat without installing another app.
zhQuote: 我想让顾客在微信里预约，不用再装一个 App。

name: WXML
title: WXML
description: A markup language for describing a WeChat mini program’s page structure and binding displayed data · On a booking screen, text and button tags define the visible objects, while a binding such as {{title}} displays page data. WXML places the objects; styles and click handling come from other files. Know first Mini Program
zhDescription: 用标签描述微信小程序页面结构，并绑定显示数据的语言 · 预约页的文字和按钮由标签组成，{{title}} 这类写法把页面数据放到指定位置。WXML 负责有哪些对象、怎样组织；颜色、圆角和点击后做什么由其他文件配合完成。 先知道 小程序 Mini Program
quote: Add an activity title and a booking button to this mini program screen.
zhQuote: 小程序这页加一个活动标题和预约按钮。

name: WXSS
title: WXSS
description: A style language that describes the appearance and layout of WeChat mini program components · A booking button can keep the same label and action while its color, corners, and spacing change through WXSS. It controls appearance; it does not submit or save bookings. Know first Mini Program
zhDescription: 描述微信小程序组件外观和排版的样式语言 · 预约按钮的文字与点击行为不变时，可以用 WXSS 修改颜色、圆角和间距。它控制画面怎么显示，不负责提交或保存预约。 先知道 小程序 Mini Program
quote: Make the booking button more noticeable and give it some space around it.
zhQuote: 把小程序里的预约按钮做醒目一点，周围也留点空。

name: rpx
title: rpx
description: A relative size unit converted according to a mini program page’s width · When page width is 375px, 600rpx is 300px; at 450px it is 360px. Both occupy 80% of page width. Relative sizing does not automatically reflow columns or prevent long text from overflowing. Know first WXSS Responsive Design
zhDescription: 按小程序页面宽度换算显示大小的相对尺寸单位 · 页面宽 375px 时，600rpx 换算为 300px；宽 450px 时则为 360px，都占页面宽度的 80%。这种单位只改变尺寸，不能自动重排分栏，也不能保证长文字不溢出。 先知道 WXSS 响应式设计 Responsive Design
quote: Why does the same button size look wider on another phone?
zhQuote: 同一个按钮尺寸，换一台手机怎么变宽了？

name: Page Lifecycle
title: Page Lifecycle
description: Callbacks triggered when a page is created, shown, hidden, or unloaded · In a mini program, opening a booking detail page can hide the list while keeping its instance. Returning shows that same list again and triggers onShow, not another onLoad. Choose refresh and cleanup timing based on those events. Know first Mini Program State
zhDescription: 页面在创建、显示、隐藏和卸载等时机触发的一组回调 · 小程序打开预约详情时，列表页可能只是隐藏，原来的页面实例仍保留。返回时这个列表重新显示，触发 onShow，不会再触发一次 onLoad。刷新与清理应放在合适的时机。 先知道 小程序 Mini Program 状态 State
quote: After I change a booking and return to the list, why is the old time still there?
zhQuote: 在详情页改完预约，返回列表怎么还是旧时间？

name: Subpackage Loading
title: Subpackage Loading
description: A mechanism that separates mini program code into a main package and subpackages loaded when needed · A shop’s home screen can live in the main package while its return and repair pages live in a support subpackage. Entering support can then load that package. Downloading page code is separate from fetching order data. Know first Mini Program File
zhDescription: 把小程序代码拆成主包和按需加载的分包的机制 · 商城首页可以放在主包，退货与维修页放在售后分包，用户进入售后时再加载相关代码。这里下载的是页面代码与资源，不是向服务器读取订单数据。 先知道 小程序 Mini Program 文件项 File
quote: Can this mini program open its home screen before downloading the rarely used support pages?
zhQuote: 首页先打开，不常用的售后页能不能晚点再加载？

name: Button
title: Button
description: Click to save, submit, delete, or run another action · A button runs an action on the current page, such as saving a form, creating a project, or confirming a deletion. Use a Link to move somewhere else. When several buttons appear together, make the main action easy to spot.
zhDescription: 按钮是让用户在当前页面执行保存、提交、删除等操作的可点击控件 · 用户提交注册表单或保存设置时会点击按钮。链接负责前往别处；同一操作区应突出一个主要动作，其余动作降低层级。
quote: Add a button that saves the content when someone clicks it.
zhQuote: 帮我加个按钮，点了就能把内容存下来。

name: Link
title: Link
description: Click to open another page, location, or file · A link takes people to another page, a place on the same page, or a downloadable file. Its text should make the destination clear, and keyboard users need a visible focus state. Use a Button for actions such as saving or submitting.
zhDescription: 链接是带用户前往另一个页面、页内位置或资源地址的可点击文本或元素 · 例如“查看订单详情”可打开详情页，“下载发票”可取得文件。链接不应用来提交或保存数据；这类动作应使用按钮。
quote: Make this text clickable so it takes people to another page.
zhQuote: 这段文字要能让人点，点了跳到另一个页面。

name: Input
title: Input
description: Let the user enter one line of text · Use a text input for an account name, nickname, search query, or anything else that fits on one line. Give it a label that stays visible after typing. If the value is invalid, explain what is wrong and how to fix it near the field.
zhDescription: 输入框是让用户填写账号、搜索词等短文本的表单控件 · 账号、昵称和搜索词通常放在输入框中。字段名称要始终可见，格式错误要在附近说明；需要输入多行说明时应使用多行文本框。
quote: Add a field where people can enter their email address.
zhQuote: 页面上要有个填邮箱的地方。

name: Textarea
title: Textarea
description: Let the user enter several lines of text · Comments, descriptions, feedback, and prompts for AI often need a multiline textarea. Give it a useful starting height and, when needed, a character count or resize control. A normal Input is faster for short, single-line answers. Know first Input
zhDescription: 多行文本框是让用户输入或编辑多段自由文本的表单控件 · 评论、个人简介和给 AI 的提示词适合使用它，并可显示字数限制。只需要填写昵称等短内容时，普通输入框更直接。 先知道 输入框 Input
quote: People need to write a longer message here, so one line won't be enough.
zhQuote: 要让用户写一大段话，一行肯定不够。

name: Number Input
title: Number Input
description: Enter a number with a defined range and step · A number input works for quantity, stock, price, and other numeric values. It can limit the format, minimum, maximum, and step size. Business rules such as available stock or a valid price still need to be checked again when the form is submitted. Know first Input
zhDescription: 数字输入框是用于填写数值并按设定步长增减的表单控件 · 购买数量、库存和价格可在这里直接输入或点加减号调整。它只能限制格式和范围，库存是否足够等业务规则仍要在提交时校验。 先知道 输入框 Input
quote: Only let people enter numbers for the quantity, with plus and minus controls if possible.
zhQuote: 数量那里只能填数字，最好能直接按加减。

name: Radio
title: Radio
description: Choose exactly one option from a small set · Radio buttons show mutually exclusive choices such as payment method or visibility. Give the group a clear question and keep all options visible. If there are many options or users need to search, a Select may work better.
zhDescription: 单选框是一组只能选中其中一个选项的表单控件 · 选择支付方式或可见范围时，可将少量互斥选项直接列出。每组要有清楚的问题说明；选项较多或需要搜索时应改用 选择器 Select 。
quote: These options should be mutually exclusive—choosing one should clear the last one.
zhQuote: 这几个选项只能选一个，选了新的要把旧的取消掉。

name: Checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Choose one, several, or none of the options · Checkboxes work for interests, filters, and other choices that are independent of one another. A single checkbox can also confirm one statement. If exactly one option must be selected, use Radio instead.
zhDescription: 复选框是让用户独立选中一个或多个选项的表单控件 · 兴趣标签、筛选条件和同意协议都可使用复选框。每个选项彼此独立；只能选择一个答案时应使用 单选框 Radio 。
quote: These options don't conflict, so people should be able to choose more than one.
zhQuote: 这几个选项不冲突，用户想选几个都行。

name: Switch
title: Switch
description: Turn a setting on or off immediately · A switch shows whether a feature is currently on or off, such as dark mode or autosave. The change should take effect and show feedback right away. If several settings are saved together at the end, use Checkbox controls with a save button.
zhDescription: 在开启与关闭两种对立状态之间即时切换的开关控件。 · 深色模式或自动保存适合用开关，并应在切换后反馈成功或失败。若多个设置需要统一保存，应改用 复选框 Checkbox 配合按钮。
quote: Make this work like a phone setting: flip it on, then flip it off again.
zhQuote: 像手机设置里那样，这个功能一拨就开、再拨就关。

name: Slider
title: Slider
description: Drag to adjust a value within a range · A slider is useful for quickly changing volume, brightness, or a price range. Show the limits and current value, and make the control work from the keyboard. If an exact number matters, pair it with an Number Input .
zhDescription: 滑块是沿着一段连续或分级范围调整数值的表单控件 · 音量、亮度和价格区间可用滑块调整。应显示范围、当前值并支持键盘操作；需要精确输入 50 等具体数值时，还要提供 数字输入框 Number Input 。
quote: I want a draggable slider for setting the price range.
zhQuote: 价格范围想用一根可以拖着走的滑杆来调。

name: Rate
title: Rate
description: Express a rating with stars or ordered levels · A rating control lets people show satisfaction on an ordered scale, often with five stars. Pair the graphic with a readable number or label, and make sure keyboard and screen-reader users can select a value too.
zhDescription: 评分控件是让用户在有顺序的等级中选择评价分值的表单控件 · 商品评价常用五颗星表示满意程度，并应同时显示“4 分”等可读文字。星数、是否允许半分必须与实际评价规则一致。
quote: Let people rate the product with stars.
zhQuote: 想让用户给商品打个分，用星星就行。

name: Select
title: Select
description: Choose one value from a collapsed list · Use a select when answers come from a fixed list but do not need to stay visible all the time. A few options are clearer as Radio buttons. If users may type their own answer, use an input or Autocomplete .
zhDescription: 选择器是从固定选项列表中选择一个或多个值的表单控件 · 城市、部门等选项较多且不适合平铺时可收进选择器。只有少量选项时 单选框 Radio 更直观；允许用户自定义内容时应使用输入框或 自动完成 Autocomplete 。
quote: There are too many choices to show all at once. Put them in a dropdown people can open and pick from.
zhQuote: 选项有几十个，全摆出来太占地方，收起来点一下再挑。

name: Autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Show matching suggestions while the user types · Autocomplete works for addresses, contacts, and tags that have common answers but may still allow free text. The user can choose a suggestion or keep typing. If only listed values are valid, use a searchable Select instead. Know first Input Select
zhDescription: 自动完成是在用户输入时显示匹配建议、帮助更快完成输入的表单控件 · 填写地址、联系人或标签时可从建议中点选，也可继续输入。最终能否提交未匹配内容取决于业务规则；只接受固定选项时要限制为选择建议，或改用 选择器 Select ，并处理无匹配和加载失败。 先知道 输入框 Input 选择器 Select
quote: When someone types the first few letters, show suggestions and let them click one to finish the entry.
zhQuote: 输入前几个字，下面自动猜我要写什么，点一下就补全。

name: Cascader
title: Cascader
description: Choose a path one level at a time · A cascader works for data such as country, state, and city or a nested product category. Keep the current path visible and explain whether a parent level can be selected. If users need items from several branches at once, a tree selector is usually clearer. Know first Select
zhDescription: 点开一个选项后继续选择下一级，常见于省、市、区选择 · 例如填写收货地址时，先选“广东省”，再选“深圳市”，最后选“南山区”，完成后要显示整条路径。若用户需要同时选择多个地区，用 树选择 Tree Select 更合适。 先知道 选择器 Select
quote: For the address, let people choose state, then city, then neighborhood one level at a time.
zhQuote: 选地址那种，先选省、再选市、再选区，一层层点下去。

name: Tree Select
title: Tree Select
description: Choose one or more items from a hierarchy · A tree selector fits departments, categories, and permission scopes with parent-child relationships. Explain whether selecting a parent includes its children, what a partial selection means, and which level is actually submitted. Know first Tree Checkbox
zhDescription: 在可展开的父子列表里勾选一个或多个项目 · 例如设置数据权限时，用户可以展开“公司 → 部门 → 小组”，再跨不同部门勾选需要开放的范围。页面必须说明勾选一个部门是否会同时选中它下面的小组；如果只需沿一条路径选一个结果，用 级联选择器 Cascader 更简单。 先知道 树形控件 Tree 复选框 Checkbox
quote: The options are nested, so people need to expand a level before choosing from it.
zhQuote: 选项是一层套一层的，得能展开再选。

name: Date Picker
title: Date Picker
description: Choose a date or date range from a calendar · A date picker reduces ambiguity by showing dates in a calendar. It may select one day or a range. State the allowed dates, whether the start and end days are included, and which time zone applies when people work across regions. Know first Input
zhDescription: 日期选择器是用日历选择某一天或一段日期的表单控件 · 预订入住日期或筛选本月订单时可用日历降低格式歧义。要说明可选范围、区间是否包含当天；跨地区业务还必须说明计算日期的时区。 先知道 输入框 Input
quote: Give people a calendar to choose a date instead of making them type it in.
zhQuote: 日期别让用户手输，给个日历直接挑。

name: Time Picker
title: Time Picker
description: Choose a specific time within allowed hours · A time picker lets people choose hours and minutes, and sometimes seconds. Make the 12-hour or 24-hour format clear, define the minute step, and show which times are unavailable. Know first Input
zhDescription: 时间选择器是让用户从允许范围中选择具体时刻的表单控件 · 预约会议可选择 09:30 这类时间。应明确 12 小时制或 24 小时制、时间步长和不可选时段；跨地区协作还要显示时区。 先知道 输入框 Input
quote: Let people choose the time instead of typing it themselves.
zhQuote: 让用户选几点几分，别让他自己打字。

name: Upload
title: Upload
description: Send a file from a device to the website · Uploading includes choosing, transferring, and saving a file. Explain type, size, and count limits before selection, show progress during transfer, and allow retry after failure. The server still needs to check the file and the user's permission. Know first Form
zhDescription: 让用户从电脑或手机选择图片、视频或文档，并提交给当前网站或软件 · 例如更换头像时，页面应先说明支持的格式和大小，选择图片后显示上传进度、成功或失败。网站后面的服务器仍要再次检查文件是否安全、格式是否正确。 先知道 表单 Form
quote: Let people upload their own images.
zhQuote: 用户要能把自己的图片传上来。

name: Form
title: Form
description: Collect several fields and submit them as one task · A form organizes multiple inputs into a task such as creating an account or placing an order. It needs clear labels, validation, error placement, submission state, and a final result so people know what to fix and whether their data was saved. Know first Input Button
zhDescription: 网页或软件里让用户填写并提交一组信息的区域，比如注册、下单或修改资料 · 例如注册账号时，用户会填写手机号、验证码和密码，再点“注册”。填错的内容要在对应输入框附近说明；提交后还要明确账号是否真的创建成功。 先知道 输入框 Input 按钮 Button
quote: Build a sign-up page where people fill in their information and submit it.
zhQuote: 帮我做个注册页，用户填完信息点提交那种。

name: Color Picker
title: Color Picker
description: A form control for viewing and choosing a color value · Use a color picker for a theme, chart series, or drawing tool. Along with the palette, show a copyable value; text and icons still need enough contrast to be readable.
zhDescription: 颜色选择器是让用户查看并选择颜色值的表单控件 · 主题设置、图表标记和画板工具可用它选择颜色。除色盘外应显示可复制的色值；文字或图标仍必须满足足够对比度。
quote: Let people choose their own theme color instead of hard-coding one.
zhQuote: 主题色想让用户自己挑，别写死。

name: Label
title: Label
description: Visible text that tells people what a form control asks for · An Email label on a sign-in form should stay visible and focus its matching input when clicked. Put required, format, and error information nearby instead of relying on placeholder text.
zhDescription: 表单标签是说明一个输入控件需要填写或选择什么的可见文字 · 登录页的“邮箱”标签应始终显示，并且点击后能让对应输入框获得焦点。必填、格式和错误原因应在附近补充，不能只依赖占位文字。
quote: Put a clear label in front of every field so people know what to enter.
zhQuote: 每栏前面得写清楚要填什么，不然用户看不懂。

name: Placeholder
title: Placeholder
description: A placeholder is the gray example inside an input box showing the expected format; it vanishes the moment you type. · The gray you@example.com in an email box demonstrates "fill it like this" and steps aside at the first keystroke. It splits the job with the label: the label sits beside the box and stays, while the placeholder only opens the show—once typing starts, only the label tells you what the field is. Know first Input Label
zhDescription: 占位文字是输入框里的灰色示例，告诉你该填什么格式；一开始输入就消失。 · 例如邮箱输入框里灰色的 you@example.com，是在演示「填成这个样子」；你打进第一个字它就退场了。它和标签分工不同：标签写在输入框旁边，一直都在；占位文字只负责开场的示范，不能代替标签——一旦开始输入，占位消失，只有标签还告诉用户这个框是填什么的。 先知道 输入框 Input 表单标签 Label
quote: The email placeholder should read you@example.com, and the "Email" label must stay visible—not placeholder-only.
zhQuote: 邮箱输入框的占位文字写成 you@example.com 这样的示例格式，标签「邮箱」要一直显示，不能只靠占位文字。

name: Table
title: Table
description: Compare many records across the same columns · Tables suit orders, members, inventory, and other records that share the same fields. Sorting, filtering, and pagination each need deliberate behavior. When there are many columns, plan for smaller screens, horizontal scrolling, and clear header relationships.
zhDescription: 表格是按行和列展示同一组字段、便于比较多条记录的数据组件 · 订单、成员和库存可放进表格逐列比较。排序、筛选和分页需明确反馈当前状态；列很多时还要处理小屏和横向滚动。
quote: This order data is a mess. Lay it out in a table with one order per row.
zhQuote: 订单数据堆在一起太乱了，帮我排成表格，一行一条。

name: List
title: List
description: Show similar items one after another · A list repeats the same structure for messages, articles, contacts, or other items that people scan from top to bottom. It is more flexible than a table and more compact than a grid of cards, so it works when column-by-column comparison is not important.
zhDescription: 列表是按相同结构连续排列多条内容或记录的数据组件 · 消息、文章和联系人可一行一条从上向下浏览。它适合不需逐列比较的信息；需要比较固定字段时使用表格通常更清楚。
quote: Just stack these items in a consistent list, one after another.
zhQuote: 这些内容一条一条排下来就行，格式统一。

name: Card
title: Card
description: Keep information about one item in a single block · A card usually groups an image, title, summary, and actions for the same object. It works well for browsing similar items. Make it clear whether the whole card is clickable; if only parts perform actions, keep links and buttons separate.
zhDescription: 卡片是把同一对象的标题、摘要、图片和操作组织在一起的内容容器 · 项目、商品或文章的浏览页可一张卡片对应一个对象。整张卡是否能点击必须清楚；局部操作则让链接和按钮分别承担。
quote: Make each product a clickable card with the image on top and the name and price underneath.
zhQuote: 每个商品做成一张小卡片：图在上面，名字价格在下，整张都能点。

name: Tag
title: Tag
description: Mark a status, category, or selected condition with short text · Tags help people recognize status, category, and active filters at a glance. Color can support scanning, but the words still need to carry the meaning. A normal tag displays information; a removable tag may clear a filter or selection.
zhDescription: 标签是用短文字标记内容状态、类别、属性或筛选条件的组件 · 订单旁的“已支付”或筛选区的“北京”都可用标签。颜色只辅助扫读，文字必须表达含义；带关闭入口的标签才可移除条件。
quote: Label each article as a tutorial or news item so people can tell them apart at a glance.
zhQuote: 文章得标出是教程还是新闻，让人一眼能分出来。

name: Badge
title: Badge
description: Add a count or compact status next to another object · A badge sits beside an icon, tab, or avatar to show a count, short label, or status dot, such as unread messages. Important meaning cannot rely on color alone, and screen readers need a complete description rather than just a number or dot.
zhDescription: 徽标是附着在其他元素旁、补充数量或状态的简短标记 · 消息图标右上角的“3”可提醒未读数量。不能只用红点或颜色表达重要状态，读屏用户也需要获得完整说明。
quote: Show a little red number on the message icon for how many messages are unread.
zhQuote: 消息图标右上角那个红色小数字，显示有几条没读。

name: Avatar
title: Avatar
description: Represent a person, team, or organization visually · An avatar may be a photo, initials, illustration, or logo; it does not have to be a circular face. Member lists and comments should usually show a name as well, because an image alone is not a reliable identity.
zhDescription: 头像是用于识别用户、团队或组织的图像、首字或标志组件 · 成员列表和评论区可用头像帮助快速认人。应同时展示姓名，不能只靠头像辨认身份；使用照片还要尊重隐私设置。
quote: Show an avatar in the comments so people can see who's speaking.
zhQuote: 评论区得看到是谁在说话，带上头像。

name: Descriptions
title: Descriptions
description: Show the field names and values of one record · A description list pairs labels with read-only values for an order, account, or project. It may look similar to a form, but its main job is viewing. When people need to change the information, move them into a clearly editable form.
zhDescription: 在详情页里用“字段名 + 内容”展示一条记录的只读信息 · 例如订单详情会显示“收货人：李明”“状态：已发货”“金额：¥199”。它只负责查看；如果用户需要修改这些内容，应使用可编辑的 表单 Form 。
quote: On the details page, list the name, date, and status clearly, one field at a time.
zhQuote: 详情页把信息列清楚就行：名称、时间、状态，一项一项的。

name: Statistic
title: Statistic
description: Highlight a small number of important values · A statistic combines a label, value, unit, and sometimes a trend. If a number went up or down, say what time period or baseline it is compared with. Keep formats and definitions consistent for money, percentages, counts, and other units.
zhDescription: 在首页或数据看板上突出显示人数、金额、比例等关键数字 · 例如“本周订单 486，较上周增加 12%”同时告诉用户数值和比较对象。只写“↑12%”却不说明和谁相比，会让结果失去意义。
quote: Put a few big numbers on the homepage, like total users and sales.
zhQuote: 首页要几个特别大的数字，比如用户数、成交额。

name: Tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switch between a few peer sections on the same page · Tabs work for sections such as Overview, Settings, and Logs under the same object. Keep the active tab obvious and decide whether unfinished input remains when switching. If the sections are really separate destinations, use navigation instead.
zhDescription: 标签页是在同一页面内切换平级内容面板的导航组件 · 项目详情可在“概览、配置、日志”之间切换。要清楚显示当前标签和是否保留输入状态；本质为不同页面的内容应使用导航菜单。
quote: There's too much content here. Split it into tabs so people can switch views with a click.
zhQuote: 内容太多了，帮我分几个页签，点一下就换一屏。

name: Segmented
title: Segmented
description: Switch quickly between a few short, exclusive modes · A segmented control keeps several short options visible together. It often changes a view, sort order, or time range and usually does not navigate to a new page. If options are numerous or their labels are long, choose another control. Know first Radio Tabs
zhDescription: 把少量选项并排放在一起，点一下就切换当前查看方式 · 例如在任务页点击“列表 / 看板 / 日历”，同一批任务会换一种展示方式。它不负责前往另一个页面；选项很多时也不适合全部塞进这里。 先知道 单选框 Radio 标签页 Tabs
quote: Put two or three choices side by side so people can tap one to switch, like the iPhone control.
zhQuote: 就两三个选项并排，点哪个选哪个，像 iPhone 那种切换条。

name: Collapse
title: Collapse
description: Hide secondary details until the user asks for them · A collapse panel shows a heading first and expands the body on request. It suits FAQs and advanced settings. Do not hide warnings, required rules, or anything people must see before they act.
zhDescription: 折叠面板是可按需展开或收起一组内容的界面组件 · 常见问题和高级设置可先显示标题，用户点开再读正文。风险提示、提交条件等必须看到的信息不应默认藏在折叠面板里。
quote: There are a lot of questions. Show just the question first, then let people open it to see the answer.
zhQuote: 问题很多，先只显示标题，点开了再看答案。

name: Timeline
title: Timeline
description: Show a sequence of events in time order · A timeline works for shipping, approval records, and release history. Choose whether the newest event appears first or last and stay consistent. Dates, labels, and status text carry the meaning; dots and colors only help people scan.
zhDescription: 时间轴是按时间顺序展示一组事件、状态或记录的数据组件 · 物流记录可依次显示“已下单、已发货、运输中”。需统一最新事件放在上方或下方，并用文字说明状态，不能只靠颜色和圆点。
quote: Show the shipping updates in time order so people can tell where the package is.
zhQuote: 物流到哪一步了，按时间排出来，让用户看得明白。

name: Tree
title: Tree
description: Expand and browse data with parent-child levels · A tree reveals folders, departments, categories, and other hierarchies by expanding and collapsing levels. It may support browsing, selection, or dragging. For permissions and selection, explain clearly how parent and child nodes affect each other.
zhDescription: 把文件夹、部门或分类按父子关系排列，并让用户逐层展开或收起 · 例如项目文件会显示“src”文件夹，展开后才能看到里面的页面文件。它主要帮助浏览层级；需要从中勾选并提交结果时，应使用 树选择 Tree Select 。
quote: Make it work like folders: click the little arrow to expand the next level.
zhQuote: 文件夹那种一层层展开的，点小三角展开下一级。

name: Carousel
title: Carousel
description: Show several panels one at a time in the same space · A carousel often appears in promotional banners and onboarding, but later slides are easy to miss. Do not place essential information only inside it. If it moves automatically, let people pause it and provide clear controls and position indicators.
zhDescription: 走马灯是在同一内容区域轮流展示多张幻灯片的轮播组件 · 首页宣传内容或新手引导可用走马灯切换多张幻灯片。重要信息不能只放在后面；自动播放时必须允许暂停，并提供当前位置和切换入口。
quote: I want several hero images to rotate automatically, with left and right arrows too.
zhQuote: 首页大图想几张轮着播，自动切换，还能点左右箭头。

name: Empty
title: Empty
description: Explain why no data is shown and what to do next · An empty state should not leave a blank area. Tell people what normally appears there, why it is empty now, and whether the next step is to create something, search, change a filter, or wait for data.
zhDescription: 空状态是在内容区域没有可展示数据时说明原因和下一步的界面状态 · 新项目列表为空时，可说明“还没有项目”并提供“新建项目”按钮。它不能代替加载失败或权限不足等错误提示，应说明真实原因。
quote: When there's no data, show an image and tell people what they can do next instead of leaving the page blank.
zhQuote: 没数据的时候别一片空白，放张图加句话，告诉用户接下来怎么办。

name: Image
title: Image
description: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback · An image component can handle aspect ratio, cropping, lazy loading, preview, and loading failure consistently. Reserve its space to prevent layout shifts. Meaningful images need alternative text; purely decorative images should be ignored by screen readers.
zhDescription: 在网页或软件里显示头像、商品图、文章配图等图片 · 例如商品列表应先为封面留出固定位置，图片加载后再按比例裁切，避免页面突然跳动。图片本身承载信息时要填写文字说明，方便图片加载失败或使用读屏的人理解；纯装饰图片不需要朗读。
quote: Let me add images to the article, and make sure they don't get distorted on phones.
zhQuote: 文章里要能插图，手机上别变形。

name: File
title: File
description: A UI row or card that shows one document, image, or attachment and its status · An upload list might show project-plan.pdf , 2.4 MB, and Uploaded. Make the filename most prominent and use type and status as support; an icon alone does not identify the file.
zhDescription: 文件项是展示单个文档、图片或附件名称、状态和操作的界面单元 · 上传完成列表可显示“项目计划.pdf、2.4 MB、已上传”。文件名应最显眼，类型和状态作补充；不能只放一个图标让用户猜文件内容。
quote: For uploaded attachments, show the filename and size and let people remove them.
zhQuote: 传上来的附件得能看到文件名和大小，还能删掉。

name: Icon
title: Icon
description: A small, consistent visual symbol for an action, object, or status · Familiar icons such as search, download, and close help people scan quickly. For an unfamiliar or high-risk action, add text or a Tooltip .
zhDescription: 图标是用统一的小型视觉符号表示功能、对象或状态的界面元素 · 搜索、下载和关闭可用熟悉图标帮助扫读。陌生或高风险操作不能只放图标，应补上文字或 文字提示 Tooltip 。
quote: Add a small icon to the button so people can tell what it does without reading.
zhQuote: 按钮上加个小图形，让人不看字也知道是干嘛的。

name: Quote
title: Quote
description: A sourced quotation or excerpt set apart from the surrounding text · Use indentation, quotation marks, or a rule to separate an expert’s words or customer feedback from an author’s view. Keep the speaker, source, or needed context; do not style ordinary text as a quote just for decoration.
zhDescription: 引用是从正文中区分出来、并标明来源的原话或文字摘录 · 文章引用专家的话或客户评价时，可用缩进、引号或边线把原文与作者观点分开。要保留说话者、出处或必要上下文；普通正文不该只为装饰做成引用。
quote: Pull out this person's exact words and make it stand out, with their name attached.
zhQuote: 把这句别人的原话单独突出一下，标明是谁说的。

name: Video
title: Video
description: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page · Video can demonstrate a product action or teach a course, such as “Create a project in two minutes.” The poster should state the topic and length, and the player needs captions, sound controls, and a clear failure state.
zhDescription: 视频是可在页面中播放、包含连续画面和时间进度的媒体内容 · 产品操作演示或课程讲解可通过视频呈现动态步骤，例如“用 2 分钟创建项目”。封面应说明内容和时长，并提供字幕、声音控制和加载失败提示；关键说明不能只留在视频里。
quote: Put a video on the page that people can play with one click.
zhQuote: 我想在页面里放个视频，用户点一下就能看。

name: Chat UI
title: Chat UI
description: A chat UI is the interactive interface that organizes a message list, input area, and conversation feedback states. · After someone sends a question, the interface should add their message to the list, show waiting or streamed output, and provide an understandable error and retry path on failure. Customer support chat and AI chat both need these interface capabilities. It is the shell people see and use, not the model or support system behind it. Know first Input Streaming Response
zhDescription: 聊天界面是组织消息列表、输入区和对话反馈状态的交互界面。 · 例如用户发送一条问题后，界面应把自己的消息放入列表，显示等待或流式输出，并在失败时保留可理解的错误和重试入口；客服聊天和 AI 对话都需要这些界面能力。它是用户看见和操作的壳，不等于里面连接的模型或客服系统。 先知道 输入框 Input 流式响应 Streaming Response
quote: Complete this chat window with a message list, input area, sending state, and retry on failure—do not hide errors.
zhQuote: 把这个聊天窗口补全消息列表、输入区、发送中和失败重试，别把错误藏起来。

name: Filter
title: Filter
description: Filtering is a feature that narrows the current content collection using existing properties or conditions. · A task list can keep only items matching owner, status, and due date; a product list can narrow by price or size. Filtering excludes items that do not meet explicit conditions. It does not interpret a free-form sentence and is not the same as sorting results. Know first Checkbox Select Table
zhDescription: 筛选是按已有属性或条件缩小当前内容集合的功能。 · 例如任务列表可按负责人、状态和截止日期只保留符合条件的项，商品列表可按价格或尺寸缩小范围。它基于明确条件排除不符合的内容，不负责理解用户自由输入的一句话，也不等于给结果排序。 先知道 复选框 Checkbox 选择器 Select 表格 Table
quote: Show only tasks due this week, incomplete, and assigned to me; hide the rest for now.
zhQuote: 只显示本周、未完成、负责人是我的任务，其他任务先不看。

name: Chart
title: Chart
description: A chart is a way to compare and understand data through visual encodings such as position, length, size, or color. · A line chart can show orders changing by month, while a bar chart compares counts across channels. Charts make trends and differences easier to notice. They are not the data itself and do not replace a precise table people must check item by item or prove causation. Know first Statistic
zhDescription: 图表是用位置、长度、大小或颜色等视觉编码来比较和理解数据的展示方式。 · 例如折线图可看订单随月份的变化，柱状图可比较不同渠道的数量；图表让趋势和差异更容易被看见。它不是数据本身，也不适合代替用户需要逐项核对的精确表格或证明因果关系。 先知道 统计数值 Statistic
quote: Use a chart to compare order changes over these six months, but do not make people guess values from color alone.
zhQuote: 用图表比较这六个月的订单变化，但不要让人只看颜色猜数值。

name: App Icon
title: App Icon
description: A brand image the operating system uses to identify an app · An App Icon appears on the Home Screen, in system search, Settings, or an app store, and the system may scale or mask it to fit a platform shape. Putting a horizontal Logo into a square canvas can make text tiny or cropped, so the system surface needs its own recognizable artwork. Know first Image Logo
zhDescription: 操作系统用来识别应用的品牌图像 · 应用图标会出现在主屏幕、系统搜索、设置或应用商店等位置，系统可能缩放或套用平台形状。横向 Logo 直接缩进方形画布后，文字常会变小或被裁切，因此要为系统位置准备可识别的图形母版。 先知道 图片 Image 标志 Logo
quote: Use the existing brand shape to make a square App Icon that works on the Home Screen, in search, and in Settings; do not change toolbar icons.
zhQuote: 用现有品牌形状做一个适合主屏幕、搜索和设置显示的方形 App Icon，别改应用里的工具栏图标。

name: Sort
title: Sort
description: Sorting puts a list in order by one field—newest first, or largest amount first—without removing a single record. · A quote list can default to newest first, and tapping the amount header flips to largest first. Sorting and filtering partner in opposite directions: filtering hides non-matching records and shortens the list, while sorting keeps every record and only reorders. Telling an AI "sort by creation time descending" beats "put the new ones on top." Know first Table Filter
zhDescription: 排序是把列表按某个字段排先后——按日期从新到旧、按金额从大到小，记录一条不少，只是换了位置。 · 例如报价列表默认按创建时间倒序，最新的一条永远在最上面；点一下「金额」列头，就变成金额最大的在前。排序和筛选是搭档但方向不同：筛选把不符合条件的藏起来，列表会变短；排序不减少任何记录，只调整先后。跟 AI 说「按创建时间倒序」比说「把最新的放上面」更准。 先知道 表格 Table 筛选 Filter
quote: When the quote list opens, show the newest on top, and let me tap the amount column to sort by size.
zhQuote: 报价列表打开时最新的放最上面，金额那列能点一下按大小排。

name: Alert
title: Alert
description: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page · An alert sits near the related content and explains a status, risk, or problem without blocking the whole page. Use a heading, icon, and clear wording together to show importance; color alone is not enough.
zhDescription: 警告提示是嵌在页面内容中、持续说明状态、风险或异常的提示组件 · 账号即将到期可在设置页相关位置显示警告提示。它不阻断当前操作，但重要程度不能只靠颜色，需同时使用标题、图标和文字。
quote: Keep a yellow warning at the top of the page to let people know their account is about to expire.
zhQuote: 页面上方要一直挂着一条黄色提示，告诉用户账号快到期了。

name: Toast
title: Toast
description: Briefly confirm a small action that just finished · A toast is useful for lightweight feedback such as Saved, Copied, or Added. It normally disappears after a few seconds. Do not use it as the only place for an important error, an action the user must take, or information they may need later.
zhDescription: 轻提示是在页面上短暂显示、反馈刚完成操作的提示组件 · 复制链接或保存设置后可显示“已复制”“已保存”。位置和停留时间要避免遮挡当前任务；需要用户处理或记住的信息不能只依赖轻提示。
quote: Show a little 'Saved' message in the corner that disappears after a couple of seconds.
zhQuote: 就是那种角落冒出来一句“已保存”，过两秒自己消失的小提示。

name: Notification
title: Notification
description: Notify the user about an event with a title and details · A notification carries more information than a toast and suits background jobs, activity from other people, and delayed results. If the message should be available later, also store it in a notification center with a read state.
zhDescription: 在页面角落或通知中心出现，提醒用户某件事已经发生或需要处理 · 例如报表导出完成后，通知可以显示“文件已生成”，并提供“下载”入口。只有需要稍后查看的消息才应保留在通知中心；短暂的操作反馈用 轻提示 Toast 更合适。
quote: Clicking the bell in the top right should show all of someone's system notifications.
zhQuote: 右上角铃铛点开，里面列出所有系统消息。

name: Modal
title: Modal
description: Pause the page for one focused decision or task · A modal appears above the page when the user must review or complete a focused task before continuing. It needs a clear title, a safe way to close, sensible keyboard focus, and buttons that state the result. Long or complex work is usually better on its own page.
zhDescription: 在当前页面上方居中弹出的阻断式对话框，用于聚焦单一核心操作。 · 确认删除、填写短表单或预览内容可在弹窗内完成。它会限制背景操作，因此只用于确实需要集中注意力的任务，并要管理关闭和键盘焦点。
quote: Click the button to show a dialog in the middle of the screen and dim the background.
zhQuote: 点击按钮后弹出一个居中窗口，背景变暗，必须确认或关闭后才能继续。。

name: Drawer
title: Drawer
description: Slide in a side panel without leaving the current page · A drawer keeps the current page visible while showing details, filters, navigation, or a short editing task from the side. Make the boundary and close behavior clear. If the content needs a lot of space or has its own navigation, use a full page.
zhDescription: 从屏幕边缘滑出的覆盖层面板，用于展示承载较多内容的辅助操作。 · 在项目列表旁查看详情或调整筛选时可打开抽屉。无论在手机上占满屏幕还是只占一侧，都需要清楚的标题、关闭入口和焦点管理。
quote: Open a details panel from the right, but keep the list behind it visible.
zhQuote: 从右边滑出来一块面板看详情，背后的列表还能看见。

name: Popconfirm
title: Popconfirm
description: Ask for confirmation next to the action that caused it · A popconfirm is a small confirmation panel anchored to a button or link. It works for a simple, local action with a short explanation. Use a Modal when the risk is high, the explanation is longer, or more information must be entered. Know first Popover Modal
zhDescription: 触发危险或关键操作时在控件就近浮现的目标二次确认浮层。 · 移除一个可恢复的标签时可在按钮旁确认“确定移除吗？”。永久删除或转账等高风险操作需要更完整说明，应使用 弹窗 Modal 。 先知道 气泡卡片 Popover 弹窗 Modal
quote: On delete, ask 'Are you sure?' next to the button instead of opening a big dialog.
zhQuote: 点删除时在按钮旁边冒一句“确定吗”，别直接弹大窗。

name: Popover
title: Popover
description: Open a small panel with extra information or controls · A popover is anchored to a trigger and can contain richer content than a tooltip, such as a preview, explanation, or a few controls. It should not carry a long workflow, and its opening and closing behavior must work with keyboard and touch input. Know first Button
zhDescription: 气泡卡片是贴近触发元素展开、可承载补充信息和少量操作的浮层组件 · 点击成员头像可展开其资料、链接和少量操作。只有一句简短解释时使用 文字提示 Tooltip 更合适；触屏设备不能只依赖悬停。 先知道 按钮 Button
quote: Click an avatar to show a small profile card beside it.
zhQuote: 点一下头像，旁边浮出一张小卡片显示资料。

name: Tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Explain a compact control with a short text label · A tooltip gives a brief label or hint for an icon or unfamiliar control. It should appear on keyboard focus as well as hover and must not contain essential instructions. If the content is longer or interactive, use a Popover . Know first Button
zhDescription: 鼠标悬停或聚焦时浮现的轻量级文字提示气泡。 · 鼠标停在陌生下载图标上可显示“下载报告”。它必须支持鼠标、键盘和触屏；必填规则和错误原因等关键信息不能藏在其中。 先知道 按钮 Button
quote: When someone hovers over this icon, show a short label explaining what it does.
zhQuote: 鼠标放上去飘出一行小字，解释这个图标是干嘛的。

name: Progress
title: Progress
description: Show how much of a task has been completed · A progress indicator helps people understand the state of an upload, installation, or multi-step task. Use a percentage when the total is known; otherwise show ongoing activity without pretending to know the finish time. State success, failure, and cancellation clearly.
zhDescription: 进度条是用长度、百分比或阶段表示任务完成程度的状态组件 · 上传 100 MB 文件时可显示“62%”。已知总量时才显示确定百分比；不知道完成度时说明仍在处理中，并提供失败、重试或取消状态。
quote: Show upload progress so people don't think the file upload is stuck.
zhQuote: 上传文件得让用户看到传到多少了，不然以为卡死了。

name: Skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Reserve the layout while content is loading · A skeleton roughly matches the shape of incoming content so the page stays stable during a short load. It should not be a detailed gray copy of every element. For a tiny action or an unknown layout, a simpler loading indicator may be clearer.
zhDescription: 页面加载时先出现的灰色轮廓，用来占住稍后内容的位置 · 例如打开商品列表时，可先看到图片框和两行文字的轮廓，真实内容到达后再替换。它只表示正在加载；等待过久或加载失败时，必须改成明确的提示和重试入口。
quote: While the page is loading, show gray placeholder blocks instead of a spinner the whole time.
zhQuote: 加载时先显示灰色的框框占位，别一直转圈。

name: Result
title: Result
description: Explain the final outcome and the next available step · A result page or panel marks the end of a task, such as payment success, submission failure, or an empty permission state. State what happened, what it means, and what the user can do next. Do not leave them at a decorative success or error icon. Know first Alert Empty
zhDescription: 结果页是在一个完整流程结束后集中说明结果和下一步操作的页面状态 · 支付失败时可说明失败原因并提供重试，审核完成后可提供返回入口。它用于流程结束；404 等访问错误应使用对应的错误页面。 先知道 警告提示 Alert 空状态 Empty
quote: After payment succeeds, show a clear success page instead of immediately sending people somewhere else.
zhQuote: 付款成功后显示付款结果、订单信息和下一步操作，别直接跳走。

name: Spinner
title: Spinner
description: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait · Use a spinner for a brief wait with no reliable completion percentage, such as a submit button, local refresh, or modal task. Name the work in progress; for a long wait, offer cancellation, retry, or a failure result.
zhDescription: 旋转加载指示器是用持续旋转表示系统正在处理、但完成度未知的状态组件 · 点击保存后短暂等待时，可在按钮旁显示旋转指示器并说明“正在保存”。等待过长时不能只让它旋转，应提供取消、重试或失败结果。
quote: Show a loading spinner when things take a while, or people will think the page is broken.
zhQuote: 加载慢的时候给个转圈的东西，不然用户以为坏了。

name: Menu
title: Menu
description: Help people move between the main sections of a product · A menu groups destinations and makes the current location visible. Keep labels consistent, group related items, and avoid making the hierarchy deeper than the product requires. Actions such as sign out should be distinguished from navigation links.
zhDescription: 导航菜单是按层级组织页面或功能入口、帮助用户在产品中移动的导航组件 · 后台可用侧边菜单列出“项目、成员、设置”，并高亮当前位置。它用于前往不同位置；切换同一对象的平级内容应使用标签页。
quote: There are too many features now. Add a menu so people can find their way around.
zhQuote: 功能越来越多，得有一列菜单让用户找得到入口。

name: Breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Show the path from a broad section to the current page · Breadcrumbs help people understand where a deeply nested page sits and let them move back to a parent level. They describe location, not browsing history. On shallow sites, a clear title and navigation are often enough.
zhDescription: 面包屑是按层级展示当前页面路径、帮助用户返回上级的导航组件 · “首页 / 项目 / 设置”可让用户看懂当前位置并返回项目页。上级通常可点击，当前页只说明位置，不需要链接到自己。
quote: This page is buried pretty deep. Show where I am at the top, with links back up the path.
zhQuote: 页面层级太深了，顶上显示一下当前在哪，能点回上一层。

name: Pagination
title: Pagination
description: Move through a large result set in separate pages · Pagination breaks a long result set into stable pages and works well when people need to return to a position or compare totals. Keep filters and sorting when the page changes. For a casual content feed, loading more items may feel more natural.
zhDescription: 分页是把大量结果分成多个可定位页面浏览的导航组件 · 订单列表可每页显示 20 条并让用户跳到第 5 页。应显示当前页和总量并同步到网址；连续浏览的信息流可考虑加载更多。
quote: There are too many items for one page. Add page numbers at the bottom.
zhQuote: 内容太多一页放不下，底下加上 1、2、3 翻页。

name: Steps
title: Steps
description: Show progress through a task with several required stages · A step indicator shows where the user is in a fixed process such as checkout or setup. Use clear stage names, mark completed and current steps, and explain whether people may move backward. It should reflect real task progress, not decorate ordinary sections.
zhDescription: 步骤条是展示多步流程及当前进度的导航与状态组件 · 注册可显示“填写信息、验证邮箱、完成”，让用户知道当前在哪一步。它只展示状态；能否返回、跳过或等待审核需要页面另外说明。
quote: Checkout has three steps. Show people which step they're on at the top.
zhQuote: 下单分三步，顶部要显示现在走到第几步了。

name: Dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Open a compact menu of actions or destinations · A dropdown keeps secondary choices behind a trigger when showing them all would add clutter. Name the trigger clearly and keep the menu short and grouped. A frequent or important action should usually remain visible instead of being hidden.
zhDescription: 下拉菜单是点击一个入口后展开一组相关操作的浮层菜单组件 · “更多”按钮可收纳重命名、导出和删除，减少页面占用。它承载操作；从固定值中选择一个答案应使用 选择器 Select 。
quote: When someone hovers over their username, show a dropdown with Settings and Sign out.
zhQuote: 鼠标放到用户名上，往下展开“设置”“退出”几个选项。

name: Anchor
title: Anchor
description: Jump to a named section on the same long page · Anchor navigation helps people scan and jump within documentation, policies, and other long pages. Keep section labels aligned with headings and update the active item as the page scrolls. It does not replace navigation between separate pages.
zhDescription: 锚点是让用户在同一长页面内跳到指定章节位置的页内导航链接 · 这里说的锚点是文档目录中用于跳到“安装”“API”等小节的页内链接。HTML 的链接元素本身也能前往其他页面或资源；在本词条中，跨页导航统一归入 链接 Link 说明。
quote: This page is long. Add a small table of contents on the right that jumps to each section.
zhQuote: 页面很长，点右边的小目录直接跳到对应段落。

name: Back to Top Button
title: Back to Top Button
description: Return quickly to the top of a long page · A back-to-top control is useful after substantial scrolling, especially when important navigation sits at the top. Keep it out of the way and reveal it only after the user has moved far enough. It does not solve a poorly structured page.
zhDescription: 回到顶部是让用户从长页面当前位置快速返回页首的导航按钮 · 读完很长的帮助文章后可点击它回到目录。按钮不能遮挡聊天或提交入口；短页面和已有便捷目录的页面通常不需要。
quote: After someone scrolls way down, show a button in the bottom right that takes them back to the top.
zhQuote: 滚到很下面之后，右下角出个按钮一键回顶部。

name: Skip Link
title: Skip Link
description: A link that lets keyboard users skip repeated navigation and move to the main content · A skip link appears when someone starts tabbing through a page and moves focus past repeated header links to the main content. It is not ordinary navigation, and it needs a visible focus state and a working target.
zhDescription: 键盘用户按 Tab 后出现的快捷入口，点击可直接跳过顶部导航到正文 · 例如进入文档站时，用户可以先按一次 Tab，再选择“跳到主要内容”，不用逐个经过 Logo、搜索和菜单。它获得焦点时必须看得见，但不能代替正常的页面导航。
quote: Keyboard users have to press Tab too many times to reach the main content. Can they jump there directly?
zhQuote: 有人说用键盘得按好多下 Tab 才能到正文，能不能让他一步到位？

name: Search
title: Search
description: Search is a feature that uses a person's keywords to find potentially relevant results in a collection. · After someone enters “budget,” projects whose name, description, or tags contain related words can appear; a help center can find articles by problem keywords too. Search answers what someone is looking for, usually ranking results by match or another rule. It does not merely narrow everything by a fixed condition. Know first Input List
zhDescription: 搜索是根据用户输入的关键词，从内容集合中找出可能相关结果的功能。 · 例如用户输入“预算”后，项目名称、描述或标签中包含相关词的项目出现在结果里；帮助中心也可按问题关键词找文章。它回答“我要找什么”，结果通常按匹配程度或其他规则排序，不是用固定条件缩小全部内容。 先知道 输入框 Input 列表 List
quote: Add search above the project list so a name or keyword quickly finds potentially relevant projects.
zhQuote: 在项目列表顶部加搜索，输入名称或关键词后快速找到可能相关的项目。

name: Hero
title: Hero
description: Use the opening area to explain the page's main point and next step · The Hero usually sits directly below the Header or Navbar. It may combine a headline, supporting copy, a primary action, and a product visual, but there is no required component checklist. What matters is that these elements explain the page's main value together. Customer logos, feature lists, and pricing are normally separate sections even when they appear nearby.
zhDescription: 网页开头用来说明页面重点并引导下一步的主要区域 · Hero 通常紧接在 Header 或 Navbar 下面。它可以由标题、补充说明、主要行动和产品画面组成，但没有固定组件清单；真正要看的是这些内容是否共同说明当前页面最重要的价值。客户标志、功能列表和定价通常属于后续区块，不因为靠近首屏就都算 Hero。
quote: The top of the site feels empty. Give it a big image and headline so people immediately get what we do.
zhQuote: 网站最上面那块太空了，想要大图加大字那种，一眼知道我们是干嘛的。

name: CTA
title: CTA
description: Tell visitors the next action you want them to take · A call to action turns the page's message into a concrete next step, such as Start free, Book a demo, or Download. The wording should describe the result, and the action should appear after enough context to make the choice reasonable.
zhDescription: CTA 是引导用户执行注册、试用或购买等关键动作的核心入口。 · CTA 可以是按钮、链接或简短表单。产品页可用“开始免费试用”直接说明行动和结果；一个视觉区域通常突出一个主目标，长页面可按阅读阶段重复或调整。不要使用“提交”“点击这里”等看不出结果的文字。
quote: Add a prominent spot on the page that makes people want to click 'Start free trial.'
zhQuote: 想在页面里放个显眼的地方，让人看了就想点“免费试用”。

name: Customer Testimonial
title: Customer Testimonial
description: Use real customer words to show a concrete experience · A customer quote can explain what changed for a real user in language that feels more specific than product claims. Keep the wording accurate, identify the source with permission, and choose quotes that add evidence rather than generic praise.
zhDescription: 真实用户表达的使用体验、诉求与评价原话，用于校准产品需求与设计方向。 · 用户原声应保留真实表达，并交代使用场景、取得方式和可核实来源。原话含有数字时，还要说明统计范围与时间；展示头像、公司或职位前须取得授权，无法公开身份时可以匿名并说明原因。
quote: Add a few real customer quotes instead of just saying we're great.
zhQuote: 光自己夸不够，放几条真实用户说的话更有说服力。

name: Header
title: Header
description: The top section of a page that introduces the site or page and often contains navigation · A Header usually holds the brand and the paths people need first, such as main navigation, search, or account access. It is broader than a Navbar, which is specifically the navigation portion.
zhDescription: 网页顶部集中放置品牌、导航、搜索和账号入口的区域 · 例如，产品官网的页头可以放 Logo、顶部导航栏、搜索和登录。顶部导航栏只是其中负责带用户去不同页面的部分；在简单页面里，两者可能看起来是同一行。
quote: How should the top bar be laid out? It needs to fit the logo, navigation, and sign-in button.
zhQuote: 最顶上那条怎么排？logo、导航、登录按钮都得塞进去。

name: Logo
title: Logo
description: A brand mark used to identify an organization, product, or service · A Logo can appear in a website header, mobile navigation, on a dark surface, or in promotional material through different variants, while its core identity stays consistent. It helps people recognize the brand; it does not own page navigation or browser-system icons. Know first Header Image
zhDescription: 用来识别组织、产品或服务的品牌标志 · Logo 可以在官网页头、移动导航、深色背景或宣传材料中以不同变体出现，但核心形状和身份应保持一致。它负责让人认出品牌，不负责承担页面导航结构或浏览器系统图标的工作。 先知道 页头 Header 图片 Image
quote: Preserve the brand's core shape, choose Logo variants for desktop, mobile, and dark backgrounds, and verify each context with screenshots.
zhQuote: 保持品牌核心形状，为桌面、移动和深色背景选择合适的 Logo 变体，分别截图验收。

name: Navbar
title: Navbar
description: Keep the brand, main destinations, and key action easy to reach · A website navbar helps visitors understand where they can go and how to return home. Keep the number of primary links manageable, show the current section when useful, and adapt the menu for smaller screens without hiding essential paths.
zhDescription: 顶部导航栏是网页页头中提供主要页面入口和当前位置提示的导航区域 · 官网可以在导航栏放品牌入口、产品、价格和登录等核心链接，并为当前页面加清楚高亮。入口过多时应分组或收进菜单；移动端菜单必须能打开、关闭并用键盘操作，保存、删除等当前页动作不应伪装成主要导航。
quote: Put the main sections in the top navigation, and make it clear which page I'm on.
zhQuote: 顶上的导航要把主要栏目都放进去，我在哪个页面得看得出来。

name: Footer
title: Footer
description: End the page with useful links, identity, and required information · A footer gives visitors another route to important pages and carries company details, legal links, contact information, or a final action. Organize links into clear groups and keep it useful rather than turning it into a second copy of the entire site.
zhDescription: 页脚是网页底部集中放置补充链接、版权和联系方式的页面区域 · 隐私政策、服务条款、联系方式和社交账号常放在 Footer，并按用途分组。它适合补充入口；不要把顶部已经清楚展示的所有链接原样重复，也不能把用户必须在提交前看到的关键规则只放在页脚。
quote: We need a footer with a few links and the copyright information.
zhQuote: 页面最底下那块也得有，放点链接和版权信息。

name: FAQ
title: FAQ
description: Answer common questions before visitors need to ask · A FAQ section handles repeated questions about price, setup, policy, or fit. Write questions in the visitor's language and answer them directly. If the same question needs a long explanation, link to a full guide instead of hiding an article inside an accordion.
zhDescription: 常见问题是集中回答用户反复提出的疑问及其答案的内容区块 · 退款条件、套餐限制和数据安全等重复问题可整理为 FAQ，答案第一句先给结论，再说明必要条件。问题应来自真实搜索、客服或访谈记录；内容很多或需要持续检索时，应建设帮助中心，不能把所有说明塞进一页。
quote: Collect the questions people ask most often into a Q&A section at the bottom of the page.
zhQuote: 把用户最常问的问题整理成一问一答，放在页尾。

name: Pricing
title: Pricing
description: Help visitors compare plans, cost, and included value · A pricing section should make plan differences, billing periods, limits, and extra fees understandable. Highlight a recommended option only when the reason is clear. Visitors need enough detail to choose without opening several hidden notes.
zhDescription: 定价区是把多个套餐的价格、权益和适用对象并列比较的页面区块 · 定价区让用户比较不同方案适合谁、包含哪些权益以及实际要付多少。套餐数量应反映真实需求差异，并明确币种、计费周期、本次应付总额、税费、试用和取消规则；推荐标记必须有适用条件或数据依据，也不要设置缺乏真实价值、只用于价格锚定的虚高档位。
quote: Show three plans side by side and mark the middle one as 'Most popular.'
zhQuote: 做三档套餐并排对比，中间那档标个“最受欢迎”。

name: Social Proof
title: Social Proof
description: Support a product claim with evidence from real use · Social proof can include customer logos, measured results, reviews, certifications, or case studies. Choose evidence that supports the claim next to it and state the source or context. A wall of unverified logos is weaker than one relevant, specific example.
zhDescription: 通过展示他人使用证据与评价来降低信任成本、辅助用户决策的设计证明。 · 客户 Logo、经授权的案例、可说明口径的用户数量和评分都可作为社会证明。它帮助访客判断是否有人实际使用；来源、统计口径和授权必须真实清楚，不能编造客户、数字或评价。
quote: Add a row of customer logos and a line that says more than 100,000 teams use us.
zhQuote: 放一排合作客户的 logo，再加一句“10 万+ 团队在用”。

name: Top Nav
title: Top Nav
description: Place the main navigation across the top of the page · A top-navigation layout works when a product has a small number of primary sections and needs wide content space below. Keep labels short, show the current section, and decide how the navigation collapses on narrow screens. Know first Navbar Sticky
zhDescription: 顶部导航布局是一种把主要导航放在页面上方、下方安排内容区域的页面结构 · 官网、社区和内容网站常把品牌、核心入口和主操作放进顶栏，下方展示居中或通栏内容。长页面可让导航配合 吸顶 Sticky 保持可见；移动端应把过多入口收进清楚、可关闭的菜单，不能只是把文字挤小。 先知道 顶部导航栏 Navbar 吸顶 Sticky
quote: Use the classic layout: a navigation bar on top and all the content below it.
zhQuote: 最经典那种结构：上面一条导航，下面全是内容。

name: Sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Keep navigation in a vertical column beside the content · A sidebar suits products with many sections, grouped tools, or workspaces that users switch between often. Give the content enough room and provide a compact or temporary version on smaller screens. Do not make every nested level visible at once. Know first Menu
zhDescription: 侧栏布局是一种把层级导航放在页面一侧、把主要任务内容放在另一侧的页面结构 · 后台和工具产品常在左侧用侧栏组织项目、设置或功能入口，右侧留给当前工作区。需要明确侧栏宽度、折叠方式和内容区最小宽度；窄屏通常改成可开关的抽屉，并提供遮罩、关闭入口和正确的键盘焦点。 先知道 导航菜单 Menu
quote: Put the feature menu in a left sidebar and show the content in a big area on the right, like an admin dashboard.
zhQuote: 左边一列功能菜单，右边大块区域显示内容，像后台那样。

name: Single Page
title: Single Page
description: Arrange a complete story in sections down one scrolling page · A single-page layout guides visitors through a sequence such as value, proof, features, pricing, and action. It works when the story has one main goal. Clear sections and anchor navigation help, but important content should not depend on scroll effects. Know first Navbar Hero CTA Footer
zhDescription: 单页滚动布局是指将相关内容按阅读顺序组织在同一长页面中的布局方式。 · 活动页或产品介绍常在一页中依次呈现问题、价值、证据和 CTA 。页面很长时应提供清楚章节、页内跳转和返回路径；内容若分别服务不同任务，就应拆成多个页面，而不是强迫用户一直滚动。 先知道 顶部导航栏 Navbar 首屏 Hero CTA 页脚 Footer
quote: Put everything on one long page so people can just scroll through it.
zhQuote: 所有内容放在一个长页面里，往下滚就能看完。

name: Doc Layout
title: Doc Layout
description: Combine section navigation, article content, and an on-page outline · A documentation layout often uses a left navigation for pages, a readable center column for the article, and a right outline for headings. Keep each column's job distinct and collapse secondary navigation on small screens. Know first Sidebar Anchor
zhDescription: 文档三栏布局是一种同时显示整站目录、正文内容和本页大纲的页面结构 · 技术文档常用左侧目录帮助跳转，中间正文承担阅读，右侧大纲标记当前章节。屏幕变窄时可先收起右侧大纲，再把整站目录放进可打开的侧栏；不要在窄屏硬保留三栏，导致正文无法阅读。 先知道 左侧栏布局 Sidebar 锚点 Anchor
quote: Lay this out like documentation: navigation on the left, the article in the middle, and this page's outline on the right.
zhQuote: 像技术文档那样：左边目录、中间正文、右边本页大纲。

name: Card Grid
title: Card Grid
description: Arrange similar cards in a responsive grid · A card grid helps people browse products, templates, articles, or projects with a shared visual structure. Define how columns change with width, keep card content comparable, and avoid forcing every card to the same height when content differs greatly. Know first Card Grid
zhDescription: 卡片网格布局是一种用规则行列排列同类卡片，并随可用宽度换行的页面结构 · 作品、商品和模板列表可将每个项目做成结构相近的 卡片 Card ，再用 Grid 自动排布。列数和最小卡片宽度要按标题、图片和操作仍能显示来决定；内容差异很大时，不必强求所有卡片完全等高。 先知道 卡片 Card 网格布局 Grid
quote: Show the content as cards in a grid, with more columns on wide screens and wrapping on narrow ones.
zhQuote: 内容做成一排排卡片，宽了多放几列，窄了自动换行。

name: Centered Column
title: Centered Column
description: Keep one narrow content column centered on the page · A centered column focuses attention on reading or one simple task such as signing in, composing a post, or changing settings. Set a comfortable maximum width and keep supporting actions nearby. It is not suitable for dense dashboards that need side-by-side comparison.
zhDescription: 居中窄栏布局是一种限制内容栏宽度并将其置于页面中央的页面结构 · 文章阅读、登录和设置页面可用居中栏减少视线横向移动，让主任务更集中。具体宽度要根据中文或英文、字号和设备测试；需要品牌说明、帮助入口或多步流程时，可以保留这些必要上下文，不能把所有页面机械压成窄栏。
quote: Keep the content in a narrow column with space on both sides instead of stretching it across the whole screen, like a blog.
zhQuote: 内容别铺满全屏，中间窄窄一条、两边留白，像博客那样。

name: Masonry
title: Masonry
description: Pack cards of different heights into equal-width columns · On galleries and inspiration feeds, images vary in height; masonry lets each new card fill the shortest gap so no full row is left blank. The trade-off is that reading order runs down columns instead of across rows, and once the layout collapses to a single column on phones, the content order needs its own acceptance check. Know first Card Grid
zhDescription: 瀑布流是一种保持列对齐、让不同高度的卡片依次补进当前最短列的页面布局 · 作品墙和灵感流里的图片高度各不相同，瀑布流让新卡片补进最短的空隙，页面不会出现整行留白。代价是阅读顺序按列推进而不是按行；手机端收成单列后，内容顺序需要单独验收。 先知道 卡片 Card 网格布局 Grid
quote: The images are all different heights—do not crop them into one size, just let new ones tuck under the short ones.
zhQuote: 图片高矮不一样，别硬裁成一样高，矮的下面自动补上新的就行。

name: Split-screen
title: Split-screen
description: Give two parallel tasks two near-equal halves of one view · Login pages often put the brand story on the left half and the form on the right; entry pages can give personal and enterprise plans one half each. It only counts as split-screen when both sides truly run parallel tasks; on phones a side-by-side split is unreadable, so stack the areas and decide yourself which one comes first. Know first Responsive Design
zhDescription: 分屏布局是一种把首屏分成两个权重接近的区域、各自承载一个并列任务或入口的页面结构 · 登录页常用左半屏讲品牌、右半屏放表单，入口页也会让个人版和企业版各占一半。成立的条件是两边任务真的并列；手机上左右分屏不可读，要改成上下排列，并由你先决定哪块在前。 先知道 响应式设计 Responsive Design
quote: Split the home page in half—brand intro on the left, login on the right—and stack them on phones.
zhQuote: 首页左右各一半，左边放品牌介绍，右边直接登录，手机上改成上下。

name: Responsive Design
title: Responsive Design
description: Responsive design is the practice of adapting one interface's layout and interaction to available space and device capabilities. · At 1440px, a site may show three card columns and full navigation; at 390px, it can use one column, larger touch targets, and collapsed secondary navigation. Breakpoints and media queries are common tools. The goal is not proportional desktop shrinkage but readable, tappable, completable tasks. Know first Flex Grid
zhDescription: 响应式设计是让同一界面根据可用空间和设备能力调整布局与交互的设计方法。 · 例如 1440px 宽度显示三列卡片和完整导航，390px 宽度改为一列、放大触控目标并折叠次要导航。断点和媒体查询是常见实现手段；目标不是把桌面页面等比例缩小，而是让任务仍可读、可点、可完成。 先知道 弹性布局 Flex 网格布局 Grid
quote: At mobile width, change three columns to one while keeping the desktop navigation and card layout intact.
zhQuote: 手机宽度下把三列改成一列，桌面的导航和卡片布局保持不变。

name: Space
title: Space
description: Use empty space to show which things belong together · Related items should sit close together, while separate groups need more room between them. That empty room is spacing. A product usually defines a small spacing scale so pages follow a visible rhythm instead of using a new value each time.
zhDescription: 间距是用内容之间的留白表达关联和分组关系的布局规则 · 表单标签应靠近对应输入框，两个不同设置组之间则留出更大空白。项目应复用固定间距档位，不要为每个位置任意填写数值。
quote: Everything feels piled together. Adjust the spacing so related things stay close and separate things have room.
zhQuote: 元素都堆在一起了，帮我把留白调舒服点：相关的靠近，不相关的分开。

name: Margin
title: Margin
description: Create space outside an element · Margin controls the space between an element and the things around it. It helps separate groups, but it does not add room inside a box. Use a shared spacing scale and let the parent layout handle repeated gaps when possible. Know first Space
zhDescription: 元素边框外侧与其他相邻元素之间的外侧间隔距离。 · 两张卡片之间或标题与正文之间可用 margin 留空。普通块级兄弟的上下 margin 在特定文档流中可能合并；Flex、Grid 子项不会这样合并，父容器的边框或内边距也会影响父子外边距合并。 先知道 间距 Space
quote: This block is too close to the one next to it. Add a little more space between them.
zhQuote: 这个块和旁边那个太贴了，把它们之间撑开一点。

name: Padding
title: Padding
description: Create space between a box and its content · Padding adds room inside an element, between its border and its content. It affects the visible size and click area of buttons, cards, and panels. Keep repeated components on the same spacing scale so they feel related. Know first Space
zhDescription: 元素内容区域与边框之间的内侧留白间距。 · 按钮文字四周、输入框内容与边框之间的空间通常用 padding 设置，它会带着元素的背景色并计入元素的可见尺寸。需要把组件彼此拉开时用 外边距 Margin ；不要用外边距假装按钮内部留白，否则点击区域不会跟着变大。 先知道 间距 Space
quote: The text is pressed right against the edge of the box. Add some breathing room inside it.
zhQuote: 字都顶到盒子边上了，让内容和边框之间留点空。

name: Flex
title: Flex
description: Arrange items along one row or one column · Flexbox lays items out on a single main axis and handles alignment, spacing, wrapping, and flexible size. It is a good fit for toolbars, form rows, and card content. Use Grid when both rows and columns need a planned structure. Know first Space
zhDescription: 沿一维主轴方向自动计算并分配子元素尺寸、对齐与间隙的弹性布局系统。 · 导航链接横排、按钮组居中或图标与文字并排时，可在父元素上设置 display: flex。justify-content 控制主轴分布，align-items 控制交叉轴对齐；它适合一行或一列的关系，需要同时规划多行和多列时应先考虑 网格布局 Grid 。 先知道 间距 Space
quote: Put these buttons in one row with even spacing and center them vertically.
zhQuote: 把这几个按钮排成一行，间距均匀，还能垂直居中。

name: Grid
title: Grid
description: Plan rows and columns as one layout system · CSS Grid controls two-dimensional layouts where rows and columns work together. It suits galleries, dashboards, and page regions. Let columns adapt to available space instead of copying one fixed desktop grid onto every screen. Know first Space
zhDescription: 基于二维行与列网格定位并分配元素位置与占比的二维排版系统。 · 商品或模板列表需要随屏幕宽度自动换列时，可在父元素上定义 grid，再用 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)) 作为起点。最小宽度必须按标题、图片和操作仍能看清来调整；只有一条轴的简单排列用 弹性布局 Flex 往往更直接。 先知道 间距 Space
quote: Arrange these cards in a clean grid that switches to two columns on narrower screens.
zhQuote: 这些卡片排成整齐的格子，屏幕窄了自动变成两列。

name: Z-Index
title: Z-Index
description: Control which overlapping layer appears on top · Z-index affects the stacking order of positioned elements inside a stacking context. A larger number does not always escape its parent. Define a short layer scale for content, sticky UI, menus, overlays, and dialogs instead of solving each overlap with a larger random number. Know first Position
zhDescription: 定位元素在垂直屏幕轴向上的层叠与覆盖优先级规则。 · 例如，下拉菜单被横幅挡住时，要同时检查菜单和横幅所在的父级；只把 z-index 改成 99999，也可能仍然无效。项目里应使用少量固定层级，避免数字越堆越乱。 先知道 定位 Position
quote: This dialog is getting covered by other content. Make sure it stays on top.
zhQuote: 那个弹窗被别的内容挡住了，让它显示在最上面。

name: Sticky
title: Sticky
description: Keep an element visible after scrolling reaches it · Sticky positioning lets a header, table heading, or section navigation follow the viewport within its container. It needs a defined offset and enough room to move. Test parent overflow and small screens, because both can change or block sticky behavior. Know first Position
zhDescription: 吸顶是一种让元素先按正常位置排列、滚动到指定边界后暂时固定显示的 CSS 定位方式 · position: sticky 让元素平时留在文档流，滚到 top 或 bottom 等阈值后暂时吸附。它受最近滚动祖先和包含块边界限制；祖先的 overflow 可能改变它跟随的滚动容器，容器没有足够滚动距离时也看不到效果。使用时还要设置相应偏移值。 先知道 定位 Position
quote: Keep the navigation pinned to the top while people scroll down.
zhQuote: 往下滚的时候，让导航栏一直钉在页面顶部。

name: Position
title: Position
description: Place an element in normal flow, against a parent, or against the viewport · CSS position decides how an element is placed and whether offsets such as top and left apply. Relative often creates a reference for an absolutely positioned child; fixed follows the viewport; sticky moves only within its scrolling context. Choose the mode from the relationship you need.
zhDescription: 定位是通过 CSS position 和偏移量决定元素是否脱离文档流及其参照位置的布局规则 · 卡片角标常让父元素 relative、子元素 absolute；悬浮工具栏可用 fixed，滚动后固定的表头可用 sticky。普通内容优先使用正常布局；absolute、fixed 的参照物会受包含块等规则影响，元素偏位时应检查父级而不是不断加偏移值。
quote: Pin this little icon to the top-right corner of the card so the rest of the layout doesn't affect it.
zhQuote: 把这个小图标固定在卡片右上角，别的内容怎么排都不影响。

name: Centering
title: Centering
description: Align an element to the middle of the available space · Centering may mean horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, or both. Text can use text alignment, a fixed-width block can use automatic margins, and flexible layouts can use Flex or Grid . Start by identifying what should be centered inside which container. Know first Flex Grid
zhDescription: 居中是把文字、元素或一组内容在容器的水平、垂直或两条轴上对齐到中间的布局方式 · 按钮组可用 弹性布局 Flex 居中，网格单元可用 网格布局 Grid 的 place-items。文字和定宽块有各自做法；absolute 加 transform 适合浮层，不应作为普通内容的默认方案。 先知道 弹性布局 Flex 网格布局 Grid
quote: Can you center this box both horizontally and vertically? Why is that always so hard?
zhQuote: 这个框帮我水平垂直都居中——怎么就那么难？

name: Box Model
title: Box Model
description: The box model is the browser's rule for the space used by an element's content, padding, border, and margin. · A card with 320px of content width can occupy more after horizontal padding and a border, leaving two columns unable to fit. A button's hit area is affected by these layers too. The box model explains size calculation, not whether excess content should show, clip, or scroll. Know first HTML
zhDescription: 由内容、内边距、边框和外边距构成的网页元素几何尺寸与排版占位规则。 · 例如卡片内容宽 320px，再加左右内边距和边框，实际占用宽度可能更大，导致两列排不下；按钮的可点击区域也受这些层次影响。它解释尺寸怎样算，不负责内容超出后该显示、裁切还是滚动。 先知道 HTML
quote: This card is set to 320px. Why does adding padding make it overflow its container?
zhQuote: 这个卡片明明设为 320px，为什么加了内边距后反而挤出容器？

name: Overflow
title: Overflow
description: Overflow is the rule for how the browser shows, clips, or scrolls content that exceeds a container's available space. · When a card has a fixed height, longer content can cross its bottom edge. If an ancestor uses overflow: hidden , the bottom description and action disappear. Overflow can be horizontal or vertical. It answers what happens after content no longer fits and should not hide a layout that needs reworking. Know first Box Model
zhDescription: 内容尺寸超出容器可见区域时的显示、裁剪或滚动控制规则。 · 例如卡片设置固定高度后，较长内容可能越过底边；若祖先使用 overflow: hidden ，超出部分会被直接裁切而不可见。Overflow 可以发生在横向或纵向，它处理“放不下以后怎么办”，不是用来掩盖本应重新排版的布局问题。 先知道 盒模型 Box Model
quote: The bottom of this card is hidden. Check whether it is vertical overflow and keep the action from being clipped.
zhQuote: 这张卡片的内容底部被遮住了，帮我检查是不是纵向溢出，别让按钮被裁掉。

name: Typography
title: Typography
description: Use text size and style to show what matters first · Typography separates headings, body text, and supporting information through size, line height, weight, and color. Define a small set of reusable text roles, then adapt them for different screens so readers can find the main point and follow the content.
zhDescription: 排版是指页面中文字的字号、字重、行距与层级规范，帮助读者快速识别标题、正文与辅助信息。 · 例如在设置页，分组标题应比选项说明更醒目，正文的行与行之间也要留够距离。必须阅读的提醒不能只用很小、很浅的字显示，否则很容易被忽略。
quote: All the text on this page runs together—separate the headings, body copy, and notes so the important stuff stands out.
zhQuote: 这页文字全糊在一起了，帮我分出标题、正文和提示，一眼能看出重点。

name: Serif & Sans
title: Serif & Sans
description: Choose letterforms that match the content and reading task · Serif typefaces have finishing strokes; sans-serif typefaces do not. Neither is automatically more readable or modern. Choose from the product's tone, text length, language support, and screen sizes, then test real headings and paragraphs.
zhDescription: 衬线与非衬线是按笔画末端是否带有装饰来区分的两类字体风格 · Georgia 和中文宋体属于常见衬线字体，系统黑体属于常见非衬线字体；两类都可用于标题或正文。选择时要测试中文和西文覆盖、正文可读性、品牌需求与加载性能，不能只凭“衬线优雅、非衬线现代”的固定印象。
quote: Use a serif font with a little character for the headings, then keep the body text clean and simple.
zhQuote: 标题想要那种笔画带小装饰的字体，正文用干净点的。

name: Text Truncate
title: Text Truncate
description: Shorten text that cannot fit in the available space · Text truncation keeps a title or filename from breaking a compact layout, usually with an ellipsis. It hides information, so provide the full value when people may need it. Decide whether the limit is one line, several lines, or a fixed character count. Know first Typography
zhDescription: 文本截断是一种在有限空间内隐藏超出文字，并用省略号提示内容未显示完整的显示方式 · 商品卡片标题或表格单元格太长时，可将文本截断并提供完整查看方式。价格、错误提示等关键信息应优先换行，不要只靠 文字提示 Tooltip 。 先知道 排版 Typography
quote: If a title is too long, cut it off and show an ellipsis at the end.
zhQuote: 标题太长就把后面的藏起来，结尾显示省略号。

name: Divider
title: Divider
description: Use a line to separate two different groups of content · A divider shows that one group has ended and another has begun. It works between list sections, menu groups, and information blocks. If spacing already makes the relationship clear, another line will only make the page feel fragmented.
zhDescription: 分割线是用细线分开相邻内容分组的视觉元素 · 订单摘要与收货地址之间可用分割线提示信息组已经变化。留白足以分组时不必加线，避免把页面切成许多碎块。
quote: These two sections feel cramped. Add a subtle line between them.
zhQuote: 上下两块内容太挤了，中间加一条淡淡的线隔开。

name: Border Radius
title: Border Radius
description: Round the corners of a box · Border radius changes sharp corners into rounded ones and helps set the visual tone of controls, cards, and images. Define a small set of radius values and use them consistently. A pill shape works only when the height and content support it.
zhDescription: 控制元素外框边角弧度与圆角曲率的外观样式属性。 · 卡片、按钮和头像常用 border-radius 控制四个角的弧度；正方形设为 50% 可得到圆形，长条设为很大的值可得到胶囊形。项目里应建立少量可复用的圆角档位，避免任意混用数值；圆角会影响观感，但“越圆越亲和”只是设计经验。
quote: Round the sharp corners on these cards a bit so they feel softer.
zhQuote: 把卡片的尖角磨圆一点，看着柔和些。

name: Shadow
title: Shadow
description: Use light and depth to separate overlapping surfaces · A shadow can show that a menu, dialog, or card sits above another surface. It should support a real layer relationship, not decorate every box. A small, consistent shadow scale is easier to read than many unrelated effects.
zhDescription: 模拟光影投射效果以构建界面元素悬浮感与视觉层级深度的样式属性。 · 弹窗、浮动菜单和需要与背景分开的卡片可以用 box-shadow；前两个值控制 x / y 偏移，后面可设置模糊、扩散和颜色。阴影只能辅助表达层级，浅色界面应保持轻微且方向一致；给每张卡片都加重阴影会让页面显得杂乱。
quote: Add a light shadow under the card so it feels like it's floating above the page.
zhQuote: 给卡片下面加一层淡淡的投影，让它像浮在页面上。

name: Opacity
title: Opacity
description: Make an element and its contents more transparent · Opacity changes the transparency of an entire element, including its children. It can soften secondary or disabled content, but low opacity also reduces text contrast. Use a transparent color when only the background should fade.
zhDescription: 透明度是通过 opacity 同时降低元素及其全部子内容可见程度的 CSS 属性 · 淡入提示框或弱化非当前内容时可设置 opacity。只想让背景半透明应改用 rgba；opacity: 0 的元素仍可能占位置或被点击，隐藏交互还需处理焦点。
quote: This image is stealing too much attention. Make it a little transparent.
zhQuote: 这张图太抢戏了，把它调得半透明一点。

name: Gradient
title: Gradient
description: Blend colors gradually across an area · A gradient moves smoothly between two or more colors. It can add depth, direction, or emphasis to a background and illustration. Keep text contrast stable across the whole blend, and use a flat color when the gradient adds no meaning.
zhDescription: 渐变是一种让两个或多个颜色在指定方向或范围内连续过渡的视觉效果 · 线性渐变适合形成方向感，径向渐变可把注意力聚到一个区域，例如产品页的背景光晕。颜色感受会随明度、面积和品牌而变化；文字覆盖在渐变上时要检查整段区域的对比度，并准备可读的纯色回退。
quote: Instead of a solid background, let the color fade from blue into purple.
zhQuote: 背景别用纯色，让颜色从蓝慢慢过渡到紫。

name: Corner Feel
title: Corner Feel
description: Use corner shape to support the product's visual tone · Sharp, softly rounded, and pill-shaped corners can make a page feel different, but the effect comes from consistent use across the system. Choose a small radius scale that fits control sizes and content instead of rounding every object the same way.
zhDescription: 圆角的气质是指不同圆角大小在界面中带来的视觉感受和一致性规则 · 较小圆角常显得克制，较大圆角常显得柔和，可为按钮、卡片和输入框建立少量 圆角 Border Radius 档位。它们是设计经验，不是固定语义；相同角色应保持一致，具体数值仍要结合组件尺寸、品牌和场景测试。
quote: Make the corner rounding consistent across the site—some parts are square and some are round.
zhQuote: 全站的圆角统一一下，别有的方有的圆，看着乱。

name: Backdrop Blur
title: Backdrop Blur
description: Blur the content behind a translucent surface · Backdrop blur creates a frosted-glass effect by blurring what is behind a partly transparent element.
