It can separate a floating header or overlay while keeping context visible. Always provide enough background color and contrast, because blur support and source imagery vary. Know first Opacity
zhDescription: 毛玻璃是一种通过模糊元素背后画面，让半透明界面层与背景区分开的视觉效果 · 用 backdrop-filter: blur() 可以让悬浮导航或弹窗保留背景轮廓，同时仍与页面内容分开。元素背景必须有透明度才能看见模糊；它可能增加渲染开销并降低文字对比度，因此不要把它铺在大段正文上，还要准备不支持该属性时仍清楚可读的纯色背景。 先知道 透明度 Opacity
quote: Make the navigation bar translucent so the content behind it blurs as it scrolls past.
zhQuote: 导航栏做成半透明的，后面的内容滚过去时模模糊糊。

name: Dark Mode
title: Dark Mode
description: Dark mode is a switchable dark interface theme state, not merely a page with a black background. · When someone chooses dark mode or their system prefers it, backgrounds, text, borders, buttons, charts, and focus states need coordinated, sufficiently contrasting values. It serves different environments and preferences. A single dark poster or visual style is not automatically a switchable theme. Know first State Design Token
zhDescription: 深色模式是一套可切换的深色界面主题状态，而不只是把页面背景涂黑。 · 例如用户选择深色模式或系统偏好深色时，页面的背景、文字、边框、按钮、图表和聚焦状态都换成协调且足够对比的值。它服务于不同环境和偏好；一张黑色海报或深色视觉风格并不自动构成可切换主题。 先知道 状态 State 设计令牌 Design Token
quote: Add real dark mode: text, borders, charts, and code blocks must switch with the page.
zhQuote: 给产品加真正的深色模式，文字、边框、图表和代码块都要跟着切换。

name: Design Token
title: Design Token
description: A design token is a named variable that centrally stores and reuses design values such as color, spacing, and typography. · A primary button color can be named color.brand.primary and a common gap space.16 ; components reference those names rather than each hard-coding a color or pixel value. Tokens help a shared rule stay consistent across a site, component library, or other interfaces when themes or brands change. They are not a synonym for every CSS variable and do not replace the design decision itself. Know first Space Border Radius
zhDescription: 设计令牌是集中命名和复用颜色、间距、字体等设计值的变量。 · 例如把主按钮颜色命名为 color.brand.primary 、常用间距命名为 space.16 ，组件引用名称而不是各自硬写色值和像素。改主题或统一调整时，令牌能让同一规则在网页、组件库或其他界面保持一致；它不是任意 CSS 变量的别名，也不替代设计决定本身。 先知道 间距 Space 圆角 Border Radius
quote: Organize the main color, spacing, and radius as design tokens instead of repeating values in every component.
zhQuote: 把主色、间距和圆角整理成设计令牌，别在每个组件里重复写一组数值。

name: Contrast
title: Contrast
description: Contrast is the brightness difference between text and background—big enough to read; light gray on light gray is not. · Light gray body text on a gray background almost vanishes when you squint—that is insufficient contrast. To turn "hard to read" into a checkable requirement, tell the AI "keep body text at 4.5:1 contrast against the background," the common industry threshold. Dark mode fails here most often: black backgrounds paired with the old gray look layered but sit below the line. Know first Dark Mode
zhDescription: 对比度是指文字与背景之间的明暗反差，直接决定内容是否清晰可辨。 · 灰底页面上放一段浅灰说明文字，眯起眼看几乎消失——这就是对比度不足。想让「看不清」变成可检查的要求，就跟 AI 说「正文和背景的对比度至少 4.5:1」，这是行业通用门槛，辅助性文字也建议 3:1 以上。深色模式翻车多因为它：黑底直接配灰字，看起来有层次，实际已经低于门槛。 先知道 深色模式 Dark Mode
quote: That gray helper text on the page strains my eyes—make it readable.
zhQuote: 页面上那段灰色说明文字太费眼了，帮我调清楚一点。

name: Visual Hierarchy
title: Visual Hierarchy
description: Visual hierarchy makes visitors read the page in your intended order—headline first, description next, button last. · Where the eye lands first on a page is not random: size, color, and position steer it. The headline is biggest and boldest so it lands first; the description sits one shade lighter so it reads second; the button carries a fill so it pops last. A page that "looks messy" usually has everything equally large and equally heavy, leaving the eye nowhere to start. Know first Typography
zhDescription: 视觉层级是让访客按你想要的顺序看页面——先看主标题，再看说明，最后注意到按钮。 · 打开一个页面，视线最先落在哪里、接着看什么，不是访客随机决定的，是字号、颜色、位置共同引导的。标题最大最粗所以先被看到，说明浅一档所以第二眼才读，按钮有底色所以最后跳出来。页面「看起来乱」多半不是内容问题，是所有东西一样大、一样重，眼睛不知道从哪开始。 先知道 排版 Typography
quote: This page feels chaotic—everything is the same size. Layer it: headline dominant, description secondary, button most visible.
zhQuote: 这个页面看起来特别乱，什么都一样大。帮我排个主次：主标题最突出，说明次要一点，按钮最显眼。

name: Prefers Reduced Motion
title: Prefers Reduced Motion
description: Reading the system's reduce motion setting and disabling or reducing animation accordingly · When visitors enable their system's reduced-motion preference, a page can query it and reduce, stop, or replace nonessential animation, such as replacing a large movement with a static state. Keep loading and status information clear; a spinning icon can be replaced with text or progress. Toggle the system setting to check that the page responds. Know first Animation
zhDescription: 读取用户的系统动效偏好，并减少或替换非必要的动态效果 · 访客开启系统的“减少动态效果”后，网页可以查询这项偏好，并减少、停止或替换非必要动画，例如把大幅位移改为静态状态。页面仍要清楚传达加载和状态变化；旋转图标可以换成文字或进度信息，不必保留旋转本身。切换系统设置后检查页面是否随之变化。 先知道 动画 Animation
quote: Someone has the system's reduce motion setting on and my page animations still run. Should I handle it?
zhQuote: 有人开了系统减少动效，我的页面动画还在动，要处理吗？

name: Transition
title: Transition
description: Smooth the change between two visual states · A transition animates a CSS property when its value changes, such as color on hover or a panel opening. Use it to clarify cause and effect, keep the duration short, and respect reduced-motion preferences. Not every property animates smoothly or cheaply. Know first Hover Active
zhDescription: 控制 CSS 属性在不同状态转换过程中产生平滑渐变的动画机制。 · 按钮悬停变色、开关滑块移动等只有起点和终点的变化适合 transition。应明确变化属性、时长和 缓动 Easing ；不要默认写 transition: all，宽高等可能触发布局计算的属性也要谨慎，并为减少动态效果的用户降低非必要运动。 先知道 悬停 Hover 按下 Active
quote: The button color changes too abruptly. Can it ease into the new color?
zhQuote: 按钮变色太突兀了，能不能慢慢变过去？

name: Animation
title: Animation
description: Run a planned sequence of visual changes · Animation can repeat, play through keyframes, or express a larger state change that a simple transition cannot. Use it to explain progress or spatial relationships, not just to keep the screen moving. Provide a reduced-motion alternative when movement is substantial. Know first Transition
zhDescription: 动画是一种用 @keyframes 定义多个阶段，并控制其播放方式的 CSS 动效 · 加载指示、分步入场等连续变化可用 animation；简单的悬停和选中反馈通常用 过渡 Transition 就够了。循环和大幅移动容易干扰阅读，必须尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；结束后是否停在最后一帧也应由实际界面状态决定。 先知道 过渡 Transition
quote: Make this icon loop through a subtle motion, like gently floating up and down.
zhQuote: 让这个图标一直循环动，比如轻轻上下浮动。

name: Easing
title: Easing
description: Control how motion speeds up and slows down · Easing changes the pace of a transition or animation over time. Ease-out often feels responsive for an element entering, while ease-in can suit an element leaving. Choose a small motion set and judge it in the real interaction, not from curve names alone. Know first Transition
zhDescription: 缓动是规定动画在持续时间内如何加速和减速的速度曲线 · 进度条和持续旋转常用 linear，界面入场常从快到慢，退场常从慢到快。具体曲线要结合移动距离和界面语义测试；项目里应收敛成少量可复用规则，回弹等物理运动再考虑 弹性 Spring 。 先知道 过渡 Transition
quote: This animation feels choppy. Can it speed up and slow down more naturally?
zhQuote: 动画一卡一卡的不自然，能不能像真实的东西那样有快有慢？

name: Spring
title: Spring
description: Create motion that settles with weight and elasticity · Spring motion is defined by physical-style values such as stiffness and damping rather than only a fixed curve. It suits direct manipulation and elements that need to settle into place. Too much bounce makes routine actions feel slow and unstable. Know first Animation Easing
zhDescription: 弹性动画是一种用刚度、阻尼和质量等物理参数计算运动的动效方式 · 拖拽卡片松手后的回弹可使用 spring，通过参数控制速度、过冲和停止方式。CSS transition 没有通用原生 spring 类型，通常需要动画库或经过设计的 缓动 Easing 近似；它不适合严肃确认、持续阅读或让所有元素同时弹动。 先知道 动画 Animation 缓动 Easing
quote: Give the dialog a small springy bounce when it appears.
zhQuote: 弹窗出现时带一点回弹，像弹簧那样轻轻晃一下。

name: Fade In / Out
title: Fade In / Out
description: Reveal or hide an element by changing its opacity · A fade is a simple transition between transparent and visible states. It works for overlays, messages, and content replacement, but opacity alone does not explain where an element came from. Combine it with small spatial motion only when that adds useful context. Know first Opacity Transition
zhDescription: 渐入渐出是一种通过改变透明度让内容出现或离开的基础动效 · 提示框、卡片或弹窗进入和退出时可用 opacity 的淡入淡出，视觉负担较低。它仍要配合正确的阅读顺序、点击和最终隐藏状态；如果需要表达内容来自哪个方向或层级，滑动或缩放可能更清楚。 先知道 透明度 Opacity 过渡 Transition
quote: When the content changes, fade the old content out and the new content in.
zhQuote: 切换内容的时候，让旧的淡出、新的淡入。

name: Keyframe
title: Keyframe
description: The state points you specify in an animation; the browser interpolates animatable properties between specified points · CSS @keyframes lets you specify styles at points such as 0%, 50%, and 100%. The browser calculates values between points for interpolable properties; looping requires a separate animation-iteration-count setting such as infinite, because keyframes do not loop by themselves. Know first Transition
zhDescription: 在动画时间线上标出样式状态点；浏览器对可插值的属性计算中间值 · CSS 的 @keyframes 可以在 0%、50%、100% 等时间点指定样式。浏览器会对可插值的属性计算时间点之间的值；动画是否循环要另设 animation-iteration-count（例如 infinite），关键帧本身不会自动循环。 先知道 过渡 Transition
quote: Make the logo rotate continuously. AI says to use keyframes?
zhQuote: 让 logo 一直转，AI 说要用 keyframes？

name: Hover
title: Hover
description: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element · Hover can preview that an item is interactive or reveal secondary detail before a click. It does not exist on touch-only devices, so essential content and actions must remain available without it. Keep the visual change clear but stable.
zhDescription: 指针设备悬停在交互元素上方时触发的即时视觉反馈状态。 · 链接变色、卡片略微浮起或按钮增加阴影，都可以用 hover 提示它可以操作。反馈应当轻微且与点击后的结果一致；触屏设备通常没有悬停，因此菜单入口、说明和关键功能不能只在 hover 时显示。
quote: Change the button color on hover so people know they can click it.
zhQuote: 鼠标放上去的时候按钮变个色，让人知道它能点。

name: Active
title: Active
description: Show that a control is being pressed right now · The active state appears during the press between pointer down and release. A small change in color, depth, or scale confirms that the input was received. It is different from a selected item that stays chosen after the interaction.
zhDescription: 用户按下或触控元素期间触发的即时物理受力反馈状态。 · active 通常出现在指针按下到松开之间，键盘激活也应有对应反馈。可以轻微下沉或改变颜色，但幅度要结合组件、品牌和可读性决定，没有固定缩放值；它不是 悬停 Hover 、持续选中或禁用状态。
quote: When someone presses the button, make it feel like it's being pushed in.
zhQuote: 点下去那一瞬间，点击按钮时需要有明确的按下凹陷反馈。

name: Focus
title: Focus
description: Show which element will receive keyboard input · Focus identifies the interactive element currently controlled by the keyboard or another input method. A visible focus indicator is essential for navigation and form entry. It may differ from hover, but it should be at least as easy to see.
zhDescription: 控件当前接收键盘输入与用户操作焦点的激活状态。 · 按 Tab 键浏览链接和按钮、点击输入框时都会看到 focus；清楚的描边能告诉键盘用户下一次按键会作用在哪里。若替换浏览器默认 outline，必须提供同样明显且对比度足够的焦点样式，不能只在鼠标点击时保留。
quote: I can't tell where I am when I use Tab. Can you add a clear focus outline?
zhQuote: Tab 键切换的时候看不出当前停在哪，能不能给个明显的框？

name: Drag
title: Drag
description: Move or reorder an item by holding and pulling it · Drag interaction works for rearranging cards, moving files, and choosing a range. Show what can be grabbed, where it may be dropped, and the result before release. Provide another method for people who cannot or do not want to drag.
zhDescription: 拖拽是一种按住元素并移动它的位置或把它放到目标区域的交互方式 · 调整任务卡顺序、把文件拖进上传区时会用到 drag；过程中应显示被拖元素、可放置区域和落点占位。拖拽对键盘、触屏和手部操作不稳定的用户并不可靠，因此排序要提供上移下移等替代操作，上传也要保留文件选择按钮。
quote: Let people drag these cards to rearrange them.
zhQuote: 这些卡片希望能按住拖动，换个顺序。

name: Disabled
title: Disabled
description: Show that a control is currently unavailable · A disabled control cannot be operated in the current state. Use it when the action is visible and its future availability matters, and explain what condition is missing. If the action is irrelevant, removing it may be clearer than leaving a page full of disabled controls.
zhDescription: 禁用是表示控件当前不能执行操作的交互状态 · 除降低视觉强调，还应就近说明暂不可操作的原因，不能只靠 文字提示 Tooltip 。原生 disabled 控件通常不能获得焦点；aria-disabled 只表达语义，元素通常仍可聚焦，必须由脚本阻止操作并决定焦点策略。长期无权限的入口是否隐藏，要看用户是否需要知道功能存在。
quote: Keep the submit button gray and unclickable until the form is complete.
zhQuote: 表单没填完之前，提交按钮要是灰的、点不了。

name: Cursor
title: Cursor
description: The mouse pointer changes shape to preview whether an area can be clicked, typed in, dragged, or is currently unavailable · When a mouse moves over an element, CSS cursor can show a familiar system pointer: pointer for clickable areas, text for editable text, grab for draggable objects, and not-allowed as an extra unavailable-state cue. These shapes vary by platform and cannot replace clear controls, labels, focus styles, or disabled behavior. Touchscreens usually show no mouse pointer. The blinking insertion line inside a text field is the caret, not the mouse pointer.
zhDescription: 鼠标指针会根据所在区域改变形状，提前提示这里可以点击、输入、拖动或暂不可用 · 当鼠标移到网页元素上，浏览器会根据 CSS cursor 显示对应的指针。可点击区域常见 pointer，可输入文字的区域显示 text，可拖动对象显示 grab，暂不可用的操作可显示 not-allowed。指针只是辅助提示，按钮、链接、输入框和禁用状态本身仍要让人看得懂；触屏设备通常看不到这些变化。输入框里闪烁的竖线是文本光标 Caret，不是鼠标指针。
quote: Change the cursor to a pointer when it moves over something clickable.
zhQuote: 鼠标移到能点的东西上，变成小手。

name: Selection
title: Selection
description: Show which text or items the user has selected · Selection highlights the text, rows, files, or objects included in the next action. Keep it distinct from hover and focus, and make the selected set remain clear while menus or toolbars open. The visual state should match the actual data selection.
zhDescription: 选中高亮是用户拖选网页文字后，浏览器为选区显示的前景色和背景色 · 可用 ::selection 为文章或说明文字设置选区颜色，并在不同主题下检查对比度。它可以适度使用品牌色，但不能影响文字辨认；user-select: none 只适合拖拽手柄等确实不应被选中的元素，正文和说明通常应允许复制。
quote: Change the text highlight color to our brand color when people select text.
zhQuote: 用户划选文字时的底色，想换成品牌色。

name: Domain
title: Domain
description: Give a website a human-readable address · A domain name is the address people type, such as example.com. It is registered separately from the server that hosts the site and points to that service through DNS . Renew it on time, protect the account, and decide which subdomains each service uses.
zhDescription: 域名是给网站、邮箱等网络服务使用的好记名称。 · 例如 example.com 是一个域名。它本身不存放网页，而是把访问者带到网站或邮箱所在的服务；通常需要按年注册。选择时要易读、易拼，保护好注册账号并留意续费。
quote: I want people to be able to type an easy-to-remember name to open my website.
zhQuote: 我想让别人输入一个好记的名字，就能打开我的网站。

name: DNS
title: DNS
description: Connect a domain name to the service that should answer · DNS translates a domain into records that direct browsers and other clients to a host, email service, or verification target. Changes may take time to spread because records are cached. Keep the required record type, name, value, and previous configuration clear before editing. Know first Domain
zhDescription: 互联网的地址簿，把域名查成浏览器能找到网站的地址 · 例如，输入 vibe-hub.org 后，DNS 会先找到它对应的服务地址，浏览器才能连接。修改 DNS 后，旧地址可能仍被缓存一段时间，所以不同地区不一定同时更新。 先知道 域名 Domain
quote: I bought a domain, so why do I still need to set up DNS? Help me point it to my server.
zhQuote: 买了名字为什么还要“解析”？帮我把名字指到我的服务器上。

name: URL
title: URL
description: Describe the exact location of a resource on the web · A URL contains pieces such as protocol, domain, path, query, and fragment. Together they identify a page or resource and may carry filters or an anchor. Keep public URLs readable and stable, and never place passwords or secrets in them. Know first Domain
zhDescription: URL 是浏览器用来打开某个页面、文件或位置的完整地址。 · 例如 https://vibe-hub.org/api 会打开 VibeHub 的一个页面；站内的相对 URL 也可以只写 /api，让浏览器从当前网站继续寻找。地址还可能带筛选条件或私密凭证，分享前要检查其中有没有密码或个人信息。 先知道 域名 Domain
quote: What's that long string in the address bar? I want every page to have its own permanent address.
zhQuote: 地址栏里那一长串是什么？我想让每个页面都有自己固定的地址。

name: HTTP
title: HTTP
description: Send a request and receive a response over the web · HTTP is the request-response protocol browsers and APIs use. A request includes a method, URL, headers, and sometimes a body; the response includes a status, headers, and content. Methods and status codes should match what actually happened. Know first URL
zhDescription: 浏览器或 App 向服务器提出请求、再接收结果时遵守的通信规则 · 例如，用户在资料页修改昵称并点击保存后，页面会通过 HTTP 发出请求，服务器再返回成功、失败和具体内容。开发者可以在浏览器的 Network 面板里看到这次通信。 先知道 URL
quote: When I click a button, what actually happens between the browser and the server?
zhQuote: 我就想知道，点一下按钮，浏览器和服务器之间到底发生了什么。

name: Cookie
title: Cookie
description: A cookie is a small piece of data the browser stores by server rules and sends automatically on matching later requests. · For example, a login response uses Set-Cookie to store a session identifier. When the browser later visits a matching address, it sends a Cookie request header so the server can find the session. A cookie is only part of the request round trip, not a complete authentication system, authorization decision, or database; sensitive sessions also need properties such as Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite. Know first HTTP Browser Storage
zhDescription: 由浏览器按服务器要求保存并在符合规则的后续请求中自动携带的文本数据 · 例如登录响应通过 Set-Cookie 保存会话标识，之后访问同一站点时浏览器会在匹配条件下带上 Cookie 请求头，服务器就能找到对应会话。Cookie 只是请求往返机制，不等于完整的身份认证、权限判断或数据库；敏感会话还要考虑 Secure、HttpOnly 和 SameSite 等安全属性。 先知道 HTTP 浏览器存储 Browser Storage
quote: Login succeeds, but a refresh signs the user out. Help me check whether the session cookie is set and sent back with requests.
zhQuote: 登录成功但一刷新就退出，帮我检查会话 Cookie 有没有被设置和随请求带回去。

name: HTTPS
title: HTTPS
description: Encrypt the connection between the browser and the website · HTTPS is HTTP protected by TLS. It helps prevent other parties on the network from reading or changing the traffic and lets the browser verify the server's certificate. It does not make unsafe application code or stolen passwords secure by itself. Know first HTTP Domain
zhDescription: 地址栏里以 https:// 开头、用于保护设备与网站之间数据的加密连接 · 例如，用户登录时，HTTPS 会降低密码在传输途中被同一网络中的其他人读取或篡改的风险。它只保护连接，不代表网站内容、公司身份或交易一定可信。 先知道 HTTP 域名 Domain
quote: My browser says the site isn't secure. How do I get that lock icon in the address bar?
zhQuote: 浏览器说我的网站“不安全”，地址栏那个小锁怎么弄出来？

name: CDN
title: CDN
description: Serve static files from locations closer to visitors · A content delivery network caches images, scripts, styles, and sometimes pages across many edge locations. It can reduce latency and protect the origin from repeated traffic. Plan cache rules and invalidation so visitors do not receive outdated files. Know first Domain DNS
zhDescription: 把图片和网页文件的副本放到多个地区，让用户从较近的位置加载 · 例如，深圳和新加坡的用户打开同一张产品图时，可以分别从附近节点获取。CDN 不会自动解决后端慢的问题，更新文件时也要处理旧缓存。 先知道 域名 Domain DNS
quote: People far away say the images load slowly. Can they download them from somewhere closer?
zhQuote: 外地用户说图片加载慢，能不能让他们从就近的地方下载？

name: Port
title: Port
description: A port is a numbered network entry that distinguishes services on the same host. · After npm run dev , a page commonly opens at http://localhost:3000 , while an API on the same machine may listen on 4000. localhost means the current device only; ports keep multiple local services separate. Know first URL
zhDescription: 端口是同一台主机上区分不同网络服务的编号入口。 · 例如运行 npm run dev 后常可在 http://localhost:3000 打开网页，同时本机的接口可能监听 4000 端口。localhost 只指当前这台设备；端口让同一台电脑上的多个服务不会混在一起。 先知道 URL
quote: The local app runs on port 3000 and the API on 4000. Help me confirm which one the browser reaches.
zhQuote: 本地项目跑在 3000 端口，接口服务在 4000；帮我确认浏览器连的是哪一个。

name: Redirect
title: Redirect
description: A redirect is a mechanism that sends a visit from one URL to another URL. · When a product is renamed, an old link can automatically lead to its matching new address; after sign-in, a page may also return someone to what they meant to view. A redirect changes the destination URL. It is not merely an in-page view change, and unrelated old content should not all be sent to the home page. Know first HTTP URL
zhDescription: 重定向是服务器或浏览器把一个 URL 的访问带到另一个 URL 的机制。 · 例如产品改名后，旧链接可自动带到对应的新地址；登录成功后也常从登录页进入原本想看的页面。它改变访问的目标地址，不等于页面内部切换视图，也不该把无关旧内容一律送去首页。 先知道 HTTP URL
quote: The old event link should take people to the new page instead of showing a 404.
zhQuote: 旧的活动链接要带到新版页面，别让用户打开后直接看到 404。

name: HTTP Status Code
title: HTTP Status Code
description: A three-digit answer from the server about a request: success, redirect, a request problem, or a server failure · When a page fails, a 404 response says the target resource was not found; check the URL, route, and deployment. A 500 is a server-error-class response; correlate its request ID with server logs to find clues. A status code points to the next check but does not prove the root cause or responsibility on its own. Know first HTTP Deployment
zhDescription: 服务器用三位数字回答一次请求的结果：成功、重定向、请求有问题，还是服务器自己出错 · 页面打不开时，Network 面板的 404 表示这次响应没有找到请求的目标资源；可能要检查地址、路由和部署。500 表示处理请求的一侧报告了内部错误，接着应结合请求 ID 和服务端日志找线索。状态码提供排查方向，不单独证明根因或责任归属。 先知道 HTTP 部署上线 Deployment
quote: The page opens to a 404 error. Did I write the wrong link, or was the deployment incomplete?
zhQuote: 页面打开是一片 404 页面，是链接写错了还是没部署好？

name: IP Address
title: IP Address
description: A network-layer address used to locate an interface and route data · In local development, 127.0.0.1 is the current device's loopback interface; a LAN address is reachable only within its routed network. Sharing localhost with a coworker still points to their own computer. A public IP alone does not mean anyone can connect: routing, ports, service listening, and access rules also matter. Know first Port
zhDescription: 网络层用于定位接口并转发数据的数字地址 · 本地开发时，127.0.0.1 指当前设备的回环接口；局域网地址只在相应网络路由范围内可达。把 localhost 发给同事仍指向同事自己的电脑。公网 IP 也不等于任何人都能连上：还要有可达路由、开放端口、服务监听和允许访问的配置。 先知道 端口 Port
quote: Why can I open the page on my computer but others cannot?
zhQuote: 为什么我电脑上能打开，别人打不开我的页面？

name: WebSocket
title: WebSocket
description: A connection that stays open, letting both sides send messages at any time · Live chat and collaborative editing may use WebSocket when both sides need frequent messages. An HTTP request and response form one message exchange, but the underlying HTTP connection can be reused and HTTP/2 can multiplex streams. After its handshake, WebSocket exchanges messages in both directions over one connection. Applications can add heartbeat checks and reconnection or state-recovery logic as needed; the connection can still drop. Know first HTTP
zhDescription: 握手后保持打开的双向连接，双方可以互相发送消息 · 聊天或协同编辑需要双方频繁交换消息时，WebSocket 握手成功后会通过同一连接双向传消息。它不是一条更长的 HTTP 请求；HTTP/1.1 可以复用连接，HTTP/2 可以在连接上多路复用。WebSocket 连接仍可能中断，需按场景设计重连和状态恢复。 先知道 HTTP
quote: How does a chat room receive new messages in real time?
zhQuote: 聊天室怎么实时收到别人的新消息？

name: API
title: API
description: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information · For example, a weather app can ask a weather service for today's Shenzhen forecast and receive the temperature and conditions. The API defines where the request goes, what it carries, and what comes back; it is not the page, backend code, or database. Know first HTTP
zhDescription: 两个软件互相请求数据或功能时共同遵守的约定 · 比如天气 App 请求“深圳今天多少度”，天气服务会返回温度和天气状态。API 会说明请求需要带什么、结果长什么样；其中某一个具体请求地址才是端点。API 不是页面、后端代码或数据库。 先知道 HTTP
quote: My website needs data from the backend. People keep saying I need an API—what is that?
zhQuote: 我的网页想从后台拿数据，听说要有个什么“接口”，到底是啥？

name: JSON
title: JSON
description: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange · JSON stores objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null in a widely supported text format. APIs often use it for request and response bodies. The text must follow strict syntax, and the receiving side still needs to validate the expected fields and types. Know first HTTP
zhDescription: JSON 是软件之间传递成组信息时常用的一种文本写法。 · 例如天气服务可以把城市、温度和天气状态按 JSON 格式发给页面，页面再把对应内容显示出来。它能把文字、数字、列表和真假状态放在一起；收到后仍要检查内容是否齐全、是否正确。 先知道 HTTP
quote: AI keeps returning data with curly braces inside curly braces. How do I read and write it?
zhQuote: AI 返回给我的那种大括号套小括号的数据，怎么读、怎么写？

name: CORS
title: CORS
description: CORS is the browser security mechanism that lets a page read a cross-origin response only after the server explicitly permits it. · When a page on app.example.com requests api.example.com , the server must allow that page origin in its response before the browser gives the data to script. It protects cross-origin reads in browsers; the server still decides whether an API can be called and whether a user has permission. Know first HTTP API
zhDescription: CORS 是浏览器要求服务器明确同意后，网页才能跨源读取响应的安全机制。 · 例如网页从 app.example.com 请求 api.example.com ，服务器要在响应中允许这个网页来源，浏览器才把数据交给脚本。它保护的是浏览器里的跨源读取；接口能否被调用、用户是否有权限，仍要由服务器验证。 先知道 HTTP API
quote: The browser blocked this page's API request. Check whether CORS is not allowing this site.
zhQuote: 网页请求接口被浏览器拦住了，帮我检查是不是 CORS 配置没有允许这个站点。

name: Validation
title: Validation
description: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values · A required field can be checked when someone leaves it, while cross-field rules usually need a submit-time check. Frontend feedback helps people correct mistakes, but the backend must validate again and return specific field errors. Know first Route & Endpoint JSON
zhDescription: 数据校验是在使用输入前检查其格式、范围和业务规则的步骤 · 例如，必填项可在用户离开字段时提示，跨字段规则通常在提交时统一检查。前端提示帮助用户及时纠正，但可能被绕过；后端仍须重新校验并返回具体字段错误。 先知道 路由与端点 Route & Endpoint JSON
quote: People can submit complete nonsense. How do I stop bad input before it gets saved?
zhQuote: 用户乱填也能提交成功，怎么在保存之前先拦住？

name: Enqueue
title: Enqueue
description: Enqueue puts work into a queue so a request can receive a task ID before a later processor runs it · After someone uploads a video, the API can enqueue a transcoding task and return a task ID while the page shows queued, processing, or completed. Batch notifications can use the same pattern. A successful enqueue means the queue accepted the task, not that transcoding or delivery has finished; queues also do not automatically promise FIFO ordering or exactly-once processing.
zhDescription: 将待处理任务写入队列暂存，使当前请求能先获得任务凭证并快速返回，再由后台异步执行的操作。 · 例如用户上传视频后，接口把转码任务入队并立即返回任务 ID，页面随后按状态显示排队、处理中或完成；批量发送通知时，也可以先把每封通知任务放进队列。入队成功只说明任务被队列接受，不等于转码或通知已经完成；队列也不一定按先进先出排列，不能据此承诺恰好一次处理。
quote: After upload, do not keep the page waiting. Enqueue the transcoding task, return a task ID, and let me check its status later.
zhQuote: 上传以后先别让页面一直等，把转码任务放进队列并返回任务 ID，之后能查到处理状态。

name: Idempotency
title: Idempotency
description: A repeated request produces the same intended business effect instead of applying it again · If a payment provider retries the same callback concurrently after a timeout, the order service uses its stable event id as a unique key and atomically claims processing so the order is marked paid only once. Idempotency does not mean zero logs, notifications, or other side effects, and different business operations must not share one key.
zhDescription: 同一个请求重复到达时，预期的业务效果仍只发生一次。 · 例如支付平台因超时并发重发同一个回调，订单服务应以事件编号作为唯一键，原子地取得一次处理权，只把订单标记为已支付一次。幂等不等于完全没有日志、通知等副作用，也不代表不同业务请求可以共用同一个编号。
quote: A payment callback may arrive more than once, but the same order must count as paid only once.
zhQuote: 支付回调可能重复送达，但同一个订单只能标记支付成功一次，重复回调要返回已处理结果。

name: Message Consumer
title: Message Consumer
description: A message consumer is an application or instance that receives messages from a queue, handles them according to its rules, and acknowledges their processing status · An upload API can publish a transcoding task while a consumer takes it from the queue and runs the work. An order system can use a consumer to receive an order-created message and create a shipping record. Without a consumer, messages build up; if processing fails, a message may be delivered again, so successful publishing is not business completion.
zhDescription: 从消息队列中获取待处理消息并执行业务逻辑，处理完成后向队列反馈确认状态的服务实例或后台进程。 · 例如上传接口只负责发送转码任务，消费者从队列取出任务并执行转码；订单系统也可以让消费者接收“订单已创建”消息，再生成发货记录。没有消费者时，消息会留在队列里堆积；处理失败时消息可能被重新投递，所以发送成功不等于业务已经完成。
quote: The message was sent, but the queue keeps growing. Check whether a consumer is receiving, processing, and acknowledging the messages.
zhQuote: 消息已经发出去了，但队列一直增长。帮我确认有没有消费者在接收、处理并确认这些消息。

name: Webhook
title: Webhook
description: A mechanism where the other party proactively notifies an address you configured when something happens · After an event such as a payment, a platform can attempt to deliver an HTTP request to your configured endpoint. Delivery may be delayed, fail, be retried, duplicate, or arrive out of order. Verify the source, deduplicate events, and read back the business record; polling can provide a reconciliation fallback. Know first API
zhDescription: 事情发生时，由对方主动向你指定的地址发一条通知的机制 · 支付平台可以在支付状态变化后尝试向你配置的 HTTPS 地址投递事件。投递可能延迟、失败、重试、重复或乱序，因此接收端需核验来源、按稳定事件或业务对象去重，并读取订单记录确认最终状态；关键流程还要有对账等补偿方式。 先知道 API
quote: How do I unlock membership automatically after a successful payment?
zhQuote: 支付成功后自动开通权限，怎么实现？

name: HTTP Methods
title: HTTP Methods
description: The verb in a request stating which kind of operation it performs: read, create, update, or delete · In the Network panel, GET /api/articles/7 and POST /api/articles are different requests. GET means safe reading; POST asks the target resource to process the request, and whether it creates or saves depends on the API contract. A method states request semantics; choosing the wrong one does not guarantee a 405 response. Know first HTTP
zhDescription: HTTP 请求中的方法，用来表达客户端想对目标资源做什么 · 在 Network 面板里，GET /api/articles/7 与 POST /api/articles 是两条不同请求。GET 表示安全读取；POST 把请求交给目标资源处理，具体是否创建或保存要看接口约定。方法说明请求语义，不保证选错时一定返回 405。 先知道 HTTP
quote: AI said to use POST instead of GET here. What does that mean?
zhQuote: AI 说这里应该用 POST 而不是 GET，什么意思？

name: Browser Storage
title: Browser Storage
description: Browser storage is a local web mechanism for keeping data in a person's current browser. · It can remember dark mode, an unsubmitted form draft, or recently viewed projects so a later page load may restore them. It normally belongs only to that browser and device; clearing data, changing browser, or switching device may remove it. Know first Frontend
zhDescription: 浏览器存储是网页把数据保存在用户当前浏览器中的本地机制。 · 例如记住深色模式、未提交的表单草稿或最近查看过的项目；刷新或下次打开时仍可能读取到。它通常只属于这一浏览器和设备，用户清除浏览数据、换浏览器或换设备后不保证还在。 先知道 前端 Frontend
quote: Keep this draft after refresh, but do not treat it as a database shared by every user.
zhQuote: 刷新页面后保留这个草稿，但不要把它当成所有用户共享的数据库。

name: Database
title: Database
description: Store and find application data such as users, posts, and orders · After someone publishes a post, the backend stores it so it remains available after refresh or sign-in. CRUD names the four common operations: create, read, update, and delete. Data kept only in one browser does not automatically appear on another device. Know first API JSON Env Var
zhDescription: 保存并查找用户、文章、订单等应用数据的地方 · 例如用户发布文章后，系统把标题和正文存进数据库；刷新页面或换一台设备登录，文章仍能被读到。常见操作包括新增、查看、修改和删除数据。只存在当前浏览器里的内容不会自动同步到别的设备。 先知道 API JSON 环境变量 Env Var
quote: The content people submit disappears after a refresh. We need somewhere to actually save it.
zhQuote: 用户发的内容刷新就没了，得找个地方真正存下来。

name: Database Migration
title: Database Migration
description: An ordered, versioned, and traceable set of steps for changing database structure or required data. · Suppose users already contains live rows and a required status column is needed. A safe migration adds a compatible column, backfills old rows, verifies that no NULL values remain, and only then enforces the constraint. The migration tool records applied versions, but migration files are not data backups and do not guarantee lossless reversal. Know first Database SQL Deployment
zhDescription: 把数据库结构或必要的数据转换写成有顺序、可版本化、可追踪的变更步骤。 · 例如 users 表已经有真实用户，现在要新增必填的 status 字段。安全的迁移方案会先增加可兼容的字段、回填旧记录，检查空值已经归零，再收紧为必填，而不是直接把新约束压到旧数据上。迁移工具会记录哪些版本已执行，但迁移文件不是数据备份，也不保证每次变更都能无损回退。 先知道 数据库 Database SQL 部署上线 Deployment
quote: I need to add a phone column to our user table, but production already has tens of thousands of rows. How do we update the schema without losing data or causing downtime?
zhQuote: 用户表里已经有真实数据了，我要再加一个必填状态字段，应该按什么顺序改才不会让旧数据立刻报错？

name: SQL
title: SQL
description: Ask a relational database to read or change structured records · SQL can select, filter, join, insert, update, and delete data in relational databases. Parameterize user values instead of building query strings, and inspect indexes and execution plans when a query becomes slow. A correct query still needs authorization around it. Know first Database
zhDescription: 后端或数据库工具用来查找和修改关系型数据的语言 · 例如，管理员筛选所有未付款订单时，后端会用 SQL 从订单表中查出结果。修改或删除数据前必须确认影响范围，用户输入也不能直接拼进 SQL 命令。 先知道 数据库 Database
quote: How do I write a query for users who placed an order in the last seven days?
zhQuote: 我想查出“最近 7 天下单的用户”，那句话怎么写？

name: Transaction
title: Transaction
description: A group of related database operations that are committed or rolled back as a whole · When an order is created, the system usually writes the order record and deducts inventory together. If stock is unavailable, the order should not remain. A transaction rolls back this group of operations in the same database, but it does not automatically undo external actions like payments or emails.
zhDescription: 作为一个整体提交或回滚的一组数据库操作。 · 例如创建订单时要同时写入订单记录并扣减库存；如果库存不足，订单也不应留下。事务能把同一数据库中的这组操作一起撤销，但不会自动撤销已经发出的支付、邮件等外部动作。
quote: Creating an order and deducting stock must succeed together; if any step fails, it must not leave half an order behind.
zhQuote: 创建订单和扣库存必须一起成功，任何一步失败都不能留下半个订单。

name: Database Write
title: Database Write
description: Writing new or updated data to a database and committing the change · After a user changes a nickname, the backend must complete and confirm the database write so refresh can read it back. A successful response alone does not prove that, and a write is not the same as backup, replication, or immediate visibility everywhere.
zhDescription: 把新增或修改的数据写入数据库并完成提交。 · 例如用户点击保存资料后，后端执行写入并确认提交，刷新页面时才能从数据库读回新昵称。接口返回成功不一定证明写入已经完成；写入也不等于备份、复制到其他节点，或所有读取都立即可见。
quote: The API says saved, but the nickname returns to its old value after refresh. Confirm the write really committed.
zhQuote: 接口说保存成功，但刷新后昵称又没了；请确认这次修改真的写进数据库并提交了。

name: PostgreSQL
title: PostgreSQL
description: An open-source database management system that stores and queries related data in tables · For example, store users and orders in separate tables and require each order to reference an existing user. PostgreSQL can enforce that constraint, but the rule must be configured; installation alone does not define your business rules. Know first Database SQL
zhDescription: 用表保存和查询关联数据的开源数据库管理系统 · 例如把用户和订单保存在两张表里，再规定每笔订单必须对应一个已有用户。PostgreSQL 可以执行这样的数据约束；这些规则需要明确配置，装好数据库不会自动理解你的业务。 先知道 数据库 Database SQL
quote: AI suggested using Supabase and PostgreSQL for my users and orders; how is that different from saving files?
zhQuote: AI 推荐我用 Supabase 和 PostgreSQL 存用户和订单，它和普通存文件有什么区别？

name: Object Storage
title: Object Storage
description: A cloud storage service specialized in whole objects like images, videos, and files, accessed by link · For an article cover, the image bytes are stored as a file object while the database stores the article title, ownership, and related object key or URL. The page reads the article record and requests the image by address; access may be permission-controlled or time-limited, so a URL is not necessarily permanent or public. Know first Database
zhDescription: 把图片、视频和附件作为完整文件对象保存的存储服务，按对象键或地址读取 · 上传文章封面时，图片字节作为文件对象存入对象存储，数据库保存文章标题、归属和对应的 object key 或 URL。页面先读文章记录，再按地址请求图片；地址可能受权限或时效限制，不代表所有人都能永久打开。 先知道 数据库 Database
quote: Where do user-uploaded profile pictures actually go?
zhQuote: 用户上传的头像到底存到哪里？

name: Primary Key
title: Primary Key
description: The field in a table used to uniquely identify each row · If two rows in a users table share an email, an update by email matches both; an update limited to primary key id = 7 identifies the target row. Check the matching count before writing and read the table again to confirm the other row stayed unchanged. A primary key can be one column or a group, and its value is unique and non-null. Know first Database
zhDescription: 一张表里用来唯一区分每一行的字段 · users 表里若有两行邮箱相同，按 email 更新会匹配两行；按主键 id = 7 则能选中带有该唯一标识的目标行。写入前核对匹配数，更新后重读表格确认另一行没变。主键可以是一列或多列的组合，值唯一且不为空。 先知道 数据库 Database
quote: AI said to update this record by id. Where does that id come from?
zhQuote: AI 说按 id 更新这条记录，这个 id 是哪里来的？

name: Backend
title: Backend
description: The server-side part people usually cannot see that handles requests and data · After someone submits a sign-up form, the backend checks the phone number and code, creates the account, and returns success or failure to the page. Passwords, secret keys, and permission rules belong here, not only in the interface.
zhDescription: 用户通常看不见、负责处理请求和数据的服务器端部分 · 比如用户在注册页点击提交后，后端会检查手机号和验证码、创建账号，再把成功或失败返回给页面。密码、密钥和权限规则应留在后端，不能只靠页面判断。
quote: Where does the part users can't see run, and who handles things like login and saving data?
zhQuote: 用户看不见的那部分在哪跑？登录、存数据这些事是谁干的？

name: Backend Framework
title: Backend Framework
description: Use a shared structure for routes, requests, data, and server behavior · A backend framework supplies conventions and tools for routing, input handling, middleware, databases, and responses. It reduces repeated setup, but it does not decide the product's rules for you. Choose one that fits the language, hosting model, and size of the application. Know first Backend
zhDescription: 开发后端时使用的现成项目骨架，帮助组织请求、处理代码和错误 · 例如，注册请求到来后，框架会把它交给注册功能的代码，并在出错时返回明确结果。框架不是一门新语言，应优先沿用项目已经选择的方案。 先知道 后端 Backend
quote: Is there a ready-made framework for building the backend, so I don't have to start from scratch?
zhQuote: 写后端有没有现成的架子，别让我从零搭。

name: Route & Endpoint
title: Route & Endpoint
description: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it · A backend route, or endpoint, defines where a request goes and which methods it accepts. For example, GET /products may read products while POST /products creates one. Validate input, check access, return meaningful status codes, and keep unrelated operations separate. Know first Backend HTTP API
zhDescription: 路由决定访问一个网址或执行一种操作时，应交给后端的哪段功能处理。 · 例如打开文章列表和提交一篇新文章，会交给两段不同功能处理。每个对外入口都要写清需要提供什么、成功后返回什么、失败时怎样说明。 先知道 后端 Backend HTTP API
quote: When people visit different URLs, how do I send each one to the right code?
zhQuote: 用户访问不同的网址，怎么让不同的代码来接管？

name: Atomicity
title: Atomicity
description: The property that related operations either all take effect or none of them does · When two people buy the last item at the same time, checking and deducting inventory must be an indivisible whole so one succeeds and the other fails. Atomicity covers only the defined operation scope; it does not make every distributed step across systems roll back together.
zhDescription: 一组相关操作要么整体生效，要么整体不生效，中间结果不能被当成最终结果。 · 例如最后一件商品同时被两个请求购买时，检查库存和扣减库存必须作为一个不可分割的整体，让一个请求成功、另一个明确失败。原子性只保证划定范围内的整体结果，并不代表所有跨系统步骤都能一起回滚。
quote: When two users buy the last item at once, there cannot be two successful orders; checking and deducting stock must act as one whole operation.
zhQuote: 两个用户同时抢最后一件时，不能出现两张成功订单；检查和扣库存要作为一个整体。

name: Process
title: Process
description: A process is a running program together with the separate resource environment assigned by the operating system. · A web server and image worker can run as separate processes with different process IDs and isolated memory. If the image worker crashes, it can restart independently while the web process keeps serving. A process is neither a program file nor a whole machine; one machine can run many processes. Know first Backend
zhDescription: 操作系统中正在运行的程序实例，拥有独立的内存空间、系统资源和进程编号（PID）。 · 例如 Web 服务和图片处理任务分别运行在两个进程中，各自有进程 ID 和独立内存；图片进程崩溃后可以单独重启，Web 进程仍能响应。进程不是程序文件，也不等于一台机器；同一台机器可以同时运行多个进程。 先知道 后端 Backend
quote: The image worker crashes and takes down the whole site. Put that work in a separate process and verify the web service stays available.
zhQuote: 图片处理一崩，整个网站也跟着停了。把这类任务放到独立进程，并验证主服务还能响应。

name: Thread
title: Thread
description: A thread is an execution path inside a process, and threads in one process usually share memory and resources. · A service process can use several threads for concurrent requests. Threads A and B can both access the same cache; sharing helps communication but can cause overwrites and races. A thread is not an independent process with fully isolated memory, and actual parallelism depends on the runtime and workload. Know first Process
zhDescription: 进程内部由操作系统调度的最小执行单元；同一进程内的多个线程通常共享内存与系统资源。 · 例如一个服务进程用多个线程同时处理请求，线程 A 和线程 B 都能访问同一份缓存；共享让数据交换方便，也可能造成覆盖和竞态。线程不是独立进程，通常没有完全隔离的内存；是否真正并行还受语言运行时和任务类型影响。 先知道 进程 Process
quote: Two requests update the same cache. Confirm whether they are threads in one process and make the shared-state order explicit.
zhQuote: 两个请求会同时改同一份缓存。先确认它们是不是同一进程里的线程，并把共享状态的访问顺序处理清楚。

name: Coroutine
title: Coroutine
description: A coroutine is a lightweight execution unit that can suspend at explicit points and resume later. · When an endpoint calls three external services, coroutines can yield at each await so the same thread advances other work, then resume when responses arrive and combine results. A coroutine is not a new thread and does not guarantee parallelism; CPU-heavy work is not automatically faster. Know first Thread
zhDescription: 在明确暂停点主动挂起并让出执行权、待条件满足后再恢复执行的轻量级并发单元。 · 例如接口同时请求三个外部服务，协程在每个 await 等待处让出执行，同一线程可以先推进其他任务，响应回来后再恢复并合并结果。协程不等于新线程，也不保证并行；CPU 密集计算不会因为改成协程就自动变快。 先知道 线程 Thread
quote: Do not block the execution path while an endpoint waits on external services. Suspend the coroutine and let other work proceed.
zhQuote: 接口在等外部服务时不要把整条执行路径堵住，让协程在等待处挂起，先处理其他请求。

name: Message Queue
title: Message Queue
description: A communication and decoupling mechanism that temporarily stores messages between senders and receivers so neither must wait synchronously. · When a user exports a large report, the API creates a job, writes its ID and parameters to a queue, and immediately returns a pending status. A worker generates the file and updates the same ID to completed or failed. Enqueueing proves receipt, not completion, and retries can cause the same job to be delivered again. Know first API Serverless Transaction
zhDescription: 在发送方与处理方之间暂存待处理消息，让双方不必同时在线或同步等待的通信与解耦机制。 · 例如用户导出大报表时，接口先创建任务，把任务 ID 和生成要求写入消息队列，再立即返回“等待处理”。后台 Worker 按能力取出任务、生成文件，并把同一个任务 ID 更新为 completed 或 failed。入队成功只代表队列收到了消息，不代表文件已经生成；发生重试时，同一任务还可能被再次处理。 先知道 API Serverless 事务 Transaction
quote: Don't make the user stare at a spinner while generating this huge report. Put the job into a message queue and let background workers process it.
zhQuote: 导出大报表要等很久，能不能先给我一个任务编号，让后台慢慢生成，并在页面上看到等待、处理中、完成或失败？

name: Side Effect
title: Side Effect
description: A function or request changes external state or triggers an external action beyond returning a value · A price preview can calculate and return shipping without creating a quote or sending email. Saving the order and notifying the user are intentional side effects when the user explicitly submits. A side effect is not automatically an error; it needs a clear trigger and observable result.
zhDescription: 函数或请求在计算返回自身结果之外，对外部系统状态造成的变更或触发的额外操作。 · 例如用户只是预览运费，代码却顺手写入报价记录并发出邮件；预览本身的计算应先返回结果，真正保存和通知应由用户明确提交。副作用不是错误，关键是它是否显式、可控、可验收。
quote: A user is only previewing a price. Do not silently write an order or send email; do that only after explicit submission.
zhQuote: 用户只是在预览价格，不能悄悄写入订单或发邮件；真正提交时再明确执行这些动作。

name: Lock
title: Lock
description: A lock is a concurrency-control mechanism that limits simultaneous access to a shared resource. · When two requests update one inventory record, the lock owner checks and decrements before release; the waiter then rechecks, so only one succeeds. The lock must cover the correct resource. Inconsistent acquisition order can deadlock, and an in-process lock does not automatically protect another service instance. Know first Thread
zhDescription: 限制多个并发操作同时访问同一共享资源，确保同一时间只有一个执行者能够修改状态的同步机制。 · 例如两个请求同时修改库存记录，先取得锁的请求完成检查和扣减后释放，另一个等待并重新检查，最终只能一个成功。锁要保护正确的资源范围；错误的加锁顺序可能造成死锁，进程内锁也不会自动保护另一个服务实例。 先知道 线程 Thread
quote: Two requests decrement the last item concurrently. Lock the shared record so one proceeds and the other waits and rechecks.
zhQuote: 两个请求同时扣最后一件库存时，只能让一个先改。请给共享记录加锁，并验证另一个会等待后重新检查。

name: Race Condition
title: Race Condition
description: A race condition occurs when the ordering of concurrent operations changes the final result. · Two requests can read and issue the last coupon at nearly the same time, so the read-write order decides whether overselling occurs. Race conditions are broader than data races; request ordering, file state, or event timing can also race, and one passing test does not prove absence. Know first Lock
zhDescription: 多个并发操作因执行时序或交错顺序不确定，导致系统出现偶发错误或状态不一致的并发缺陷。 · 例如最后一张优惠券被两个请求同时读取并发放，谁先读、谁先写会决定是否超发，所以问题只在某些时序下出现。竞态条件不只等于数据竞争；请求顺序、文件状态或事件先后也可能形成竞态，一次测试通过不能证明它不存在。 先知道 锁 Lock
quote: Coupons occasionally oversell while one test run looks normal. Reproduce the race with concurrent timing, fix it, and verify repeatedly.
zhQuote: 优惠券偶尔会超发，但单次测试又正常。请按并发时序复现这个竞态条件，再修复并重复验证。

name: Backpressure
title: Backpressure
description: Backpressure sends a downstream slowdown or pause signal upstream to limit new or unfinished work · If an image-processing service can finish only a small number of tasks per second while uploads keep arriving, queue length and memory grow without backpressure. The system can slow or pause publishing, or cap unacknowledged work, then resume when capacity recovers. Backpressure is not extra capacity and is not a fixed rate limit independent of downstream state.
zhDescription: 下游处理能力不足时，将减速或暂停信号反向传递给上游以限制任务流入的反馈机制。 · 例如图片处理服务每秒只能完成少量任务，上传高峰却不断产生新任务；没有背压时，队列和内存会持续增长，延迟最终变成故障。系统可以让上游放慢、暂停发送，或限制还没确认的任务数量；日志显示队列深度和处理能力回到可控范围后再恢复。背压不是增加容量，也不是脱离上下游关系的固定限流。
quote: When downstream processing cannot keep up, do not let the queue and memory grow forever. Slow or pause the upstream and resume after recovery.
zhQuote: 下游处理不过来时不要让队列和内存一直涨，帮我让上游自动放慢并能在恢复后继续。

name: Lease
title: Lease
description: A lease is time-limited ownership that must be renewed and can be taken over after it expires · If two scheduler instances can run the daily summary, one can acquire and renew a lease while the other waits. If the holder fails, the lease expires and a waiting instance can take over. A lease only decides who may take over: a delayed old holder can still write, so each takeover also needs a larger fencing token that the write target checks atomically to reject stale holders.
zhDescription: 带有明确有效期的临时持有权；持有者需定期续约，超时失效后其他节点方可安全接管。 · 例如两个调度实例都能运行每日汇总任务，系统让其中一个先取得租约并在执行期间续租，另一个只能等待；持有者宕机后，租约过期，等待中的实例可以接管。租约只能决定谁有资格接管。旧持有者恢复后仍可能写入，因此每次接管还要得到更大的持有代次，也叫 fencing token（隔离令牌）。数据库或目标服务在真正写入时，用原子操作拒绝较小的旧代次。
quote: Two scheduler instances must not run the same summary. Let one hold time-limited ownership, let it expire after failure, and let the other take over.
zhQuote: 两个调度实例不能同时跑同一份汇总；让一个实例限时持有，失联后过期，再由另一个接管。

name: Distributed System
title: Distributed System
description: A distributed system uses multiple computing nodes that coordinate over a network to achieve a system goal. · During checkout, order, inventory, and payment services may run separately and exchange requests and results over a network. An inventory timeout does not mean every service stopped, so the system must handle partial failure. Multiple threads in one process share process resources and are not automatically a distributed system; the important boundary is network communication and independent failure. Know first Backend API
zhDescription: 由多个计算节点组成，并通过网络协作完成共同任务的系统。 · 例如下单时，订单服务、库存服务和支付服务分别运行，彼此通过网络传递请求和结果；库存服务超时不代表其他服务都停止，系统必须处理这次部分失败。一个进程里的多个线程共享同一进程资源，不因为并发执行就自动成为分布式系统；真正影响判断的是节点之间存在网络和独立失败。 先知道 后端 Backend API
quote: Orders, inventory, and payment run in different services. When a service or network fails, show exactly how far the order got.
zhQuote: 订单、库存和支付分在不同服务里，某个服务或网络断了时，系统还要知道这次订单到底走到哪一步。

name: Authentication
title: Authentication
description: Verify who is making the request · Authentication proves an identity through a password, passkey, one-time code, or trusted provider and then maintains a session. Store credentials safely, limit repeated attempts, and protect recovery paths. After identity is known, Authorization still decides what that person may do. Know first Route & Endpoint Database Env Var
zhDescription: 确认当前用户身份的检查过程 · 用户可以用密码、验证码或第三方登录证明身份；成功后，网站会保存一份登录凭证，让用户不必每个页面重新登录。密码不能直接保存为可读文字；确认身份后还要继续判断这个用户能做什么。 先知道 路由与端点 Route & Endpoint 数据库 Database 环境变量 Env Var
quote: How do I verify that someone is who they say they are? I need to add sign-in.
zhQuote: 怎么证明“你是你”？我要加登录功能。

name: Authorization
title: Authorization
description: Decide what an authenticated user is allowed to see or change · Authorization checks permissions for each resource and action after the user's identity is known. A person may view one project but not another, or edit content without managing billing. Enforce the rule on the backend for every request, not only by hiding controls in the interface. Know first Authentication Database
zhDescription: 确认身份后，根据规则判断用户是否有权访问特定界面或执行某项操作 · 例如，普通用户只能修改自己的资料，管理员可管理成员。敏感操作必须在服务端逐次检查；隐藏按钮只改善界面，不能代替权限判断。 先知道 身份认证 Authentication 数据库 Database
quote: After people sign in, I still need different access levels for admins and regular users.
zhQuote: 登录之后还要分谁能看谁不能看，管理员和普通用户不一样。

name: Audit Log
title: Audit Log
description: An audit log records who did what to which object, when, and with what result. · After an administrator changes the billing-editor role, an audit log can record the actor, time, target, action, and success or denial so the permission change can be investigated. It is different from an error log that explains a program failure and from monitoring that observes health signals; request data may contain sensitive information, so its scope and access need control. Know first Authorization Server Logs
zhDescription: 按时间顺序记录谁在何时对什么对象执行了什么操作，以及最终成功或被拒绝的结果。 · 例如管理员修改 billing-editor 权限后，审计日志会留下操作者、时间、目标对象、动作和成功或拒绝结果，方便追查权限变化。它不同于只说明程序出错的报错日志，也不同于观察健康指标的监控；请求内容可能含敏感信息，记录范围和访问权限需要控制。 先知道 权限控制 Authorization 服务端日志 Server Logs
quote: An administrator changed a permission. Show who changed what, when, and whether the action succeeded or was denied.
zhQuote: 管理员改了谁的权限？我想知道谁在什么时候改了什么，结果是成功还是被拒绝。

name: Entitlement
title: Entitlement
description: The specific features and allowances granted to an account by its plan or authorization · In this drawing-tool example, Free allows three generations while Pro includes HD export. Payment and access activation are separate: the server needs effective entitlements and checks every restricted action. Changing a Free label in the browser does not grant access. Know first Authentication Authorization
zhDescription: 账号根据所获方案或授权，可以使用的具体功能与额度 · 例如同一个绘图工具，Free 可生成 3 次，Pro 才能导出高清图。付款与功能开通是两个环节：服务端要拿到有效权益，并在每次受限操作时检查；改掉页面上的“Free”标签不会自动开通功能。 先知道 身份认证 Authentication 权限控制 Authorization
quote: A user bought a Pro subscription; how should the backend check if they can access this export feature?
zhQuote: 用户买了高级版会员，代码里该怎么判断他能不能用这个导出功能？

name: Session
title: Session
description: State a service keeps for a signed-in person and can look up using a browser-held identifier · After sign-in, a request that matches the cookie domain, path, and browser policies can carry a session identifier, which the service uses to find a still-valid session. A session may expire or be revoked, prompting another sign-in; this differs from the current password check failing. Know first Authentication
zhDescription: 服务器为“同一个人连续操作”保持的一段状态，靠 Cookie 里的标识认人 · 登录后刷新仍能看到账户页，是因为后续符合 Cookie 域、路径和浏览器策略的请求带上会话标识，服务端找到仍有效的会话。会话可能过期或被撤销，此时页面会要求重新登录；这与本次密码校验失败是不同问题。 先知道 身份认证 Authentication
quote: After signing in, why does the page stay signed in after refresh?
zhQuote: 登录后刷新页面，为什么还保持登录？

name: OAuth
title: OAuth
description: A protocol for granting a client scoped access to protected resources · After a user approves, an OAuth access token lets a client access a protected resource within its granted scope; the token itself is not generic proof of identity. A site using a provider account for sign-in commonly also needs OpenID Connect or the provider's explicit identity mechanism, then maps that identity to its own user. Know first Authentication
zhDescription: 让用户授权客户端在限定范围内访问受保护资源的协议 · 用户同意后，客户端可用 OAuth access token 按授权范围访问受保护资源；这个 token 本身不是通用的用户身份凭据。网站若要用第三方账号登录，通常还需要 OpenID Connect 或提供方明确的身份接口，再把身份映射到本站用户。 先知道 身份认证 Authentication
quote: How do I add a sign in with WeChat button to the page?
zhQuote: 页面上放个“用微信登录”按钮，怎么弄？

name: Cache
title: Cache
description: Keep reusable results so later requests do not always return to the origin · When new CSS is deployed but an old style remains visible, the browser, a shared cache, or a CDN may still be reusing an older copy. Caching reduces waiting and repeated transfer; diagnose the layer that served the old result, because clearing one browser does not prove a shared cache or origin has changed. Know first HTTP Browser Storage CDN
zhDescription: 暂存可以复用的结果，让后续请求不必每次都回到源站 · 例如新 CSS 已经部署，但你看到的仍是旧样式：浏览器、共享缓存或 CDN 可能还在复用旧副本。缓存能减少等待和重复传输；排错时要先判断是哪一层命中了，清浏览器不能证明共享缓存或源站已经更新。 先知道 HTTP 浏览器存储 Browser Storage CDN
quote: The new styles are deployed, but some people still see the old version. Find out which cache layer has not updated.
zhQuote: 新样式已经发布，但有些人还看到旧版，帮我查清到底是哪一层缓存没有更新。

name: SEO
title: SEO
description: SEO is ongoing work that helps search engines understand, discover, and present web content. · A help article that truly answers a question with clear headings, body structure, and reachable links is easier for search systems to understand; product pages also need accessible content and links. SEO improves the conditions for understanding and presentation, not a guarantee of a particular keyword rank. Know first HTML URL Deployment
zhDescription: SEO 是帮助搜索引擎理解、发现和呈现网页内容的一组持续优化工作。 · 例如一篇真实回答用户问题的帮助文章，用清楚的标题、正文结构和可访问链接，更容易被搜索系统正确理解；商品页也要让内容和链接可被访问。SEO 提高被理解和展示的基础条件，不承诺某个关键词一定排第几名。 先知道 HTML URL 部署上线 Deployment
quote: Help me clarify this product article's title, body hierarchy, and links so both readers and search engines can understand it.
zhQuote: 帮我把这篇产品说明的标题、正文层级和链接改清楚，让搜索引擎和读者都看得懂。

name: Canonical URL
title: Canonical URL
description: A preferred representative URL for pages with the same or very similar content · Several product URLs with campaign parameters can remain accessible while each page declares a parameter-free representative URL in its head and the sitemap lists that same address. A canonical is usually a hint to search systems, not a browser redirect; use a redirect when visitors must move. Know first URL Redirect SEO
zhDescription: 在多个相同或相近页面中声明更希望被当作代表版本的 URL · 同一商品带广告参数的多个地址可以都能打开，但页面 head 中可声明一个无参数的代表 URL，并让 Sitemap 也列它。Canonical 通常只是给搜索系统的提示，不会把用户地址栏自动跳走；需要迁移访问时应使用重定向。 先知道 URL 重定向 Redirect SEO
quote: Keep the product's campaign URLs accessible, but declare the parameter-free URL as canonical and use it in the sitemap.
zhQuote: 商品的广告参数地址仍要能打开，但请把无参数地址声明成规范 URL，并让 Sitemap 使用同一个地址。

name: XML Sitemap
title: XML Sitemap
description: List important canonical URLs in a machine-readable XML file for crawler discovery · When a new article has few internal links, listing its full address in sitemap.xml can help crawlers discover and request it. It is a machine-readable URL list, not visitor-facing site navigation, and it does not guarantee indexing or ranking. Know first SEO URL Web Hosting
zhDescription: 用机器可读的 XML 文件列出希望爬虫发现的重要 URL · 例如新文章还没有内部链接时，可以在 sitemap.xml 中列出它的完整地址，让爬虫更容易发现并请求页面。它是给机器读取的 URL 清单，不是给访客浏览的网站导航，也不保证页面一定被收录或排名。 先知道 SEO URL 网站托管 Web Hosting
quote: The new article is live but has few internal links. Generate a sitemap.xml containing only valid canonical URLs.
zhQuote: 新文章已经上线但还没有多少内部链接，帮我生成只包含有效主地址的 sitemap.xml。

name: Robots.txt
title: Robots.txt
description: A root-level file that tells automated crawlers which paths they may crawl · Shopping carts and duplicate filter URLs can waste crawler requests, so robots.txt can describe crawling rules at the site root. It is guidance for crawlers that follow the rules, not a block on normal visitors, authentication, or protection for sensitive data. Know first URL Authorization SEO
zhDescription: 放在站点根目录、告诉自动爬虫哪些路径可以抓取的规则文件 · 购物车和重复筛选路径可能浪费爬虫请求，可以在根目录的 robots.txt 中写抓取规则。它只表达对遵守规则的爬虫的抓取建议，不会阻止普通用户打开页面，也不能代替登录、权限或敏感数据保护。 先知道 URL 权限控制 Authorization SEO
quote: Limit crawler access to duplicate filter paths, but do not use robots.txt as permission for the admin area.
zhQuote: 请让爬虫少抓重复筛选路径，但不要把 robots.txt 当成管理页的访问权限。

name: Not Found Page
title: Not Found Page
description: Return 404 for a missing resource and give people a way to recover · When an article link no longer works, the server should return 404, explain that the content was not found, and offer a list or search path. A Not Found message alone is not enough: Network must also show HTTP 404. If the content moved to a new address, use a redirect instead. Know first HTTP URL
zhDescription: 资源不存在时返回 404，并给用户一条可以继续走的路径 · 例如文章链接已经失效，服务器应返回 404，页面说明找不到内容并提供返回列表或搜索入口。页面上写着“找不到”还不够，Network 中的 HTTP 状态也必须是 404；如果内容已经搬到新地址，应使用重定向。 先知道 HTTP URL
quote: This article URL no longer exists. Make a real 404 page that still lets people return to the article list.
zhQuote: 这个文章地址已经不存在了，帮我做一个真正返回 404、还能回到文章列表的页面。

name: Env Var
title: Env Var
description: Provide configuration outside the source code · Environment variables supply values such as API endpoints, feature settings, and secret keys when a program starts. Public browser variables are visible to visitors, even if their names come from an environment file. Keep real secrets on the server and document the required variable names with safe examples. Know first Terminal
zhDescription: 环境变量是在代码外保存设置值、让不同运行地点读取各自配置的方式。 · 例如本机测试、测试地址和正式网站可以分别使用不同服务地址或密钥。会发到浏览器的设置谁都能查看，真正的密钥只能留在服务器。 .env 常用来在本机保存这些值，但它不是保险箱，也不应上传到代码仓库。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: I know a secret key shouldn't go in the code. Where should I put it?
zhQuote: 密钥不能直接写进代码里，那应该放哪？

name: Deployment
title: Deployment
description: Build the project and make it available on a server · Deployment turns source code into a running website or service. It may install dependencies, build assets, set environment variables, start processes, and connect a domain. A repeatable deployment includes logs, health checks, and a way to return to a known working version. Know first Terminal npm Env Var Domain
zhDescription: 把项目发布到目标环境运行，使目标用户或其他系统可以正常访问 · 例如平台取得项目文件后，生成可运行的网页或启动服务，再放到测试地址、内部地址或公开网址。发布前要确认发往哪里、怎样启动和需要哪些设置；失败时先查看系统记录的报错。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal npm 环境变量 Env Var 域名 Domain
quote: I finished the site. How do I make it available at a URL that other people can open?
zhQuote: 我做好了，怎么才能让别人用一个网址就能打开我的页面？

name: Web Hosting
title: Web Hosting
description: A service that continuously stores and serves website files or a running environment · A page that works locally still needs a public environment that can serve it continuously. Web hosting provides that environment for files or a running service; deployment is the one-time action of publishing a version into it. They are related but not the same. Know first Deployment Domain DNS
zhDescription: 持续保存并向用户提供网站文件或运行环境的服务 · 本地能打开的页面还没有公网承载环境，别人就无法持续访问。网站托管负责让文件或服务在公网环境中持续提供内容；Deployment 是把某个版本发布进去的一次动作，两者不是同一个概念。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 域名 Domain DNS
quote: Confirm that this project has hosting that can continuously serve the site, then deploy it publicly. Do not treat localhost as live.
zhQuote: 请确认这个项目有能持续提供网页的托管环境，再部署到公网，不要把 localhost 当成已经上线。

name: CD
zhName: 持续交付 / 持续部署
title: CD
zhTitle: 持续交付 / 持续部署
description: CD keeps verified versions continuously releasable, or releases them to production automatically under defined rules. · Continuous delivery keeps a version through the pipeline and ready to release, with a possible human approval before production. Continuous deployment automatically releases to production after gates pass. Both are more than “tests run automatically”; the key difference is whether production keeps a human approval. Know first CI Deployment
zhDescription: 持续交付和持续部署，是把检查通过的版本继续送往可访问地址的两种做法。 · 持续交付会把版本准备好，仍由人决定何时正式发布；持续部署会在检查通过后自动正式发布。两者的差别是，正式发布前是否保留人工确认。 先知道 持续集成 CI 部署上线 Deployment
quote: Send this CI-passing version to testing first; production needs human approval unless we explicitly choose continuous deployment.
zhQuote: 检查通过的版本先送到测试地址；正式发布前保留人工确认，除非团队明确要自动发布。

name: Staging
title: Staging
description: Staging is an isolated pre-production environment used to validate a candidate release under production-like conditions. · A candidate version can run in staging with separate services, test payment, and de-identified orders so the team can check a full deployed flow. Staging is one kind of test environment, not a name for every local, CI-ephemeral, or test URL; its defining role is production-like validation before production. Know first Deployment Env Var
zhDescription: 预发布环境是在生产发布前，用接近生产的配置验证候选版本的独立环境。 · 例如同一版改动可先放到预发布地址，连接独立服务、使用不含真人信息的订单完成测试，再从这里验收。它是测试环境的一种，但不是每个本机环境或测试网址都算预发布环境。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 环境变量 Env Var
quote: Deploy the candidate to staging with production-like configuration and de-identified order data; do not run destructive verification in production.
zhQuote: 先把候选版本部署到和生产配置接近的预发布环境，用脱敏数据走完流程，别直接碰生产。

name: Monitoring
title: Monitoring
description: Monitoring continuously observes production metrics, logs, and alerts to find anomalies and judge system health. · A login error rate can cross a threshold, trigger an alert, and connect its time window, request logs, and running version. This provides signals from real use after release. One test report only records some checks at one time and cannot replace production monitoring. Know first Deployment Server Logs
zhDescription: 监控是持续采集和观察生产指标、日志与告警，以发现异常并判断系统健康。 · 例如新版本发布后持续观察错误率、请求延迟和预订成功率，越过阈值时通知负责人并关联版本。一次测试报告只说明当时的检查结果，不能替代上线后的持续信号。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 服务端日志 Server Logs
quote: After release, monitor login error rate and checkout success rate; alert above a threshold and show which version was running then.
zhQuote: 上线后盯住错误率和请求延迟，超过阈值就告警，并标出是哪个版本开始异常。

name: Rollback
title: Rollback
description: Rollback restores a system or configuration to a previous known-good state to stop current impact. · If v2 causes abnormal login errors, switch the running image or configuration back to v1 and check the live version, login result, and error rate recover. It aims to reduce impact first. Fixing the issue and shipping a new version later is a forward fix, not rollback. Know first Deployment Monitoring
zhDescription: 回滚是把系统或配置恢复到先前已知可用状态，以停止新版本造成的影响。 · 例如 v2 上线后错误率明显上升，可以把流量切回 v1，再检查线上版本和关键指标是否恢复。修好代码后发布 v3 属于向前修复；关闭功能开关也不一定改变部署版本。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 监控 Monitoring
quote: When a new version sends login error rate sharply up, roll back to the last known-good version; then confirm both running version and metrics recover.
zhQuote: 新版本让预订失败率升高，先切回上一版，并确认版本号和错误率真的恢复。

name: Feature Flag
title: Feature Flag
description: A feature flag enables or disables a code path at runtime according to configuration or user conditions. · The same deployed code can send employees to a new recommendation page while other people stay on the old path; closing the flag stops the new path on anomaly. It separates deploying code from deciding who gets a feature. Permanently deleting code or restoring a whole old version is not a feature flag itself. Know first Deployment State
zhDescription: 功能开关是运行时按配置或用户条件启用、停用代码路径的机制。 · 例如同一版本已经包含新编辑器，但开关只让内部账号进入新路径，其他用户继续看到旧页面。它把代码部署与功能开放分开；长期不用的开关仍要清理，也不能代替版本回滚和数据恢复。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 状态 State
quote: Open the new recommendation feature to employees first; if error rate rises, turn off the new path immediately without redeploying.
zhQuote: 新行程编辑器先只给内部同事看，出问题时不用重新部署就能立刻关闭。

name: Canary Release
title: Canary Release
description: A canary release exposes a new version to a small amount of real traffic before health signals decide whether to expand or stop. · Checkout v2 can serve 5% of requests while stable v1 keeps the other 95%; if v2 crosses its error threshold, its traffic returns to v1. This limits exposure to a release version. It is not merely switching one feature on or off inside the same release. Know first Deployment Monitoring
zhDescription: 金丝雀发布是先把新版本交给少量真实流量验证，再根据健康信号扩大或停止的发布策略。 · 例如结账服务 v2 先承接 5% 请求，其余 95% 仍由 v1 处理；若 v2 错误率越过阈值，就停止扩大并把流量退回 v1。它限制的是版本发布范围，不等于只开关某一个功能。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 监控 Monitoring
quote: Send 5% of users to the new release first; expand only while error rate stays healthy, and return to the stable release on anomaly.
zhQuote: 先让 5% 用户使用新版本，错误率正常再逐步扩大，异常就立刻退回稳定版。

name: Blue-Green Deployment
title: Blue-Green Deployment
description: Blue-green deployment runs old and new releases in two production-capable environments, then switches traffic after the candidate environment is verified. · Blue can keep travel site v1 live while green independently runs v2; after login and booking checks pass, the production entry switches to green and blue remains temporarily available for return. Two application environments do not automatically isolate or make the database compatible. Know first Deployment Staging
zhDescription: 蓝绿部署是用两套都能承载生产的环境运行新旧版本，验证候选环境后再切换流量的部署策略。 · 例如蓝色环境运行旅游站 v1，绿色环境独立部署 v2；登录和预订检查通过后，生产入口才从蓝切到绿，并暂留蓝色环境用于回退。两套应用环境不代表数据库也自动隔离或兼容。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 预发布环境 Staging
quote: Keep blue serving while deploying and accepting the new release on green; switch production traffic only after it passes.
zhQuote: 先让蓝色环境继续服务，在绿色环境部署并验收新版本，通过后再切生产流量。

name: Serverless
title: Serverless
description: Run backend code on demand without managing a long-running server · A serverless function is deployed to a managed platform and starts when an HTTP request, schedule, or event triggers it. It reduces server operations for small independent tasks, but runtime limits, cold starts, regions, and stateless execution still shape the design. Know first Backend Env Var Deployment
zhDescription: Serverless 是让云平台按需要运行后端代码、免去自己维护服务器的一种方式。 · 例如用户提交联系表单后，云平台按这次提交运行一段代码，保存内容并发送通知。它不是没有服务器，而是服务器由平台管理；运行多久、能否保留内容和怎样收费仍受平台规则限制。 先知道 后端 Backend 环境变量 Env Var 部署上线 Deployment
quote: I only have a small feature. Is there a way to run code on demand without buying or managing a server?
zhQuote: 我就一个小功能，不想买服务器也不想运维，有没有按次跑代码的？

name: Server Logs
title: Server Logs
description: Record what the server did so problems can be traced · Server logs capture requests, errors, background jobs, and important state changes. Useful logs include time, severity, and a request or job identifier. Avoid recording passwords, tokens, and unnecessary personal data, and connect related events so one failure can be followed across services. Know first Backend Terminal
zhDescription: 记录后端运行时发生了什么，主要用来查找失败原因 · 例如用户提交订单时出现服务器错误；如果记录了关键步骤，日志可以帮助判断是保存数据还是检查权限出了问题。日志要保留时间和必要线索，但不能记录密码、登录凭证或完整个人资料。 先知道 后端 Backend 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: There's an error in production. Where can I see what happened on the server?
zhQuote: 线上报错了，我想知道服务器那边到底发生了什么，去哪看？

name: Circuit Breaker
title: Circuit Breaker
description: A circuit breaker cuts off a repeatedly failing dependency, fails fast or degrades, and probes recovery later · When a checkout page calls a payment dependency that keeps timing out, continuing to wait and retry can exhaust the caller's threads and request queue. A breaker moves through Closed, Open, and Half-Open: normal calls pass while Closed; repeated failures open it for fast failure or fallback; a later limited probe tests recovery, returning to Closed on success or Open on failure. It is different from one timeout or retry and cannot repair the dependency.
zhDescription: 当外部依赖连续失败时主动切断调用并快速返回降级结果，避免自身被拖垮，并在稍后自动探测恢复的保护机制。 · 例如结算页面调用第三方支付连续超时，继续盲目等待会耗尽自己的线程与连接。熔断器借用了电路断路器的物理机制：正常时保持通路（Closed/闭合）；连续失败达到阈值后切断通路（Open/断开开路）并快速返回降级结果；等待一段时间后进入半开路（Half-Open）放少量请求探测，成功则重新闭合通路，失败则再次断开。它不同于单次超时或重试，也不能修好依赖本身。
quote: The payment dependency keeps timing out. Stop making every request wait, fail fast or degrade, and probe it again after a pause.
zhQuote: 支付依赖连续超时后别让所有请求继续等，先快速失败或降级，过一会儿再探测它是否恢复。

name: Single-Instance Deployment
title: Single-Instance Deployment
description: Single-instance deployment keeps exactly one running replica of a service in its environment. · A background service with a replica count of 1 sends requests to one running instance. A release or crash restart can make it briefly unavailable, and in-memory work that was not written to durable storage may be lost. Single-instance deployment is not the Singleton pattern and does not mean data cannot be durable: it describes the number of runtime replicas, while a database or other durable store can exist separately. Know first Deployment Database
zhDescription: 在运行环境中仅为某个服务保留单个运行副本，所有流量由该唯一实例处理的部署形态。 · 例如后台服务配置副本数为 1，所有请求暂时由同一个实例处理；发布或崩溃触发重启时，服务可能短暂不可用，未写入持久存储的内存任务也可能丢失。单实例不是单例模式，也不等于数据不能持久化：它描述运行副本数量，数据库或其他持久存储仍可独立存在。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 数据库 Database
quote: Run this service as one instance and explain the short outage during restart, while separating in-memory task risk from durable data.
zhQuote: 这个服务先只跑一个实例，重启时会短暂不可用；请把内存里的任务风险和可持久化的数据分开说明。

name: Multi-Instance Deployment
title: Multi-Instance Deployment
description: Multi-instance deployment runs multiple instances of the same service that receive requests together. · A load balancer can send requests to instance-a and instance-b, so another instance can serve traffic when one restarts. If a login session lives only in one instance's local memory, a user may be logged out after the next request reaches another instance; the state must be shared or externalized. Multiple instances can improve service redundancy and throughput, but they do not automatically make a database highly available or solve concurrency coordination and consistency. Know first Deployment Monitoring Single-Instance Deployment
zhDescription: 让同一个后端服务同时运行多个对等的运行副本，并通过负载均衡共同承载流量与提供容灾冗余的部署形态。 · 例如负载均衡把请求分给 instance-a 和 instance-b，某个实例重启时其他实例仍可接收请求。若登录会话只放在某个实例的本地内存，用户下一次被分到另一个实例就可能掉登录，因此需要共享或外置状态。多实例可以改善服务层冗余和吞吐，但不会自动让数据库高可用，也不会自动解决并发协调和数据一致性。 先知道 部署上线 Deployment 监控 Monitoring 单实例部署 Single-Instance Deployment
quote: Run several instances to share requests, but keep users logged in when their next request reaches another instance.
zhQuote: 把这个服务跑成多个实例分担请求，但用户换到另一个实例也要保持登录，不能只把进程数量加上去。

name: Stack Trace
title: Stack Trace
description: The position list printed when a program fails, ordered from the failure point back to the entry · In JavaScript and Node.js, a stack trace commonly lists the frame nearest the throw near the top, followed by its callers. Start near the top and find a frame in your own file; it gives a location clue, not proof of the root cause. Know first Terminal
zhDescription: 程序报错时列出的函数调用位置，通常从抛错帧开始，再列调用者 · JavaScript 抛出异常时，调用栈通常先列离抛错点最近的函数，再列它的调用者。先在顶部附近找属于自己文件的帧，再结合代码和数据检查原因；栈给出位置线索，不单独证明根因。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: The terminal printed a long error. Which line should I send to the AI?
zhQuote: 终端里报了一大段错，我该把哪一行发给 AI？

name: Timeout
title: Timeout
description: The maximum time to wait for a result before giving up and reporting failure · When a save action ends in 'Request timed out', the page has reached a wait limit; this does not prove the request failed to arrive or the server crashed. Check whether the timeout happened during connection, sending, or waiting for the response, then distinguish it from rate limiting or invalid input. Know first HTTP Rate Limit
zhDescription: 一次操作等待结果的上限时间，超过后主动放弃并报告失败，而不是一直等下去 · 点击保存后页面等待到上限并报告超时，不等于服务端已停止处理或数据肯定没写入。本页例子假设请求已抵达服务端；其他超时也可能发生在连接、发送或读取阶段。重试前先确认这次操作的服务端结果，避免重复提交。 先知道 HTTP 速率限制 Rate Limit
quote: I clicked save and it spins forever, then says the request timed out. Is it the network or the server?
zhQuote: 点了保存一直在转圈，等了半分钟才说超时，是网不好还是服务器坏了？

name: User Story
title: User Story
description: A brief requirement that states who needs what and why from the user's perspective · A traveler may need to save an unfinished itinerary so they can continue on another device. A user story starts a requirements conversation but does not replace interaction details, acceptance criteria, or technical design.
zhDescription: 以“角色 + 诉求 + 价值”为结构，从真实用户视角描述功能预期的需求表达框架。 · 例如，旅行者需要保存未完成的行程，以便换一台设备后继续编辑。用户故事为需求讨论提供起点，但不会替代交互细节、验收标准或技术方案。
quote: Before listing features, explain who has the problem, what they need, and why it matters.
zhQuote: 先别直接列功能，写清楚是谁遇到了什么问题，解决以后有什么用。

name: Use Case
title: Use Case
description: A description of the main interaction and important exceptions between an actor and a system while reaching a goal · For an order refund, a use case states eligibility, what the customer submits, how the system responds, and how expired or duplicate requests end. It describes observable behavior without prescribing internal code. Know first User Story
zhDescription: 描述参与者为达成目标与系统交互时的正常路径和重要例外 · 例如，顾客申请订单退款时，用例会写清申请条件、顾客提交什么、系统怎样回应，以及超期或已经退款时怎样结束。它描述外部可观察行为，不规定内部代码如何实现。 先知道 用户故事 User Story
quote: Write the refund request end to end: how the customer starts, how the system responds, and what failure looks like.
zhQuote: 把申请退款这件事写完整：用户怎么发起，系统怎么回应，失败时会看到什么。

name: User Flow
title: User Flow
description: A path diagram of the steps and branches a user takes to reach one goal · A sign-up flow might show entering the sign-up page, filling in details, verification success or failure, and account creation. It keeps the steps that affect progress, not every click on the screen. Know first PRD
zhDescription: 画出用户从入口到完成目标所经过步骤和分支的路径图 · 例如，注册流程可以包含进入注册页、填写资料、验证码成功或失败，以及完成注册。它只保留影响用户前进的关键步骤，不必画出页面里的每一次点击。 先知道 PRD
quote: Map out every step a user takes from arriving on the site to finishing checkout.
zhQuote: 帮我画一下，用户从进来到完成下单，中间都经过哪几步。

name: User Journey
title: User Journey
description: A staged view of a user's actions, thoughts, feelings, and obstacles across touchpoints while pursuing a goal · A learner might discover a course through a friend, visit its page, pay, receive an email, and enter the first lesson. A user journey needs interview or behavioral evidence and must not present team assumptions as real feelings. Know first User Flow
zhDescription: 按阶段记录用户跨触点完成目标时的行动、想法、感受和阻碍 · 例如，学习者可能从朋友分享发现课程，经过介绍页、付款、邮件和应用内引导才开始第一课。用户旅程应以访谈或行为数据为依据，不能把团队猜测写成真实感受。 先知道 用户流程 User Flow
quote: Map the whole experience from first hearing about the product to actually using it, including where people get stuck.
zhQuote: 别只画网站里的点击步骤，把用户从第一次听说到真正开始使用的整个过程和卡住的地方整理出来。

name: Persona
title: Persona
description: An evidence-based model of a target user's behavior, goals, and concerns · When writing homepage copy, a team can synthesize interview or usage notes: freelance designers want potential clients to see their work quickly, and they worry about building and maintaining a site. A persona makes those goals, behavior, and concerns a reference for checking whether the homepage offers a portfolio and an easy way to start. It remains a model to validate; demographic details without evidence are not facts. Know first User Story
zhDescription: 把目标用户的行为、目标和顾虑整理成可讨论的代表性模型 · 准备首页文案时，团队可以从访谈或使用记录里归纳：独立设计师希望客户快速看到作品，也担心自己不会搭建和维护网站。把这组目标、行为与顾虑整理成用户画像，便能检查首页是否给出了作品展示入口和容易开始的做法。画像是基于证据形成、仍需验证的模型；没有依据的人口特征不能当作事实。 先知道 用户故事 User Story
quote: This page feels too generic. Which customer should I write it for?
zhQuote: 这个页面到底该写给谁看？

name: PRD
title: PRD
description: A product document that defines the user problem, scope, and success criteria · Before a team builds one-click meeting-notes export, a PRD explains who needs it, what this release includes, and how the team will know it worked. It aligns product, design, and engineering without locking every technical detail.
zhDescription: 系统阐述产品背景、用户价值、功能范围与验收标准的结构化需求文档。 · 例如，做注册功能前，PRD 会写清它服务谁、这次包含哪些能力，以及怎样判断上线有效。它帮助产品、设计和开发对齐，但不需要提前写死每个技术细节。
quote: Help me spell out what I'm building for the AI: the problem it solves and what counts as done.
zhQuote: 我想把要做的东西写清楚给 AI：解决什么问题、做到什么程度算完。

name: Product Discovery
title: Product Discovery
description: The exploration process of collecting user and business evidence to validate whether a problem is real, valuable, and feasible before committing to full development. · Suppose a team wants to build a prompt-result comparison tool. Discovery turns 'creators need comparisons' into a testable assumption, then gathers evidence from recent real stories and a low-fidelity task. The evidence may support continuing, narrowing, changing direction, or stopping. Discovery reduces early uncertainty; it does not guarantee product success. Know first User Story User Flow PRD
zhDescription: 在投入完整开发之前，通过收集用户与业务证据，验证问题是否真实存在、方案是否具备价值和可行性的探索过程。 · 例如团队想做一个“提示词结果对比工具”。产品发现不会先把完整功能写出来，而是把“创作者经常需要对比结果”写成假设，通过最近一次真实操作的访谈记录和低保真原型观察来收集证据。结果可能支持继续，也可能要求缩小范围、改换问题或暂时停止；它降低早期押错方向的风险，不保证产品上线后一定成功。 先知道 用户故事 User Story 用户流程 User Flow PRD
quote: Don't have AI start coding features yet. Let's do product discovery first to see whether users actually care about this problem.
zhQuote: 先别让 AI 把整套功能写出来，我们先确认用户真的遇到这个问题，再用最小的测试决定继续、缩小还是停止。

name: MVP
title: MVP
description: The smallest real product or experiment that tests a key product assumption · To test whether freelancers will pay for payment reminders, a team can charge real customers and deliver the reminders manually first. An MVP gathers decision-worthy evidence; it is not a carelessly stripped-down full product. Know first PRD
zhDescription: 以最低成本构建核心可用闭环、用于验证核心业务假设的产品最小原型版本。 · 例如，想验证用户是否愿意付费时，可以先向目标用户收取真实费用，再用人工方式完成提醒服务。MVP 要取得能支持决定的真实证据，不是把完整产品随便删减后上线。 先知道 PRD
quote: Let's start with the smallest version that proves the core feature works instead of building everything at once.
zhQuote: 先做最小的一版试试水，核心功能跑通就行，别一上来全做。

name: Product Backlog
title: Product Backlog
description: A dynamic, ordered list of features, fixes, and improvements that a product may need next · When a trip app receives both a payment incident and a map-export idea, the team can reorder items using product goals, risk, and new evidence. Items near the top are usually clearer, but backlog inclusion does not promise a date or delivery. Know first PRD
zhDescription: 按顺序维护产品未来可能需要完成的功能、修复和改进的动态清单 · 例如，行程应用收到支付故障和地图导出建议后，会根据产品目标、风险和新证据重新排列条目。靠前内容通常更清楚，但进入列表不代表已经承诺日期或一定交付。 先知道 PRD
quote: Put these requests and problems into an ordered backlog, but do not treat every item as a delivery promise.
zhQuote: 把这些需求和问题整理成待办列表，先按重要程度排好，但别把每一项都当成已经答应上线。

name: Product Roadmap
title: Product Roadmap
description: A dynamic plan that communicates product goals, priorities, and expected outcomes across time horizons · A trip product might use Now for reliable saving, Next for collaborative editing, and Later for testing automatic planning. A roadmap communicates direction and tradeoffs; distant work rarely supports exact date commitments. Know first Product Backlog
zhDescription: 按时间范围表达产品目标、重点方向和预期成果的动态计划 · 例如，行程产品可以把“先解决保存可靠性、再改善同行协作、以后探索自动规划”放入 Now、Next、Later。路线图说明方向与取舍，较远内容通常不适合承诺精确日期。 先知道 产品待办列表 Product Backlog
quote: Turn the next few stages into a roadmap that explains why and what to improve, without scheduling daily development tasks.
zhQuote: 把接下来几个阶段为什么做、重点解决什么整理成路线图，先别排成每天的开发任务。

name: Gantt Chart
title: Gantt Chart
description: A schedule chart that uses timeline bars to show task dates, duration, milestones, and dependencies · A release can require interaction design before development and testing. If development moves, dependent testing and the launch milestone move too. A Gantt chart exposes schedule impact, but unknown durations should not become invented dates. Know first Product Roadmap
zhDescription: 用时间轴横条展示任务起止时间、持续周期、里程碑和依赖关系的排期图 · 例如，版本发布可以先完成交互设计，再开发并测试；开发延期会推动依赖它的测试和发布日期。甘特图适合检查排期影响，但未知工期不能被伪装成精确日期。 先知道 产品路线图 Product Roadmap
quote: Put design, development, testing, and launch on a timeline with dependencies, and show what a delay changes.
zhQuote: 把设计、开发、测试和上线排到时间轴上，标出谁依赖谁，延期以后也要看得出后面会受什么影响。

name: Wireframe
title: Wireframe
description: A wireframe is the page skeleton drawn in gray blocks and placeholder lines—it fixes "what goes where" before any colors or fonts. · Sketch the page in gray blocks first: how tall the header is, what sits in the hero, where the button goes. With positions settled, colors and fonts can be adjusted without reworking the layout. The wireframe fixes positions; the visual design handles colors and fonts. Know first Hero
zhDescription: 线框图是用灰块和占位线画出的页面骨架——只定「哪里放什么」，不谈颜色和字体。 · 先在纸上或让 AI 画一个灰块版页面：页头多高、首屏放什么、按钮在哪，都只用方框和文字标出。位置先在灰块上定下来，之后再上颜色和字体，需要改动的范围就小得多。线框负责定位置，视觉稿负责颜色和字体。 先知道 首屏 Hero
quote: Hold off on colors—sketch a gray page skeleton first: header, hero, three cards, footer, just the positions.
zhQuote: 先别急着上颜色，帮我画个灰色的页面骨架：页头、首屏、三张卡片、页脚，位置排好就行。

name: Moodboard
title: Moodboard
