description: A moodboard collects reference images, colors, and keywords on one board—align on "what feeling" before building the page. · "Make it premium" or "give it breathing room" rarely means the same thing to you and the AI. Collect five or six screenshots you like, one or two you dislike, and the main color, then send the collage—working from pictures lands far closer than adjectives. Fixing a wrong direction at the collage stage means swapping a reference; after the page is built, it means redoing the work.
zhDescription: 情绪板是开工前把参考图、配色和关键词拼在一张板上——先对齐「想要什么感觉」，再动手做页面。 · 「高级一点」「有呼吸感」这类形容词，你和 AI 的理解经常对不上。先收集三五张你喜欢的网站截图、一两张不喜欢的，加上想要的主色，拼成一张图发给 AI——它照着做，比靠形容词描述准得多。选错方向的成本在拼图阶段最低：换一张参考图就行，做完再改要动的地方多得多。
quote: Here are my references: the three I like set the feel, the crossed-out one is what to avoid. Style the site this way.
zhQuote: 我拼了几张参考图：这三张是喜欢的感觉，那张标了叉的别学。照这个方向给官网配色。

name: Scope Creep
title: Scope Creep
description: New requests continually enter agreed project work without being evaluated · You ask AI to make the login button blue, then notice that the header and card shadow changed too. Those changes were never discussed, yet they have entered this delivery. A new request can become part of the scope after it is recorded and evaluated; scope creep is the unassessed addition of work to the current plan. Know first MVP
zhDescription: 项目执行时，未经评估的新要求不断混进已约定的工作范围 · 你请 AI 把登录按钮改成蓝色，检查页面时却发现页头标题和卡片阴影也变了：这两项没有经过讨论，却已经混进这次交付。把新需求单独记录并评估后，它可以成为新的正式范围；只有没经过这个判断、直接不断加进当前工作时，才叫范围蔓延。 先知道 MVP
quote: I asked AI to make only the login button blue, but the header and card shadow also changed. How should I review that?
zhQuote: 我只让 AI 改登录按钮颜色，页面其他地方也变了，该怎么验收？

name: Technical Debt
title: Technical Debt
description: A usable implementation choice that leaves structural issues adding to later change work · When five pages each keep a copy of the login-button style, changing its color means editing five places; missing one leaves the pages inconsistent. This duplication makes later edits easier to miss. After moving the style into one shared component, you still need to check every page. Technical debt describes a maintenance burden to weigh; it does not mean every duplicate must be rewritten now or will inevitably cost more over time. Know first Component
zhDescription: 当前可用的实现方式留下了会增加后续改动负担的结构问题 · 五个页面各自保存了一份登录按钮样式时，想统一改颜色就得改五处，漏掉一处会让页面看起来不一致。这类重复会让后续改动更容易遗漏；将样式收进一个共享组件后，还要逐页检查按钮外观。技术债描述的是需要权衡的维护负担，不代表每种重复都必须立刻重写，也不保证拖久一定更贵。 先知道 组件 Component
quote: Five pages each have a copy of the button style, and one was missed during a color change. What does that show?
zhQuote: 五页各自有一份按钮样式，改颜色时漏了一页，这说明了什么？

name: Prototype
title: Prototype
description: A clickable interface model for walking through page order, branches, and recovery paths · Before a booking page connects to a service, a clickable prototype can take the team from time selection through details and then to a success or failure branch. It helps check whether the paths are complete, but a simulated booking number or confirmation cannot prove a slot is available or an order was saved. Know first Wireframe
zhDescription: 用可点击的界面模型走查页面顺序、分支和返回路径 · 预约页还没接服务端时，可以先做一份能从选时段走到填写资料、再走到成功或失败分支的可点击原型。它帮助团队检查路径是否完整，但显示的预约编号和提交结果只是模拟内容，不能证明时段真实可订或订单已保存。 先知道 线框图 Wireframe
quote: Make a clickable prototype to confirm the flow before writing code.
zhQuote: 先做个能点的原型确认流程，再写代码。

name: Heuristic Evaluation
title: Heuristic Evaluation
description: A usability inspection method where evaluators systematically check an interface against established design principles to identify interaction defects. · An evaluator edits a nickname in Settings and clicks Save. With no saving state or result message, the issue is recorded under visibility of system status with its location, reproduction steps, impact, and recommendation. After the fix, the same task is repeated to verify visible progress and outcome. Heuristic evaluation can reveal likely issues early, but it does not replace testing with real target users. Know first User Journey Acceptance Criteria A/B Test
zhDescription: 让评估者依据一组可用性经验原则，逐项检查界面中可能妨碍用户完成任务的问题。 · 例如评估者在设置页修改昵称并点击保存，发现按钮没有“保存中”状态，成功后也没有结果提示，于是把问题记录为“系统状态不可见”，写明位置、复现步骤、用户影响和建议。修复后再走一次同样任务，确认等待和结果都能看见。启发式评估能较早发现明显问题，但不能代替真实目标用户的可用性测试。 先知道 用户旅程 User Journey 验收标准 Acceptance Criteria A/B 测试 A/B Test
quote: Don't just say this interface 'feels clunky'. Run through Nielsen's usability heuristics to pinpoint whether status is hidden, error prevention is missing, or terminology is confusing.
zhQuote: 别只说这个设置页‘用着别扭’，请指出问题出现在哪里、违反哪条可用性原则、会让用户做错什么，以及修复后怎样复查。

name: A/B Test
title: A/B Test
description: An experiment that randomly assigns eligible users to variants and compares them using predefined metrics · Eligible new visitors can be randomly shown one of two sign-up pages during the same period, then compared on completion rate. A before-and-after comparison or changing metrics mid-test does not provide the same causal evidence. Know first MVP
zhDescription: 把符合条件的用户随机分到不同版本，并用预先确定的指标比较结果的实验方法 · 例如，同一时期的新访客可以随机看到两个注册页版本，再比较注册完成率。只比较改版前后数据，或测试中途不断更换指标，都不能提供同等可靠的因果证据。 先知道 MVP
quote: Do not choose between these sign-up pages by taste. Randomly split users and compare the same metric.
zhQuote: 两个注册页别凭感觉选，把用户随机分组，用同一个指标比较哪个版本更有效。

name: Conversion Funnel
title: Conversion Funnel
description: A sequence of user counts and conversion rates that locates drop-off from entry to a target outcome · Out of 1,000 visitors, 620 may start sign-up, 310 submit details, and 280 finish. A funnel shows how many remain at each step. Mismatched event definitions, time windows, or user scopes can make the shape misleading. Know first User Flow
zhDescription: 按既定步骤统计用户数量和转化比例，用来发现从入口到目标结果之间的流失位置 · 例如，1,000 名访客中有 620 人开始注册、310 人提交资料、280 人完成注册，漏斗可以显示每一步留下多少人。事件定义、时间范围和用户口径不一致时，漏斗形状会误导判断。 先知道 用户流程 User Flow
quote: Turn visits, sign-up starts, profile submissions, and completions into a funnel to find the largest drop-off.
zhQuote: 把访问、开始注册、提交资料和注册完成的人数排成漏斗，看看用户主要在哪一步流失。

name: CRUD
title: CRUD
description: CRUD is the four basic operations repeatedly performed on one kind of data: create, read, update, and delete. · For a client quote list: tapping "new" adds a quote (create), opening the list shows every record (read), changing an amount or status is an update, and removing a record is a delete. These four cover the backbone of managing data; exports and charts are extra features built on top, not one of the four. Know first Table Field
zhDescription: 增删改查是对同一类数据反复做的四种基本操作：创建、读取、更新和删除。 · 例如一个客户报价列表：点「新建」添加一条报价是创建，打开列表看到每条记录是读取，改某条的金额或状态是更新，删掉不要的记录是删除。这四种操作覆盖了管理数据的主干；导出报表、统计图表是建立在数据之上的扩展功能，不属于其中任何一种。 先知道 表格 Table 字段 Field
quote: Build me a client quote list: add new ones, edit amount and status, delete rows, and show all records on open.
zhQuote: 帮我做一个客户报价列表，能新增、能改金额和状态、能删除，打开就能看到全部记录。

name: Field
title: Field
description: A field is one standalone piece of information in a record, such as client name, amount, or date. · One client quote consists of four fields: client name, amount, status, and date. Before building a tool, splitting "what I want to record" into a field list matters more than sketching pages: the list drives the form, the list view, and validation. The field is the information itself; the input is just the control for filling it in. Know first Form
zhDescription: 字段是一条记录里单独的一项信息，比如客户名、金额或日期。 · 例如一条客户报价由客户名、金额、跟进状态和日期四个字段组成。做工具前先把「想记什么」拆成字段清单，是比画页面更重要的第一步：清单定了，表单、列表和校验就有了依据。字段指信息本身，输入框只是填写它的控件。 先知道 表单 Form
quote: Each quote should record client name, amount, date, and status—just these four, nothing more for now.
zhQuote: 我想记录每条报价的客户名、金额、日期和跟进状态，就这四项，先不要加别的。

name: Data Type
title: Data Type
description: A data type is the format agreement for one piece of information: text, number, date, or an on/off value. · If the amount field is a number type, phones show a numeric keyboard and records can be summed; stored as text, it can neither compare nor total. A date type opens a date picker and enables time sorting. The type fixes the format before entry, while validation checks at submit—two things that happen in order. Know first Field
zhDescription: 数据类型是一条信息的格式约定：文字、数字、日期还是开关值。 · 例如「金额」字段的类型是数字，输入时会弹数字键盘，多条记录能求和；如果当成文字存，就比较不了大小也算不出总额。「日期」用日期类型，手机会弹日期选择器，还能按时间排序。类型在填写前就定好了格式，校验是提交时的检查，两件事先后发生。 先知道 字段 Field
quote: The amount column is stored as text and cannot be summed. Change it to a number type, and switch date to a real date picker.
zhQuote: 金额那栏存的是文字，没办法求和，帮我把它改成数字类型，日期也换成真正的日期选择。

name: Import & Export
title: Import & Export
description: Import and export move data in bulk: export saves records into files like CSV or Excel, import turns a file back into records. · Export 200 quotes as a CSV for the accountant, and import the edited file back—data moves between tools as files. Both operate on whole batches, not single records. If Excel shows garbled Chinese, it is usually an encoding problem; ask the AI to re-export as UTF-8. Know first CRUD Table
zhDescription: 导入导出是把数据整批搬进或搬出：导出存成 CSV、Excel 这样的文件，导入把文件变回一条条记录。 · 例如把 200 条报价记录导出成 CSV 发给会计，会计改完再导回来——数据以文件的形式在工具之间搬家。导出和导入操作的是整批数据，不是单条记录。用 Excel 打开发现中文全是乱码，多半是编码问题，让 AI 改用 UTF-8 重新导出就行。 先知道 增删改查 CRUD 表格 Table
quote: Add an export button to the quote list that downloads all records as a CSV that opens cleanly in Excel.
zhQuote: 帮我在报价列表加一个导出按钮，把全部记录存成 CSV 文件下载，用 Excel 打开中文不乱码。

name: Event Tracking
title: Event Tracking
description: A record of a page action sent to an analytics tool when the action occurs · To count clicks on Start trial, a developer can create a start_trial event in the click handler and add parameters such as the page source. A click means the event was triggered; analytics code must still send it and the platform must receive it before it appears in a debug or real-time view. A received event does not mean the aggregated report is complete. Know first Conversion Funnel
zhDescription: 在页面动作发生时记录事件，并把事件数据交给统计工具 · 要统计首页“立即试用”按钮的点击次数，开发者会在点击处理里生成名为 start_trial 的事件，并带上页面来源等参数。用户点击只代表事件被触发；它还需要由统计代码发送，并被平台接收，才会出现在调试或实时视图里。埋点能记录设定过的动作，但单条事件不代表报表已汇总完成。 先知道 转化漏斗 Conversion Funnel
quote: I want to know whether anyone actually clicks this button.
zhQuote: 我想知道这个按钮到底有没有人点。

name: Regex
title: Regex
description: A notation for describing text to match, search, or constrain · A regular expression describes text patterns for matching, searching, or constraining an input, such as \d for digits and + for one or more. This page uses JavaScript regex syntax to constrain a numeric-text field; a match only means the text fits this rule, not that a phone number or email is valid. Know first Validation
zhDescription: 用一串符号描述要匹配的文字，可用于查找或限制输入格式 · 在输入框限制文本格式或查找某类内容时，正则表达式用符号描述要匹配的文字，例如 \d 代表数字、+ 代表一个以上。本页用 JavaScript 正则校验纯数字文本；匹配通过只说明符合这条文字规则，不代表手机号、邮箱等业务信息有效。 先知道 数据校验 Validation
quote: AI gave me a regex I cannot read. Should I use it?
zhQuote: AI 给了一段正则，我看不懂该不该用？

name: Acceptance Criteria
title: Acceptance Criteria
description: Acceptance criteria are checkable conditions that determine whether a result is acceptable. · For an itinerary, saving can show the trip, refresh can keep it, and an end date before the start date can explain how to correct it. This turns “mostly done” into observable results. Code coverage or framework choice alone cannot prove the user need is complete. Know first PRD
zhDescription: 验收标准是用来判断成果是否满足要求的一组明确可检查的结果条件。 · 例如旅行攻略可以要求“每天都有路线、景点开放时间来自官方来源、换乘时间能够实际执行”。这些条件应能直接判通过或不通过；代码覆盖率和开发者自评可以提供线索，但不能替代用户结果。 先知道 PRD
quote: Write clear acceptance criteria for the itinerary feature: saving shows the trip, refresh keeps it, and invalid dates explain how to fix them.
zhQuote: 先把这个旅行攻略怎么算完成写清楚：每天有路线、交通时间和官方开放信息，缺一项就不能验收。

name: Test Case
title: Test Case
description: A test case is one repeatable check that states preparation, action, input, and expected result. · Prepare a registered account, enter its email with a wrong password, submit, and expect an explanation without entering the account page. This lets people or automation check the same thing. “Test login” is a test plan, not one executable case. Know first Acceptance Criteria
zhDescription: 测试用例是写明前置条件、操作步骤、输入和预期结果的一次可重复检查。 · 例如先准备一个已注册账号，再输入错误密码并点击登录，预期页面拒绝进入且在密码框附近说明原因。测试计划安排的是整体范围和资源，不是某一次具体检查。 先知道 验收标准 Acceptance Criteria
quote: Write a failed-login test case so another person can use the same account and steps and see the same result.
zhQuote: 把登录失败写成一条别人也能照着重现的测试：准备什么、点哪里、最后应该看到什么。

name: Unit Test
title: Unit Test
description: A unit test tests one independently verifiable function, component, or small module. · Pass a fixed price to a tax function and assert the amount, or check that a disabled button does not submit. It isolates outside services so a failure points to a small responsibility. A full login with browser, API, and real database is not a unit test. Know first Test Case
zhDescription: 针对独立函数或单个组件执行功能逻辑隔离验证的单元测试。 · 例如给总价计算输入商品、优惠券和运费，再检查结果是否正确；也可以单独确认禁用按钮不会触发操作。它只检查一小块明确功能，不能证明整个页面、保存和数据读取已经能一起工作。 先知道 测试用例 Test Case
quote: Add unit tests for price calculation: 100 gets 20 off, 99 does not, and external payment must not participate.
zhQuote: 先单独测一下总价计算函数，优惠券、运费和边界值都别连真实支付。

name: Integration Test
title: Integration Test
description: An integration test verifies that multiple modules or dependencies cooperate correctly. · A registration form sends a name to an API, the API writes a database, then returns success or error to the page. This finds mismatched field names, formats, and error handoff. A pure calculation function with fixed input remains a unit test. Know first Unit Test API
zhDescription: 集成测试是验证多个模块、服务或依赖之间能否按约定正确协作的测试。 · 例如提交订单后，页面把正确内容交给保存服务，保存服务再把结果返回页面。它能发现两边对字段名称、数据格式或连接方式理解不一致的问题；从用户打开页面到看到最终结果的完整检查，属于端到端测试。 先知道 单元测试 Unit Test API
quote: Test that submitting a registration form sends correct fields, the API saves them, and the page shows server errors.
zhQuote: 别只测函数，确认下单接口真的能把订单写进测试数据库，再把结果读回来。

name: Contract Testing
title: Contract Testing
description: An automated test that records the requests and responses a consumer truly depends on, then verifies that the provider remains compatible. · A profile page may read avatar_url and nickname. A consumer test records the request and minimum response; provider verification compares the backend's real response with that contract. Renaming avatar_url to avatar then fails CI before merge. This checks communication at a service boundary, not the whole page, network, or business calculation. Know first API Acceptance Criteria Integration Test
zhDescription: 记录调用方真正依赖的请求与响应约定，再验证提供方实际行为是否兼容的自动化测试。 · 例如用户资料页读取 avatar_url 和 nickname。前端的调用方测试先记录这次请求和最小响应要求，后端的提供方验证再用真实响应与它比对；若后端把 avatar_url 改成 avatar，持续集成（CI）会在合并前指出缺失字段。它检查服务之间能否按约定沟通，不证明完整页面、网络环境或业务计算都正确。 先知道 API 验收标准 Acceptance Criteria 集成测试 Integration Test
quote: The backend renamed a field in the response, and our frontend crashed on deploy. How can we catch this automatically on commit?
zhQuote: 后端把接口字段改名以后，前端总是到联调或上线才坏，能不能在合并代码前就指出哪个约定被破坏了？

name: End-to-End Test
title: End-to-End Test
description: An end-to-end test follows a complete system flow from a user's entry point to the final result. · A browser can register, sign in, create a trip, and reach confirmation across pages, services, and data storage. This is evidence that the user journey works. Calling one API or checking one function is important but not end-to-end. Know first Integration Test
zhDescription: 模拟真实用户跨页面跨系统完整操作流的端到端集成测试。 · 例如在浏览器里选择旅行日期、填写乘客、完成测试付款，再确认订单页出现正确行程。它检查用户从开始操作到看到结果的整条路径，但不表示每一种内部情况都已检查。 先知道 集成测试 Integration Test
quote: Like a real user, create an itinerary from the travel home page, save it, reopen it, and confirm the confirmation page shows that same trip.
zhQuote: 像游客本人一样，从选择日期、预订行程一直点到确认页，把整条流程跑一遍。

name: Smoke Test
title: Smoke Test
description: A smoke test uses a few critical checks after a new build to decide whether the system is worth deeper testing. · A new version can open home, log in, and call a core API first; any failure blocks slower tests. It aims to decide “continue or stop” within minutes. Re-running every old feature and edge case is regression testing, not smoke testing. Know first Build Test Case
zhDescription: 验证软件核心关键路径是否基本可用的极简冒烟测试。 · 例如先打开首页、完成一次登录并确认关键功能能回应；任一入口失败就先停止后续检查。它用很少的步骤判断新版本是否基本可用，不会逐项检查所有旧功能。 先知道 构建 Build 测试用例 Test Case
quote: After a new version reaches testing, first check that home opens, login works, and the core API responds; if one fails, do not start full regression.
zhQuote: 新版本刚部署，先用几分钟检查首页、登录和预订入口，坏一个就先别继续。

name: Regression Test
title: Regression Test
description: Regression testing checks that a change has not broken functionality that previously worked. · After tax changes, rerun payment, coupons, and confirmation; after dependency upgrades, rerun critical pages. It selects old capabilities the change could affect, not only the new request. A new feature working does not prove no regression. Know first Test Case
zhDescription: 回归测试是确认一次修改没有破坏原本正常功能的测试。 · 例如改优惠券规则后，除了验证新规则，还要按风险重跑支付、退款和订单查询的旧用例。只重测刚修复的一个缺陷不能代表完成了所需的回归范围。 先知道 测试用例 Test Case
quote: After changing tax rules, rerun payment, coupons, and order confirmation as well as the new rule to ensure working checkout was not broken.
zhQuote: 这次只改了优惠券，也要确认原来的支付、退款和订单查询没有被带坏。

name: Test Coverage
title: Test Coverage
description: Test coverage measures how much of requirements, code structure, or risk paths have been reached by tests. · Branch coverage can show whether the coupon-plus-payment-failure combination was reached; a requirements matrix can show a missing payment case. Coverage finds untouched paths. It does not mean no defect or meaningful assertions, even at 100%. Know first Unit Test
zhDescription: 测试覆盖率是衡量需求、代码结构或风险项有多少被测试触达的指标。 · 例如报告可以标出退款失败这条情况从未被测到，也能发现某条支付规则没有对应检查。它只说明测试触及了多少情况，不说明检查结果一定可靠；即使达到 100% 也可能有缺陷。 先知道 单元测试 Unit Test
quote: Do not only report “90% coverage”; also show whether the high-risk path combining payment failure and a coupon was actually tested.
zhQuote: 别只报一个覆盖率数字，直接指出支付流程还有哪些高风险分支没有测到。

name: Test Double
title: Test Double
description: A test double is a controllable object that replaces a real dependency during testing. · When an order module requests payment, a double can reliably return success, rejection, or timeout so tests verify how the page handles each. Mock, stub, fake, and spy can be different kinds of test double; not every double is simply a Mock, and it cannot prove a real service is connected. Know first Unit Test API
zhDescription: 测试替身是在检查时，用可控制的假对象代替真实外部服务的做法。 · 例如检查订单处理时，可以让一个假的支付服务按要求返回成功、拒绝或超时，再看订单页面如何处理。它适合隔开缓慢或不稳定的外部服务；要确认真实服务能连通，仍要做连通检查。 先知道 单元测试 Unit Test API
quote: When testing an order failure message, use a controllable payment test double that returns “payment rejected” instead of depending on the real payment service every time.
zhQuote: 单测别真的扣款，用一个可控的支付替身返回成功和超时，再检查订单模块怎么处理。

name: Test Data and Fixture
title: Test Data and Fixture
description: Test data are input and state samples; a fixture is a reusable setup and cleanup mechanism. · A fixed user and order JSON are test data. Creating an account and order before a test, then deleting or restoring state afterward, is a fixture. Together they give each case the same start. One random input or yesterday’s leftover record is not stable evidence. Know first Test Case Database
zhDescription: 测试数据是检查时使用的固定内容；Fixture 是每次准备和清理这些内容的步骤。 · 例如固定用户和订单用于每次检查，Fixture 会在开始前创建它们、结束后删除或重置。前者说明“用什么内容”，后者说明“怎样准备和还原”；它不负责假装成外部服务。 先知道 测试用例 Test Case 数据库 Database
quote: Prepare fixed user and product data for the order test, and create it before every run and clean it after so the next run starts identically.
zhQuote: 每次测试前都准备同一个用户和订单，跑完后清理掉，保证下一次还是同样的起点。

name: Flaky Test
title: Flaky Test
description: A flaky test sometimes passes and sometimes fails when the code has not changed. · The same CI commit can time out occasionally, or parallel tests can race for one account and alternate red and green. Unlike a defect that fails every time, flakiness makes the result untrustworthy. Retries can collect clues or temporarily reduce impact, but do not replace finding timing, shared-state, or environment causes. Know first Test Case
zhDescription: 不稳定测试是在代码未改变时仍会时而通过、时而失败的测试。 · 例如 CI 中的页面测试偶发超时，或并行用例抢同一个账号导致结果交替。重试可以帮助确认现象和收集证据，但不能当作修复；稳定失败通常更像真实缺陷或固定配置错误。 先知道 测试用例 Test Case
quote: Run the same commit five times: it sometimes passes and sometimes times out. Check waiting conditions and shared accounts first; do not hide red with endless retries.
zhQuote: 同一个 commit 的测试一会儿过一会儿不过，别只点重试，查清是时序还是共享数据。

name: Load Testing
title: Load Testing
description: Load testing measures latency, throughput, and errors while a system handles a realistic level of load. · Before an event, an isolated production-like environment can simulate browsing and checkout with synthetic or sanitized data. The team records response time, throughput, and failures, then compares them with predefined thresholds to decide what to improve. Load testing is not the same as pushing a system to its breaking point with stress testing, and it cannot promise zero production failures. Know first Monitoring Acceptance Criteria
zhDescription: 在模拟真实业务规模的并发请求下，测量系统延迟、吞吐量和错误率等表现的性能测试方法。 · 例如活动前在接近生产的环境用合成或脱敏数据模拟用户浏览和下单，记录响应时间、处理量和失败比例，再按预先设定的阈值判断是否需要改善。负载测试不是把系统故意推到极限的 stress test，也不能保证生产环境永远零故障。 先知道 监控 Monitoring 验收标准 Acceptance Criteria
quote: Before the event, simulate many real checkout users and show how latency, throughput, and error rate behave at the target load.
zhQuote: 活动开始前模拟真实用户同时下单，看看延迟、吞吐和错误率在目标负载下会怎样。

name: Quality Gate
title: Quality Gate
description: A set of conditions that decide whether code may be merged or a release may proceed · All tests may pass while coverage remains below the agreed 80%, keeping a pull request blocked. Checks produce results and the gate evaluates them; branch protection must require that result to enforce the merge restriction. Know first Unit Test CI
zhDescription: 在合并代码或发布版本前，根据检查结果判断是否允许继续的一组准入条件 · 例如测试全部通过，但覆盖率没有达到团队约定的 80%，这次改动仍不能合并。检查负责产出结果，门禁负责判定；还要把它设为必需检查，代码平台才会据此阻止合并。 先知道 单元测试 Unit Test 持续集成 CI
quote: Why is my Pull Request blocked with an error saying 'Quality gate failed'?
zhQuote: 为什么我刚提交的代码合并不了，AI 提示我‘质量门禁未通过’？

name: Terminal
title: Terminal
description: Run text commands in a specific folder on your computer or server · A terminal gives you a prompt where commands can start tools, install packages, inspect files, and run a project. The current directory changes what a command affects. Read the command and confirm the path before running anything that changes or deletes files.
zhDescription: 终端命令行是通过输入文字命令操作电脑和运行程序的界面 · 许多项目命令和相对路径取决于当前目录，例如启动开发服务前要先进入项目目录并观察输出。删除文件、改权限或上传数据前，先确认命令作用的准确目标和影响。
quote: AI gave me a command to run, but I don't know what it will do. Is it safe to run?
zhQuote: AI 丢给我一串命令让我运行，我都不知道它会干什么，敢直接跑吗？

name: Browser DevTools
title: Browser DevTools
description: Browser DevTools are built-in tools for inspecting page structure, styles, errors, requests, and storage state. · For example, when Save does not update the page, use Elements for nodes and styles, Console for script errors, Network for request status and responses, and Storage for browser data such as cookies. DevTools provides evidence and temporary edits; it does not replace server logs, permission checks, or a real code fix. Know first HTML HTTP
zhDescription: 浏览器开发者工具是一组用来检查网页结构、样式、错误、请求和存储状态的内置工具。 · 例如保存按钮没有更新页面时，可以在 Elements 看节点和样式，在 Console 看脚本错误，在 Network 看请求状态与响应，在 Storage 看 Cookie 等浏览器数据。DevTools 提供证据和临时修改，不会代替服务端日志、权限检查或真正的代码修复。 先知道 HTML HTTP
quote: Clicking Save does not update the page. Use browser developer tools to find the evidence instead of guessing from the screen.
zhQuote: 保存按钮点了没有更新，请用浏览器开发者工具帮我找到证据，不要只凭页面现象猜。

name: npm
title: npm
description: Install JavaScript packages and run project scripts · npm is a package manager and command runner for JavaScript projects. package.json records dependencies and named scripts, while the lockfile keeps installed versions reproducible. Install packages intentionally and review scripts before running code from an unfamiliar project. Know first Terminal
zhDescription: npm 是给 JavaScript 项目下载所需工具、运行项目命令的工具。 · 项目会列出需要下载哪些工具和版本，npm 按这份清单下载到本机，也能启动项目或执行检查。下载时可能运行额外脚本，所以要先确认自己位于正确项目目录，并了解陌生依赖会做什么。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: AI told me to install dependencies, and one command downloaded a ton of stuff. What's going on?
zhQuote: AI 让我先“装依赖”，敲了一行命令就哗啦啦下载一堆东西，这是在干嘛？

name: Build
title: Build
description: A build converts source code, dependencies, and configuration into a runnable or releasable artifact. · Front-end source can build into a dist folder and service code into a versioned container image. A successful build means that commit produced the requested artifact. Making it available in testing or production is a later deployment and release step. Know first npm
zhDescription: 构建是把项目文件整理成浏览器或服务器能够运行的成品的过程。 · 例如网页项目构建后会生成一组可发布的文件，服务项目也可能生成带版本号的运行包。构建成功只说明成品已经生成；把它放到测试地址或正式网站是部署。 先知道 npm
quote: Build this commit into a deployable front-end artifact and retain a version identifier; do not treat “build succeeded” as being live.
zhQuote: 把这次源码真正构建成可以发布的成品，告诉我输出目录和对应的 commit。

name: CI
title: CI
description: CI is the practice of automatically building and testing changes as they enter shared code, so integration problems appear early. · A PR can automatically run lint, unit tests, and build, then write pass or fail back to the PR. This exposes issues before or just after merging. Manually testing once before release is not continuous integration. Know first Git Build Unit Test
zhDescription: 持续集成是在每次准备合并改动时，自动检查这些改动能否和现有项目一起正常工作的做法。 · 例如有人提交一份改动后，系统会自己准备项目、检查常见代码错误、运行关键功能检查，并在合并页面标出通过或失败。它让问题在改动正式进入项目之前暴露；检查通过不代表新版本已经向用户发布。 先知道 Git 构建 Build 单元测试 Unit Test
quote: For every PR or merge, automatically run lint, build, and key tests, with results shown on the pull request.
zhQuote: 每次有人准备把改动合进项目时，都自动检查页面能不能正常生成、有没有明显错误、关键功能有没有出错；没通过就先别合并。

name: Lint
title: Lint
description: Lint is static checking that uses source rules to find suspicious patterns and consistency problems without running the full program. · Lint can locate unused variables, clear mistakes, or unhandled promises and make the warning disappear after a correction. It finds source-level risks early. Clicking a button and confirming save results or API responses still need build, tests, or manual verification. Know first JavaScript
zhDescription: Lint 是不启动整个项目、只检查代码写法是否有常见问题的工具。 · 例如它能标出没有使用的变量、可能漏掉的错误处理或不符合项目约定的写法，并给出文件和行号。它能提前发现一部分问题，但不能证明按钮点击、保存等实际操作正确。 先知道 JavaScript
quote: Use lint to flag unused variables and unhandled promises first, but do not say a passing lint means the button really works.
zhQuote: 提交前跑一下 Lint，把未使用变量和明显可疑写法定位到具体行。

name: Hash
title: Hash
description: A digest computed from content using a specified algorithm, often used to compare files or identify versions · A website build can include a script’s content hash in its filename to distinguish old and new files. The page must also reference the new file to load the update. Different contents can collide, so a hash is not an absolutely unique identifier.
zhDescription: 哈希是按指定算法从内容计算出的摘要，常用来比较文件或标识版本。 · 例如发布网站时，把脚本内容的哈希放进文件名，方便区分新旧文件。页面还要引用新文件，用户才会加载更新；不同内容也可能得到相同哈希，不能把它当成绝对唯一的编号。
quote: I updated the website, so why does it still show the old content?
zhQuote: 我明明更新了网站，为什么打开后还是旧内容？

name: Dependency
title: Dependency
description: External code packages a project declares it will use, usually installed from its manifest by a package manager · After cloning a project, package.json declares its dependencies and a lockfile records resolved versions; the package manager prepares a local install directory from them. Repositories usually do not commit node_modules. If you see Cannot find module, first check whether dependencies were installed, then start the project as documented and inspect the actual error. Know first npm
zhDescription: 项目声明会使用的外部代码包，通常由包管理器按清单安装 · 克隆项目后，package.json 记录项目声明的依赖，锁文件记录解析出的具体版本；包管理器据此准备本地安装目录。源码仓库通常不提交 node_modules。遇到 Cannot find module 可以先看依赖是否安装，再按项目提示启动并核对实际报错。 先知道 npm
quote: I just downloaded the project and it reports a missing module. Is the code broken?
zhQuote: 刚下载好的项目一运行就报找不到模块，是代码坏了吗？

name: Semantic Versioning
title: Semantic Versioning
description: A versioning rule that uses major, minor, and patch to express a public API compatibility promise · SemVer uses X.Y.Z to express a promise about public API compatibility: for stable versions, patch means a compatible fix, minor means a compatible addition, and major means an incompatible change. A version is the author’s API contract, not an application upgrade risk score; 0.y.z versions have not promised a stable API. Know first npm
zhDescription: 用主版本、次版本和修订号表达公开 API 兼容承诺的版本规则 · SemVer 用 X.Y.Z 表达对公开 API 兼容性的承诺：稳定版本中，修订号表示兼容修复，次版本表示兼容新增，主版本表示不兼容变化。版本号是项目作者对 API 的约定，不是应用升级风险分数；0.y.z 版本尚未承诺稳定 API。 先知道 npm
quote: AI says a dependency is moving from major version 1 to 2. Should I just upgrade?
zhQuote: AI 建议我把依赖从主版本 1 升到 2，我该直接升级吗？

name: Tech Stack
title: Tech Stack
description: The set of languages, frameworks, data services, and tools used to build and run software · A website might combine JavaScript, React, a database, build tools, and hosting. They handle different jobs: page behavior, interface, data, and operation. Start by learning what the project already uses before replacing several layers at once. Know first Frontend Backend
zhDescription: 技术栈是一套项目实际使用的编程语言、现成框架、数据服务和运行工具。 · 例如一个网站会分别用工具处理页面、交互、数据保存和对外运行。先看现有项目已经使用什么，再决定是否替换；不要为了看起来完整，一次改掉页面、样式和启动方式。 先知道 前端 Frontend 后端 Backend
quote: When someone asks what tech stack I use, what am I supposed to say?
zhQuote: 别人问我“你用什么技术栈”，我到底该怎么回答？

name: JavaScript
title: JavaScript
description: A programming language that makes a web page respond to actions and data · When someone marks a task complete, browser JavaScript can send a request, receive the updated list, and change that row on the page. JavaScript can also run on a server through Node.js, which is a different environment with different responsibilities. Know first HTML
zhDescription: JavaScript 是让网页响应点击、输入等操作，也能处理程序逻辑的编程语言。 · 例如用户点击“完成”后，JavaScript 可以发送保存请求并更新待办状态。它既能在浏览器运行，也能在服务器运行；密码和真正的权限检查不能只放在浏览器。 先知道 HTML
quote: What language makes the interactive parts of a webpage move and respond?
zhQuote: 网页上会动、能交互的那部分，是用什么语言写的？

name: TypeScript
title: TypeScript
description: A language that checks written code for mismatched names and value types before it runs · If you type user.nmae instead of user.name , TypeScript can flag it before the page runs when the object type is known. It checks declared code contracts; passing those checks does not prove the product logic is right. Know first JavaScript
zhDescription: TypeScript 是在 JavaScript 上增加“数据应是什么样”检查的编程语言。 · 例如已经说明用户资料里有姓名，却把姓名字段拼错，编辑器可在运行前标红。它能发现字段名称或数据种类不一致，不能证明价格、权限等业务规则正确。 先知道 JavaScript
quote: I've heard there's a stricter version of JavaScript that catches mistakes early. What is it?
zhQuote: 听说有种更严格的 JavaScript，写错了能提前提醒我，是什么？

name: Python
title: Python
description: A programming language often used to automate work on a computer or server · A Python script can read three Markdown notes and write their titles into summary.csv . It runs on a local machine or server; an ordinary web page does not execute a local Python script by itself. Know first Terminal
zhDescription: Python 是常用于自动化、数据处理和服务器程序的通用编程语言 · 例如，脚本可读取多份 Markdown 笔记并生成 summary.csv；这是 Python 的一个常见用途，不是它的完整定义。运行前确认会读写哪些路径及是否覆盖文件；普通网页不能直接执行你电脑上的 Python。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: What's the language everyone recommends for automating spreadsheets and files with a script?
zhQuote: 我想写个脚本自动处理表格和文件，大家推荐的那个语言叫什么？

name: Pointer
title: Pointer
description: A value holding a target location so a program can find data through that location · When two names point to the same settings object, editing its contents changes what both names read. JavaScript object references help illustrate this relationship, but do not expose directly manipulable memory addresses.
zhDescription: 指针是保存目标位置的值，让程序通过这个位置找到数据。 · 例如两个名字都指向同一份设置，改动其中的内容，另一个名字读到的结果也会变化。JavaScript 的对象引用可以帮助理解这种“指向”关系，但它不向代码提供可直接操作的内存地址。
quote: I only wanted to edit this draft, so why did the original settings change too?
zhQuote: 我只想改这份草稿，怎么原来的设置也跟着变了？

name: Node.js
title: Node.js
description: A runtime for JavaScript outside the browser, often used by local scripts and build tools · When a project specifies a Node.js version, use node -v in the terminal to check your local runtime. Node.js runs JavaScript outside the browser and can provide local capabilities such as file-system access; browser scripts run in a page environment, which is different. Know first JavaScript
zhDescription: 让 JavaScript 能在浏览器以外运行的环境，常用于本地脚本和构建工具 · 项目说明要求 Node.js 版本时，可以在终端用 node -v 查看本机环境。Node.js 让 JavaScript 在浏览器外运行，可提供文件系统等本机能力；浏览器脚本则运行在网页环境中，二者不是同一个运行环境。 先知道 JavaScript
quote: The terminal says command not found: node. Why can't my project run?
zhQuote: 终端说 command not found: node，我的项目为什么跑不起来？

name: React
title: React
description: A JavaScript library for building interactive interfaces from components and state · After an item is added to a cart, React can update the count from 2 to 3. Whether the item was actually saved and remains after a refresh still depends on backend and data storage. Know first JavaScript
zhDescription: React 是把网页拆成可复用部分，并让画面跟随数据变化的工具。 · 例如商品加入购物车后，右上角数量从 2 变成 3，React 会根据新数量更新这处画面。商品是否真的保存成功、刷新后还在不在，仍取决于保存数据的服务。 先知道 JavaScript
quote: People keep saying to use React for websites. What's better about it than writing the page directly?
zhQuote: 老听人说做网页要用 React，它到底比直接写页面强在哪？

name: Vue
title: Vue
description: A JavaScript framework for building interactive interfaces with templates and components · When a +1 button changes a count from 0 to 1, Vue updates the bound text on the page. It controls how the interface reflects data; a server still handles durable storage. Know first JavaScript
zhDescription: Vue 是把网页拆成可复用部分，并让画面跟随数据变化的工具。 · 例如点一次“+1”后，页面数量从 0 变成 1，Vue 会让按钮旁的文字跟着更新。它只负责页面怎样显示，数据是否长期保存仍要由服务器处理。 先知道 JavaScript
quote: Is Vue really friendlier for beginners, and how is it different from React?
zhQuote: 听说 Vue 对新手更友好，是真的吗？跟 React 比呢？

name: Next.js
title: Next.js
description: A React framework for building full websites and web applications · When someone opens /products/42 , Next.js can find that product page and fetch product data on the server before showing it. It does not automatically provide a product database or permission system. Know first React npm
zhDescription: Next.js 是基于 React 搭建完整网站的工具，常用于官网、内容站和带登录的网站。 · 例如用户打开某个商品网址时，它会找到对应详情页，并可先读取商品资料再显示。它不会自动提供商品保存、账号权限等后端能力。 先知道 React npm
quote: Is there a framework for building a full React site with routing and SEO?
zhQuote: 我想用 React 做个完整网站，带路由和 SEO，有没有一站式的框架？

name: Tailwind CSS
title: Tailwind CSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework that styles elements through small class names · Classes such as p-6 , rounded-xl , and border give a card padding, rounded corners, and a border. Tailwind generates CSS rules; the same CSS layout rules still explain why something overlaps or crowds. Know first HTML Flex Grid
zhDescription: Tailwind CSS 是用一组现成短代码直接写网页外观的工具。 · 例如 p-6 、 rounded-xl 和 border 分别表示留白、圆角和边框。短代码很多时，可按留白、文字、边框和布局分组阅读；重复组合应收进同一个可复用界面部分。 先知道 HTML 弹性布局 Flex 网格布局 Grid
quote: Do I really have to open a separate CSS file for every style change? Can I adjust styles right where I write the markup?
zhQuote: 调个样式还要专门开 CSS 文件，能不能在写结构的地方顺手就调了？

name: shadcn/ui
title: shadcn/ui
description: A collection of editable UI component code that you add to a React project · Adding Button puts component files in your project, so changing those files changes the buttons on your site. It is not an online component service; your project owns the maintenance after you add it. Know first React Tailwind CSS npm
zhDescription: shadcn/ui 是一套可复制到项目里、由项目自己维护的按钮、表单和弹窗代码。 · 例如加入按钮后，项目里会多出一份按钮代码；修改这份代码，网站里的对应按钮也会改变。它不是在线组件服务，后续更新和修复都由项目自己负责。 先知道 React Tailwind CSS npm
quote: Is there a set of good-looking components I can copy into my project and customize?
zhQuote: 有没有一套好看的现成组件，代码直接复制进项目就能改？

name: AI Application Basics
title: AI Application Basics
description: A product that uses an AI model, an interface, and sometimes tools to help people complete tasks · When you ask a calendar assistant about tomorrow afternoon, the interface receives the question, the model decides what to look up, a calendar tool reads the real schedule, and the app shows the result. The model does not enter the calendar on its own. Know first API JSON
zhDescription: AI 应用是把 AI 放进网页或软件里，让用户提问或完成任务的产品。 · 例如用户说“帮我查明天下午的日历”：应用接住问题，判断需要查询什么，再通过日历功能读取真实日程并显示结果。AI 本身不能直接进入日历，权限和实际查询由产品控制。 先知道 API JSON
quote: Add an AI assistant to my website that people can chat with.
zhQuote: 我想在自己的网站里，也加一个能聊天的 AI 助手。

name: AI Hallucination
title: AI Hallucination
description: An AI hallucination is information a model generates that looks credible but is inaccurate, unsupported, or invented. · An AI can invent venue hours, a nonexistent link, an outdated rule, or a function that is not in a project. Fluent wording is not evidence. An Agent can research changing external facts online, but conclusions still need official or original sources, tool results, tests, and human judgment. Know first AI Application Basics
zhDescription: AI 幻觉是模型生成看似可信、但不准确、无依据或虚构的信息。 · 例如 AI 可能编造景点开放时间、不存在的链接、过期规则，或项目里没有的函数；流畅语气不能当作证据。涉及会变化的外部事实时，可以让 Agent 联网调研，但结论仍要回到官方或原始来源、工具结果、测试和真人判断。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics
quote: This AI travel guide sounds confident, but I do not want to trust the opening hours. Research the official website or reservation page online and include the source link and update date.
zhQuote: 这份 AI 旅行攻略写得很肯定，但景点开放时间我不敢直接信。先帮我联网查官网或官方预约页，把来源链接和更新时间一起给我。

name: Vibe Coding
title: Vibe Coding
description: Building software by describing the desired result to an AI agent and reviewing the work it makes · You can ask an agent to build a settings page, inspect the changed files, then test the mobile layout. It can speed up implementation, but you still need to define the scope, check the result, and protect data and secrets. Know first AI Application Basics
zhDescription: Vibe Coding 是指用自然语言向 AI 表达需求，由 AI 编写代码，再根据运行结果持续迭代调整的开发方式。 · 例如，你说“做一个待办页面”，AI 会先生成代码；你打开页面，发现按钮太挤或保存报错，再把这些结果告诉它继续修改。它适合快速试想法，但能运行不等于可靠；正式上线前仍要检查代码、测试和权限。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics
quote: I can't code. I just want to tell an AI what I need and have it build it for me.
zhQuote: 我不会写代码，就想用说话的方式让 AI 帮我把东西做出来。

name: Multimodal AI
title: Multimodal AI
description: AI that can combine information such as text, images, audio, or video in one task · Send a screenshot of a phone checkout page with the question “Why is the payment button missing?” and the AI can consider both the visible layout and your written question. Know first AI Application Basics
zhDescription: 多模态 AI 能在同一个任务里结合文字、图片、音频或视频等不同形式的信息。 · 例如，把手机结账页的截图和“付款按钮为什么不见了”一起发给 AI，它可以把画面里的布局和文字里的问题放在一起判断。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics
quote: Can AI understand my screenshot too, not just the text I send it?
zhQuote: 能不能让 AI 不光看文字，还能看懂我发的截图？

name: RAG
title: RAG
description: A method that retrieves relevant passages from specified material at answer time and gives them to the model · When customer support answers a refund question, RAG first finds relevant passages in connected policy material and then lets the model answer from them. New material must finish processing and enter the searchable set before later answers can use it; retrieval may still miss a passage or the model may misread it. Know first Context Window
zhDescription: 回答时先从指定资料中检索相关片段，再把它们交给模型参考的做法 · 客服回答退款问题时，RAG 会先从接入的政策资料中找相关段落，再让模型据此作答。新资料要完成处理并进入检索范围后，后续回答才有机会用到；检索仍可能漏掉内容或被模型误读。 先知道 上下文窗口 Context Window
quote: I updated the refund policy. Why is AI still citing the old rule?
zhQuote: 我改了退款政策，为什么 AI 还在引用旧规则？

name: Fine-tuning
title: Fine-tuning
description: Continuing to train an existing model with task examples so its outputs better match them on a specific task · A support team wants every refund reply to state the outcome before the next step. Fine-tuning can continue training a model with representative inputs and target replies; compare it on tickets not used for training to see whether it helps, and still provide the current task instructions. Know first Prompt
zhDescription: 用任务示例继续训练已有模型，使它在特定任务上的输出更贴近示例 · 客服团队希望退款回复都先说明结果、再给下一步。微调可以用代表性的输入和期望回答继续训练模型；实际是否更合适，要用未参与训练的工单比较，且模型仍需要当前任务说明。 先知道 提示词 Prompt
quote: Support replies keep changing tone and format. Should we train a model?
zhQuote: 客服回复的语气和格式总不一致，要不要训练模型？

name: Reasoning Model
title: Reasoning Model
description: A class of language models that uses additional internal reasoning computation for harder problems · A signup page says the submission succeeded, but the record disappears after refresh. A reasoning model may help an Agent investigate the prompt, request, and save result step by step; it does not automatically see logs or guarantee the right cause, so check the real outcome. Know first AI Application Basics
zhDescription: 为复杂问题使用额外内部推理计算的一类大模型 · 报名页面提示提交成功，刷新后记录却消失了。推理模型可以帮助 Agent 按提示、请求和保存结果逐步排查；它不会因此自动看到日志或保证找到正确原因，仍要核对真实结果。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics
quote: AI took a long time to answer. What can I check to tell whether that helped?
zhQuote: AI 想了很久才回答，我该看什么来判断它有没有帮上忙？

name: Context Engineering
title: Context Engineering
description: Organizing the goals, rules, source material, and latest results an AI receives for each turn · For a long login fix, keep the current error, relevant files, and the rule that shared components cannot change. Repeated logs can become a summary with a path to the original. Know first Context Window System Prompt Conversation History
zhDescription: 系统化筛选、编排并向大模型提供最高相关度上下文信息的工程方法。 · 例如修复登录故障时，下一轮要继续带上当前报错、相关文件和“不能修改公共组件”的限制；重复日志可以改成摘要，原文只保留文件位置供需要时读取。 先知道 上下文窗口 Context Window 系统提示词 System Prompt 对话历史 Conversation History
quote: As the task gets longer, the AI starts missing a newly confirmed requirement. What should the next turn include?
zhQuote: 任务做久以后，AI 开始漏掉刚确认的要求。下一轮应该带上哪些资料？

name: Token
title: Token
description: A small piece of text or code that a model reads and writes · Models split text, punctuation, and code into tokens using their own rules. Input and output token counts affect available context, wait time, and cost; a token is not always one word or one character. Know first AI Application Basics
zhDescription: Token 是 AI 读取和生成文字、标点或代码时使用的计数单位。 · 同一句话在不同 AI 中可能被分成不同数量的小片段。输入和输出的片段数会影响一次能放多少内容、等待时间和费用；一个汉字不一定正好算一个 Token。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics
quote: Everyone says AI pricing is based on tokens. What is a token, and how does it relate to what I type?
zhQuote: 都说按 token 收费，token 到底是个啥？跟我打几个字什么关系？

name: Context Window
title: Context Window
description: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request · After a long chat, “follow the first requirement” can fail if that requirement was not included in the current request. More context capacity does not make every piece of information relevant. Know first Token
zhDescription: 上下文窗口是 AI 一次回答时能够同时参考的资料和回答内容的总量上限。 · 例如聊了很久后再说“按最初要求修改”，最早的要求可能没有被这次回答带上，结果就会偏离。它能参考的内容有上限，资料更多也不代表资料更相关。 先知道 Token
quote: The AI forgets what I said at the start of a long chat. Does it have a memory limit?
zhQuote: 聊着聊着 AI 把开头说的忘了，是不是它有记性上限？

name: System Prompt
title: System Prompt
description: Instructions an AI product gives the model behind the scenes to guide its behavior · A support assistant can be told to hand off refunds above $500. That rule can shape its reply, but real permission checks must still control whether a refund happens. Know first Context Window
zhDescription: 系统提示词是 AI 产品在背后先交给模型的规则，例如客服助手该用什么语气、哪些问题不能自行处理。 · 例如客服助手收到“退款超过 500 元要转人工”这条规则后，会在遇到大额退款时提示转接。它只能影响模型的回答，真正拦住退款仍要靠产品的权限检查。 先知道 上下文窗口 Context Window
quote: Where do I set rules for the AI, like its tone and what it can or can't answer?
zhQuote: 我想给 AI 立规矩：什么语气、什么能答什么不能答，在哪设置？

name: Conversation History
title: Conversation History
description: Conversation history is the earlier messages a product saves and can include again when they matter to a new request · When you say “make the second one shorter,” the application retrieves the three earlier titles and includes the relevant material in this request. A complete transcript in the interface does not mean the model received every message this time. Know first Context Window
zhDescription: 对话历史是产品保存的旧消息，其中与当前问题有关的部分可以在下一次请求中再次交给模型。 · 例如用户说“把第二条改短”时，应用需要从记录中找回原来的三个标题，并把相关内容放进本次请求。聊天界面保存了全部消息，不代表模型这次收到了全部消息。 先知道 上下文窗口 Context Window
quote: The earlier messages are still visible in the chat. Why did the AI edit the wrong second item?
zhQuote: 聊天界面里明明还有前面的内容，AI 为什么还是答错了我说的第二条？

name: Prompt
title: Prompt
description: A prompt is the message you send the AI—the problem, requirements, and context all live in it, and it steers what the AI builds. · "Build a client quote list with client, amount, date, and status, stored locally, newest first"—that whole sentence is the prompt. The AI reads it before every move: specific wording lands specific results, while "make a nice tool" forces guessing. When results disappoint, refine the prompt before switching tools—add the object, the requirements, and what counts as done. Know first AI Agent
zhDescription: 输入给大语言模型以引导其生成特定格式与内容结果的指令与上下文文本。 · 例如「做一个客户报价列表，字段是客户名、金额、日期和状态，数据先存浏览器本地」——这一段就是提示词。AI 每次动手前读的就是它：说得具体，结果就贴得近；只说「做个好看的工具」，AI 只能猜。结果不理想时，第一反应不是换工具，而是把提示词改得更具体——补上对象、要求和怎样算完成。 先知道 AI Agent
quote: Build a client quote list: client name, amount, date, and status, stored in the browser, newest first.
zhQuote: 帮我做一个客户报价列表：字段是客户名、金额、日期、跟进状态，先存在浏览器本地，列表按时间倒序。

name: Agent Memory
title: Agent Memory
description: A mechanism for an Agent to save and retrieve selected information in later interactions; its scope depends on the product and settings · While coding, you want the Agent to avoid automatically editing shared components. The same conversation may retain chat history; a new one sees the preference only if project rules are read or a supported memory is saved and retrieved. Check what the new conversation actually loaded in the target project. Know first Conversation History
zhDescription: Agent 保存并在后续交互中取回部分信息的机制，具体范围取决于产品和设置 · 写代码时，你希望 Agent 不自动修改共享组件。同一会话可能保留聊天记录；新会话只有在项目规则被读取，或相应记忆被保存并取回时，才会看到这条偏好。要在目标项目的新会话里核对实际加载了什么。 先知道 对话历史 Conversation History
quote: Will the Agent remember what I told it after I start a new conversation?
zhQuote: 新开对话以后，Agent 还会记得我之前交代的约定吗？

name: Stateless Request
title: Stateless Request
description: A stateless request is a model call that uses only what it receives this time and does not automatically retain prior input or results · If one request creates a table and the next contains only “continue,” the model does not know which table to continue. The product may save the table and chat, but it must include the current goal, table, and relevant result again. Know first API HTTP
zhDescription: 无状态请求是一次模型调用只依据本次收到的内容，不会自动保留上一轮输入和结果。 · 例如上一轮生成了表格，下一轮只发送“继续”，模型就不知道要继续哪张表。产品可以保存表格和聊天记录，但仍要把本轮需要的目标、表格和上一轮结果重新放进请求。 先知道 API HTTP
quote: The table is still visible in the chat. Why does the AI not know what to do when I send only “continue”?
zhQuote: 聊天里明明有刚才的表格，为什么只发“继续”时 AI 还是不知道要做什么？

name: Structured Output
title: Structured Output
description: Model output returned in an agreed, machine-checkable shape · To fill a calendar form from an email, a product can require fields such as title, date, and location with defined types. JSON is a common encoding, not the same thing as structured output, and business rules still need validation. Know first JSON API
zhDescription: 结构化输出是要求 AI 按事先约定的栏目和格式返回结果的方式。 · 例如可把邮件整理成包含日期、地点和标题的一组固定信息，供表单或日历直接读取。格式正确不代表内容真实可用，日期、金额等信息仍要检查。 先知道 JSON API
quote: AI gives me a big block of text I can't use directly. Can it return the answer in a fixed format?
zhQuote: AI 回的一大段话没法直接用，能不能按固定的格式给我？

name: Streaming Response
title: Streaming Response
description: A response sent and displayed in consecutive pieces as it is generated · A chat answer can appear as if it is typing. An early first piece makes waiting feel shorter, but the full answer can still take time to generate and transmit. Know first HTTP Token
zhDescription: 流式响应是 AI 一边生成内容，界面一边逐段显示内容的方式。 · 例如，聊天回答会像打字一样逐段出现。首段更早可见不代表整份回答更早完成，总时长仍受后续生成和传输影响。 先知道 HTTP Token
quote: Show the answer as it comes in, like someone typing, instead of making me wait for the whole thing.
zhQuote: 别让我干等，像打字机一样一个字一个字往外蹦。

name: Temperature
title: Temperature
description: A parameter that adjusts sampling randomness in generation APIs and models that support it · When asking AI to name a to-do app, a higher temperature usually allows more varied wording; for a response with a fixed format, a lower setting may reduce variation. It cannot lock outputs to identical wording, and support and ranges differ by model and API. Know first Prompt
zhDescription: 在支持该设置的生成接口中，调节采样输出随机程度的参数 · 让 AI 为待办应用想宣传语时，温度较高通常会带来更多样的措辞；写固定格式的回复时，较低设置可能减少变化。它不能锁定逐字相同的结果，支持范围也会因模型和接口不同。 先知道 提示词 Prompt
quote: Why does AI phrase the answer differently when I ask the same question again?
zhQuote: 同一个问题问几次，AI 给的句子为什么会变？

name: AI Agent
title: AI Agent
description: An AI system that can plan steps, use permitted tools, and act on results toward a goal · To fix a page, an agent can read the relevant file, edit it, run a check, and report what passed. It only has the tools, permissions, and context the product gives it. Know first AI Application Basics Tool Calling
zhDescription: 具备目标感知、自主规划、工具调用与多步执行能力的 AI 系统。 · 例如你让它整理会议，它可以读取会议记录、提取决定和待办，再写进文档；每一步会根据实际结果决定下一步。它能使用哪些文件和工具、何时必须确认，仍由产品权限和规则决定。 先知道 AI 应用基础 AI Application Basics 工具调用 Tool Calling
quote: I don't want to direct every step. Can I give it a goal and let it figure out how to finish it?
zhQuote: 我不想一步步指挥，能不能给个目标，让它自己想办法完成？

name: Harness Engineering
title: Harness Engineering
description: The engineering practice of turning project knowledge, tools, state, permissions, and checks into a working environment an AI agent can use · For example, when a frontend agent delivers a plausible page, an independent evaluator can operate the live flow and return failed steps and screenshots to the next turn. Harness engineering changes the conditions around the model rather than making the prompt longer. Know first AI Agent Agent Loop Tool Calling
zhDescription: Agent 运行框架工程是把项目知识、工具、状态、权限和检查做成 AI Agent 可用工作环境的工程实践。 · 例如前端 Agent 交付了看似完整的页面，独立评审器会用浏览器实际点击主流程，再把失败步骤和截图送回下一轮。它改造的是模型周围的工作条件，不是把提示词写得更长。 先知道 AI Agent Agent 循环 Agent Loop 工具调用 Tool Calling
quote: The same AI works well sometimes but repeats the same mistake elsewhere. What can I change besides the model?
zhQuote: 同一个 AI 有时做得很好，有时总在同一个地方犯错，除了换模型还能改什么？

name: Human-in-the-loop
title: Human-in-the-loop
description: Pausing an AI workflow before a critical decision or high-risk action so a person can review, approve, reject, or correct it · A travel agent may search and compare flights automatically, but before payment it should show the dates, passenger, total, and change rules and wait for approval. Human-in-the-loop adds decision points where they matter rather than making a person watch every step. Know first AI Agent Tool Calling
zhDescription: 人在回路是在 AI 工作流的关键判断或高风险动作前暂停，让人审阅、批准、拒绝或修正后再继续的机制。 · 例如旅行 Agent 可以自动搜索并比较机票，但付款出票前要展示日期、乘机人、总价和退改规则，等你批准后才继续。它不是让人盯着每一步，而是把决定权放在真正重要的暂停点。 先知道 AI Agent 工具调用 Tool Calling
quote: The AI can research the itinerary and flights, but it must ask me before paying or issuing a ticket.
zhQuote: 攻略和机票可以让 AI 先查，但付款、出票前一定要让我确认。

name: Sub-agent
title: Sub-agent
description: A separate agent the main agent assigns to a bounded part of a larger task · Before release, a main agent can ask one sub-agent to review copy and another to check mobile layout, then combine their evidence. Each sub-agent needs a clear scope, permissions, and expected return. Know first AI Agent Context Engineering
zhDescription: 由主 Agent 调度、专注处理特定独立子任务的专项执行单元。 · 例如上线前，主 AI 可以让一个帮手检查页面文字，另一个检查手机布局，再汇总两边结果。它不会自动知道全部背景，任务范围、可用权限和需要交回什么，都要提前说明。 先知道 AI Agent 上下文工程 Context Engineering
quote: Can I split a big task among a few helpers at the same time, then get one combined result?
zhQuote: 大任务能不能拆给几个帮手同时干，最后汇总给我？

name: Tool Calling
title: Tool Calling
description: A model’s request for an application to run a named tool with parameters · A model can request a calendar lookup, but the application must validate the permissions and parameters before it reads the schedule. The returned result, not the request text, proves what happened. Know first Structured Output API
zhDescription: 工具调用是 AI 请求应用执行某项操作，再读取操作结果的方式。 · 例如 AI 可以请求查询日历，应用确认权限和查询条件后才实际读取日程，再把真实结果交给 AI。删除、发送等操作仍须确认对象和范围。 先知道 结构化输出 Structured Output API
quote: AI can talk, but how do I get it to actually check the database or make a request?
zhQuote: AI 光会说不会做，怎么让它真的去查数据库、发请求？

name: ReAct
title: ReAct
description: A task pattern where an agent decides, acts with a tool, observes the result, and decides again · When a login button does nothing, an agent can inspect the button first. If the click handler already exists, that observation changes the next action to inspecting the network request and its 401 response. Know first Tool Calling
zhDescription: ReAct 是让 AI 根据当前证据选择一个操作，读取真实结果，再据此选择下一步的任务方式。 · 例如登录按钮没有反应时，AI 先检查按钮文件；发现点击事件已经存在后，不再继续修改按钮，而是改查网络请求，并根据 401 结果检查认证信息。 先知道 工具调用 Tool Calling
quote: Can the AI check the result after each step before deciding what to do next?
zhQuote: AI 能不能每完成一步先检查结果，再决定下一步？

name: Agent Loop
title: Agent Loop
description: A runtime mechanism that repeatedly calls AI and tools, then uses check results to continue, pause, or stop · While fixing horizontal overflow in mobile navigation, the first failed check can start another round. A second identical failure or a change to shared styles pauses for confirmation. The task ends only after the build and 390px page check both pass. Know first ReAct Stateless Request
zhDescription: Agent 循环是应用反复调用 AI 和工具，并根据检查结果决定继续、暂停或结束的运行机制。 · 例如修复手机导航横向滚动时，第一次检查失败可以继续修改；同类问题连续两次失败，或需要改共享样式时暂停确认；构建和 390px 页面检查都通过后才结束。 先知道 ReAct 无状态请求 Stateless Request
quote: After a check fails, should the AI continue editing, stop to ask me, or end the task?
zhQuote: 检查失败以后，AI 应该继续修改、停下来问我，还是结束任务？

name: Provider
title: Provider
description: A platform or infrastructure entity that hosts, runs, and serves large language models through APIs. · A model vendor, cloud platform, aggregation gateway, or even a local model service may appear as a Provider in a tool. It receives requests and provides model access, often handling credentials, rate limits, or billing, but it does not necessarily train or directly run the underlying model. Check the Base URL, key issuer, and billing party to identify the actual path.
zhDescription: Provider 是你通过它访问 AI 模型的服务平台与基础设施实体。 · 模型厂商、云平台、聚合网关，甚至本地模型服务，都可能在工具里作为 Provider。它负责接收请求并提供模型访问，通常还处理凭证、限流或计费，但不一定训练或直接运行底层模型；要结合 Base URL、Key 签发方和账单方判断请求实际经过谁。
quote: What do Provider and Model mean in this configuration, and where will my request actually go?
zhQuote: 配置里的 Provider 和 Model 分别指什么？我的请求最后会发给谁？

name: Base URL
title: Base URL
description: An address prefix shared by a group of API requests, onto which specific endpoint paths are appended. · For example, one client may combine https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 with /chat/completions to form the full request URL. Whether /v1 belongs in the prefix and which path the client appends depend on both the service and the client. Check both sets of official documentation instead of applying one fixed pattern.
zhDescription: Base URL（基准地址）是一组 API 请求共同使用的地址前缀。 · 例如某个客户端把 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 与 /chat/completions 拼成完整请求地址。是否包含 /v1 、客户端会补哪一段路径，都取决于服务接口和客户端的拼接规则；配置时要同时核对两边的官方文档，不能套用一个固定写法。
quote: I've switched the model API endpoint to our team's self-hosted proxy. Where do I update the Base URL to make it work?
zhQuote: 我把大模型的 API 地址换成我们团队自己部署的中转服务了，现在需要改哪里的 Base URL 才能生效？

name: API Proxy
title: API Proxy
description: An intermediate service that receives and forwards requests and responses between a client and an upstream API. · For example, an AI tool can send a request to a relay, which forwards it to a model provider and returns the result along the same path. The relay may handle authentication, routing, or a shared gateway, but that does not mean the model runs there. Prompts, file fragments, and credentials may pass through it, so verify the operator, privacy policy, retention rules, and key issuer before use.
zhDescription: API 代理是位于客户端和上游 API 之间，代为接收和转发请求与响应的中间服务。 · 例如 AI 工具把请求发给中转站，再由它转给模型提供方；结果也沿同一路径返回。中转站可以负责鉴权、路由或统一入口，但不代表模型运行在那里。提示词、文件片段和凭证可能经过它，因此使用前要核对运营主体、隐私政策、数据留存和 Key 的签发方。
quote: Requests started working after I switched to a relay URL. Check who can see the prompts, files, and key along that path.
zhQuote: 我换成中转地址后请求能成功了，但提示词、文件和 Key 会经过谁？帮我把链路检查清楚。

name: OpenAI-Compatible API
title: OpenAI-Compatible API
description: A third-party model endpoint conforming to OpenAI request and response formats, allowing compatible clients to switch providers seamlessly. · For example, a tool that only sends OpenAI-shaped requests may connect to another model service after changing the Base URL, API key, and model name. The service may implement that shape directly or through a translation layer. Compatibility usually covers only some endpoints and fields, so tool calls, images, streaming, and other capabilities still need separate checks.
zhDescription: 与 OpenAI 接口的请求和响应格式相近，允许兼容客户端平滑切换底层模型服务的一类兼容接口。 · 例如一个只会发送 OpenAI 格式请求的工具，换掉 Base URL、API Key 和模型名后，可能连接到另一家模型服务。兼容可能由服务直接实现，也可能经过转换层；它通常只覆盖部分端点和字段，不代表工具调用、图片、流式输出等能力全部一致。
quote: My AI tool only has settings for OpenAI, but I want to use DeepSeek. Can I just swap the Base URL and API Key?
zhQuote: 我这个大模型工具只支持配置 OpenAI，但我想用 DeepSeek 的模型，是不是直接改一下 Base URL 和 API Key 就可以用？

name: API Key
title: API Key
description: An authentication credential used by applications to prove identity, verify permissions, and track resource usage with an API service. · For example, a web app can read an API key from an environment variable and send it with an AI request. The service usually associates permissions and usage with the key's account, project, or application—not necessarily a specific person. A leaked key may spend quota or expose data, so keep it out of source code, repositories, and chat logs, then revoke and replace it immediately if exposed. Know first API Env Var
zhDescription: 供应用程序向接口服务表明身份、验证调用权限并追踪资源用量的访问凭证。 · 例如给网页接上 AI 能力：程序从环境变量读取 API Key，并随请求交给服务验证。服务通常把权限和用量记到 Key 所属的账户、项目或应用，而不一定代表某个具体的人。Key 一旦泄露，别人可能消耗额度或访问数据；不要把它写进代码、仓库或聊天记录，发现泄露后立即吊销并更换。 先知道 API 环境变量 Env Var
quote: Connect the LLM API for me; read the API Key from environment variables, and never hardcode its value in the source code.
zhQuote: 帮我接上大模型 API，把 API Key 放在环境变量中读取，千万不要硬编码在代码里。

name: Configuration File
title: Configuration File
description: A structured file containing runtime settings and environment parameters for software to parse upon startup or runtime. · For example, an AI tool may read its model, endpoint, timeout, and permission settings from a config file, while project rules describe the stack and collaboration conventions for the current codebase. A config may reference secret variable names, but real secrets belong in environment variables or a secret manager and must not be tracked by git.
zhDescription: 配置文件是用文件保存的软件设置，供程序在启动或运行时读取。 · 例如 AI 工具可以从配置文件读取模型、连接地址、超时和权限设置，而项目规则文件负责说明当前项目的技术栈和协作要求。配置文件可能引用密钥变量，但真实密钥应放在环境变量或密钥管理服务中，并确认不会被 Git 跟踪。
quote: Help me update the default model in the AI tool's config file to DeepSeek, and increase the timeout limit to 60 seconds.
zhQuote: 帮我把 AI 工具的配置文件里默认的模型换成 DeepSeek，并且把超时限制设置成 60 秒。

name: Profile
title: Profile
description: A named and saved collection of configuration settings for switching between work, personal, or different provider environments. · For example, work and personal projects may use separate Providers, Base URLs, key variable names, or permission settings saved as work and personal profiles. Selecting a profile loads its configuration; it does not switch git branches, project files, or conversation history, and it does not replace checking the actual endpoint and credential source.
zhDescription: 命名保存的一组配置集合，用于在工作、个人或不同模型服务环境之间一键整体切换。 · 例如公司和个人项目使用不同的 Provider、Base URL、密钥变量名或权限设置，可以分别保存为 work 和 personal。选择 Profile 只加载对应配置，不会切换 Git 分支、项目文件或对话历史，也不能代替对实际请求地址和凭证来源的检查。
quote: Configure two profiles for me: 'work' using our company's private API, and 'personal' using my own API Key. Show me how to switch between them.
zhQuote: 帮我配置两个 Profile：一个叫 work 用我们公司的内网 API，一个叫 personal 用我自己的 API Key，并告诉我怎么切换它们。

name: Project Rules
title: Project Rules
description: Repository-level instruction files that inject team stack requirements, coding conventions, and operational boundaries into an AI agent. · For example, a team can record its stack, code style, validation steps, and operating boundaries in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or another file supported by the tool. Whether it is loaded, which directories it covers, and its precedence are product-specific. Rules reduce repetition but do not guarantee compliance or replace permissions and tests.
zhDescription: 保存在工程目录中的规范文件，用于向 AI 智能体注入团队技术栈、代码约定与操作边界约束。 · 例如团队可以在 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 或工具支持的其他规则文件中写明技术栈、代码风格、验证方式和操作边界。是否读取、作用于哪些目录以及规则优先级由具体工具决定；规则能减少重复说明，但不能保证每次都被遵守，也不能代替权限控制和测试。
quote: I keep reminding the AI to use TypeScript and our existing styles. Can these requirements live in project rules?
zhQuote: 每次都要提醒 AI 使用 TypeScript 和项目现有样式，有办法把这些要求放进项目规则吗？

name: Hook
title: Hook
description: An automated mechanism that intercepts execution upon specific lifecycle events to run predefined scripts or checks. · For example, Git can run a check before committing, and some AI tools provide an event after writing a file. The specific event names, parameters, and whether a failure blocks later steps depend on the product. Review the current tool documentation before configuration, and keep dangerous scripts bounded by permissions.
zhDescription: 在特定生命周期事件触发时，自动截获流程并执行预设脚本或检查的任务机制。 · 例如 Git 可以在提交前运行检查，某些 AI 工具也提供写入后触发点。具体事件名、参数以及失败是否会阻止后续流程，都由产品定义；配置前先查当前工具的文档，危险脚本仍要受权限和范围限制。
quote: Does this tool support a post-write Hook? If so, have it format only the files that just changed.
zhQuote: 这个工具支持写入后 Hook 吗？如果支持，让它只格式化刚改过的文件。

name: Plugin
title: Plugin
description: A distributable software package installed into a host application to provide extended capabilities, commands, or UI via standardized extension points. · For example, an editor plugin can add a sidebar, shortcuts, code completion, or diff previews. Other plugins may only add commands or service integrations. A plugin does not require a UI, and it is not the same as a Skill task method or a Hook event script.
zhDescription: 独立封装并安装到宿主应用中，按标准扩展点为其补充功能、命令或界面的可分发模块。 · 例如编辑器插件可以增加侧边栏、快捷键、代码补全或 Diff 预览；其他插件也可能只增加命令或外部服务连接。插件不一定带界面，也不等于 Skill 的任务方法或 Hook 的事件脚本。
quote: AI plugins, hooks, and Skills all look like extensions. Which one actually fits this need?
zhQuote: AI 插件、Hook 和 Skill 都像扩展，这个需求到底该用哪一种？

name: Model Context Protocol
title: Model Context Protocol
description: A connection protocol AI applications use to discover and call external tools, data, and prompts · When a user asks who owns issue #1024, the application discovers get_ticket from an MCP server and sends the lookup. The issue tracker checks read permission and returns Alex. MCP standardizes the connection; it does not replace the real system or its authorization. Know first AI Agent Tool Calling API
zhDescription: 规范 AI 模型与外部数据源及工具双向调用的标准化开放协议。 · 例如用户问“工单 #1024 谁负责”，应用通过 MCP 找到工单服务公开的 get_ticket 工具并发出查询，工单系统检查当前账号的只读权限后返回“小林”。MCP 统一连接方式，但不代替真实系统或授权。 先知道 AI Agent 工具调用 Tool Calling API
quote: Can the AI connect to our issue tracker and tell me who owns #1024?
zhQuote: 能不能让 AI 接上工单系统，帮我查 #1024 是谁负责的？

name: Skill
title: Skill
description: A specialized workflow and instruction package organized in a standard directory, with SKILL.md as the entry point for agents to execute on demand. · A Skill can include instructions, scripts, references, and templates. When a task matches it, an agent reads those materials and follows the documented method. Know first AI Agent System Prompt
zhDescription: 按约定目录结构组织的专业工作流与指令集包，以 SKILL.md 为统一入口供智能体按需调取执行。 · 文件夹里可以继续放说明、脚本、资料和模板。Agent 遇到对应任务时，会读取这些文件并按里面的做法完成工作。 先知道 AI Agent 系统提示词 System Prompt
quote: I have to teach the AI the same process every time. Can it remember how to do this task?
zhQuote: 同一个任务每次都要重新教一遍，能不能让它记住这套做法？

name: Permission Mode
title: Permission Mode
description: A set of control presets defining file system boundaries, network access limits, and user confirmation triggers for an AI agent. · For example, one Codex permission option can allow routine reads, writes, and local commands inside the current workspace, then ask before network access or crossing that boundary. Names and combinations differ across tools. Check the sandbox scope, when prompts appear, and who reviews them before choosing.
zhDescription: 规范 AI 智能体执行任务时，预设的一组访问范围和审批设置。 · 例如 Codex 的某个权限选项可以允许在当前工作区内读写和运行常规命令，越过工作区或访问网络时再询问。不同工具的名称和组合并不通用；选择前要分别看清沙箱范围、何时询问，以及谁负责批准。
quote: Routine changes inside this project can continue automatically, but ask before deletion, wider access, or external actions. Which permission setting fits?
zhQuote: 当前项目里的常规修改可以自动继续，删除、越界访问和外部操作还是先问我，应该选哪种权限？

name: Sandbox
title: Sandbox
description: An isolated execution environment restricting the files, network, and system resources accessible by untrusted code or automated tasks. · For example, an AI tool may let commands write only inside the current workspace and restrict network access, reducing the chance that a bad script affects unrelated files. A sandbox may use OS controls, containers, or virtual machines, and its strength depends on the actual boundary. Mounted sensitive folders, injected real keys, and allowed networks remain accessible to code inside it.
zhDescription: 限制不受信代码或自动化任务对宿主文件、网络与系统调用的物理或逻辑隔离运行环境。 · 例如 AI 工具可以让命令只在当前工作区内读写，并限制网络访问，从而减少错误脚本影响其他文件的机会。沙箱可以由操作系统机制、容器或虚拟机实现，隔离强度取决于实际边界；已挂载的敏感目录、注入的真实密钥和允许的网络仍可能被代码使用。
quote: Both sandboxing and command confirmation are meant to protect my computer. What does each one limit?
zhQuote: 沙箱和命令确认都说能保护电脑，它们分别限制什么？

name: Prompt Injection
title: Prompt Injection
description: A security problem where instructions in input steer a model away from its intended task or authorization boundaries · When an Agent summarizes an email, its body may include an instruction to forward an attachment. The model may be influenced by that content; labeling the email as material can help, but does not replace tool permissions and send approval outside the model. Know first Tool Calling
zhDescription: 输入中的非预期指令让模型偏离原本任务或授权范围的安全问题 · 让 Agent 总结一封邮件时，正文可能带有让它转发附件的指令。模型可能受这段内容影响；把邮件标成资料有帮助，但不能替代外部的工具权限和发送审批。 先知道 工具调用 Tool Calling
quote: I only asked AI to summarize an email. Why do I need to care what the email says?
zhQuote: 我只让 AI 总结邮件，为什么还要管邮件里写了什么？

name: TTFT / TPS
title: TTFT / TPS
description: Measures of time to first output and of token generation speed after output begins · TTFT measures time from sending a request to receiving the first token. TPS measures tokens produced each second afterward. A quick first token does not guarantee a short total response time. Know first Streaming Response Token
zhDescription: TTFT 和 TPS 分别表示 AI 出现第一段回答前的等待时间，以及之后每秒生成多少内容。 · TTFT 是从发送问题到看到第一个字的等待时间，TPS 是开始回答后每秒出现多少文字片段。第一段出现得快，不代表整段回答一定很快，回答长度也会影响总时长。 先知道 流式响应 Streaming Response Token
quote: Why do some AI tools take forever to show the first word while others answer right away?
zhQuote: 为什么有的 AI 半天才出第一个字，有的秒回？

name: Token Usage & Cost
title: Token Usage & Cost
description: The cumulative model tokens in a task and the price calculated from the model’s rate card · System rules, chat history, files, tool results, and model output all use tokens across a multi-turn task. Cost also depends on the model and separate input, output, and cached-token prices; external tools may have their own fees. Know first Token Context Window
zhDescription: AI 处理的文字片段会逐轮累加，费用还要按所用模型的价格计算。 · 系统规则、聊天记录、文件、工具结果和 AI 回答都会计入用量，多轮任务要把每一轮的输入和输出加总。费用还取决于模型，以及输入、输出和缓存内容的不同价格；外部工具也可能另收费。 先知道 Token 上下文窗口 Context Window
quote: My API bill blew up this month. What am I actually paying for?
zhQuote: 这个月 API 账单炸了，钱到底花在哪了？

name: Rate Limit
title: Rate Limit
description: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time · After a limit is reached, a request may wait, slow down, or return 429. The exact limits vary by service, model, and account, so distinguish request, token, and concurrency limits. Know first API
zhDescription: 速率限制是服务规定一段时间内最多能发多少次请求、处理多少内容或同时运行多少任务的上限。 · 达到限制后，请求可能排队、延迟或收到 429。具体上限会随服务、模型和账号而变化，处理时要分别看请求数、Token 数与并发任务数。 先知道 API
quote: I'm getting an error because I called the API too often. What does that limit mean?
zhQuote: 调用太频繁就报错，说什么超过限制，是怎么回事？

name: Git
title: Git
description: Keep a history of code changes so work can be compared and restored · Git records snapshots of a project and lets people compare changes, create independent branches, and combine work. Each developer has a full local history. GitHub and similar services host repositories and collaboration, but they are not Git itself. Know first Terminal
zhDescription: Git 是在本地记录文件版本历史、比较改动并协作同步的版本控制工具 · 例如，完成并检查首页导航后，可以用 提交 Commit 把相关改动保存成一个本地版本，以后查看或恢复；只有 推送 Push 后 GitHub 才有副本。未 Commit 的改动不会自动进入历史。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: AI broke my code. I want to get back to the last version that worked.
zhQuote: AI 把我的代码改崩了，我想回到上一个能用的版本。

name: Commit
title: Commit
description: Save one meaningful set of changes in the project history · A commit records selected changes with an author, time, and message. Before undoing work, distinguish uncommitted edits from commits that have already been pushed. Shared history is usually reversed with a new revert commit instead of rewriting old records. Know first Git
zhDescription: 给当前项目保存一个可以回看、带说明的版本 · 例如修好手机端按钮后，先把这部分改动选进“这次准备保存的清单”，再保存为一个注明“修复手机端按钮错位”的版本。撤销前要区分还没保存的改动和已经分享出去的版本；已经分享的版本通常另存一次反向修改，不直接改写旧记录。 先知道 Git
quote: Save the code changes I have now—I don't want things to get messy and lose this working version.
zhQuote: 帮我把现在改好的代码存一下，我怕等下越改越乱，回不去了。

name: Branch
title: Branch
description: Develop an independent line of work without changing the main line · A branch is a movable name pointing to a series of commits. It lets a feature, fix, or experiment proceed separately and later be merged. Create branches from the right starting point and keep their purpose small enough to review. Know first Commit
zhDescription: 从当前版本另开一条修改路线，让新功能先不混进主版本 · 例如从当前稳定版本另开一条路线，只在这里修改和测试导航，确认后再合回主版本。它和主版本共享已有历史，同时把新的尝试暂时分开；切换前要先收好还没保存的改动。 先知道 提交 Commit
quote: I need to try a different approach, but I don't want to break the version that works now.
zhQuote: 我想试试另一种做法，但又怕把现在这个能跑的版本搞坏。

name: Merge
title: Merge
description: Combine the commits from one branch into another · Merge brings two lines of history together. Git can combine independent changes automatically, but overlapping edits may create conflicts that a person must resolve. Review the result and run tests after resolving, because a clean text merge can still break behavior. Know first Branch Commit
zhDescription: 合并是把另一条修改路线上的已保存改动放进当前路线的操作。 · 例如功能完成后，可以把功能路线合回主版本。两边都改到同一处时，Git 会提示内容冲突，需要决定保留什么、清理提示标记并重新检查。 先知道 分支 Branch 提交 Commit
quote: The feature I built separately works. How do I bring it back into the main version?
zhQuote: 我在另一边试的功能成了，怎么把它并回正式版本？

name: Pull
title: Pull
description: Download remote changes and integrate them into the current branch · Git pull usually runs fetch and then merge or rebase. It updates the current branch with work from its configured remote branch. Check local changes and the active branch first so a convenient command does not create an unexpected integration. Know first Git Commit Merge
zhDescription: 拉取是把网上已经保存的新版本同步到当前项目的操作。 · 例如同事把改动上传到 GitHub 后，可以拉取到自己电脑上的同一个项目。开始前先保存或收好未完成改动；第一次把整个项目下载到电脑，应使用克隆。 先知道 Git 提交 Commit 合并 Merge
quote: My teammate says they're done with their changes. How do I get their version onto my computer?
zhQuote: 同事说他改完了，我怎么把他那版拿到我电脑上？

name: Push
title: Push
description: Upload local commits to a remote repository · Push sends commits and branch references to a remote such as GitHub. It shares committed history, not uncommitted files. The remote may reject the push if new work exists there or if branch rules require review. Know first Git Commit
zhDescription: 推送是把电脑上已保存的版本上传到共享代码网站的操作。 · 例如把完成的版本上传到 GitHub，供协作或触发后续发布。它不会上传还没保存的改动；被拒绝时先查看原因并处理网上已有的变化，不要直接强行覆盖。 先知道 Git 提交 Commit
quote: My local changes are ready. How do I send them to GitHub so everyone else can see them?
zhQuote: 我本地改好了，怎么传到 GitHub 上让别人也能看到？

name: Clone
title: Clone
description: Create a local copy of a remote repository and its history · Clone downloads a repository, creates a working directory, and configures the original location as a remote. It is normally the first step when joining an existing project. Check the destination path and repository source before running it. Know first Terminal Git
zhDescription: 克隆是第一次把共享代码网站上的项目和版本记录完整下载到电脑的操作。 · 它会新建项目文件夹，并下载代码和以前保存的版本。例如进入文件夹后先阅读项目说明，再安装需要的工具；之后同步新版本使用拉取。 先知道 终端命令行 Terminal Git
quote: Here's a project URL. How do I download the whole codebase to my computer so I can edit it?
zhQuote: 给我一个项目网址，我想把整套代码下载到自己电脑上改。

name: Pull Request
title: Pull Request
description: Ask others to review and merge the work from one branch · A pull request is a collaboration feature on Git hosting platforms, not a core Git command. It collects the change summary, discussion, automated checks, and review before a branch is merged. Keep its scope focused and explain how the result was verified. Know first Branch Push Diff
zhDescription: 合并请求是在 GitHub 或 GitLab 上查看改动、讨论并决定是否合并的页面。 · 例如把新导航的改动上传后，可以创建一个合并请求；其他人能逐行查看变化、留言并确认自动检查结果，再决定是否合进主版本。它不是终端命令，也不表示改动已经进入主版本。 先知道 分支 Branch 推送 Push 差异对比 Diff
quote: My changes are done. Have someone review them before they go into the main version.
zhQuote: 我改完了，想请人看一眼没问题，再合进正式版本。

name: Worktree
title: Worktree
description: Check out another branch in a second working directory · A Git worktree lets one repository have several working directories at the same time. It is useful when a long task must stay open while another branch needs attention. Each worktree has its own checked-out files, but they share the repository history. Know first Branch Terminal
zhDescription: 让同一个 Git 仓库同时出现在多个文件夹里，每个文件夹处理一条分支 · 例如，原文件夹继续做首页，另一个文件夹单独处理线上修复，两边可以同时打开和运行。移除额外文件夹前，先保存其中的改动并停止正在运行的服务；不要直接删除文件夹，应使用 Git 的 worktree 命令移除。 先知道 分支 Branch 终端命令行 Terminal
quote: I'm halfway through a feature and an urgent bug just came up. I don't want to clean up my current work first.
zhQuote: 功能改到一半突然要修紧急 bug，我又不想收拾现在这个现场。

name: Stash
title: Stash
description: Temporarily set aside uncommitted changes · Stash stores selected working changes and restores a cleaner directory so another task can proceed. It is useful for short interruptions, not as a long-term archive. Name important stashes and inspect conflicts when applying them later. Know first Git Branch
zhDescription: 把当前没做完的改动临时收起来，让工作区先恢复干净 · 例如，首页改到一半却要切去修 Bug，可以先 Stash，处理完再恢复。刚新建且从未加入 Git 的文件默认不会被收起，操作前要看 git status；Stash 只适合短期中转，正式成果仍要 提交 Commit 。 先知道 Git 分支 Branch
quote: I'm in the middle of changes but need to switch to something else. Can I put this work aside for now?
zhQuote: 改到一半要切去干别的，先把现在这些东西临时收起来。

name: .gitignore
title: .gitignore
description: Tell Git which untracked files should stay out of version control · .gitignore patterns keep generated files, dependencies, local settings, and secrets from being added by accident. It does not remove files that are already tracked, and it should not replace secure secret management. Know first Git Env Var
zhDescription: 告诉 Git 哪些本地文件不要加入版本记录的规则清单 · 例如可重新下载的工具文件和本机保存的密钥文件，通常会写进忽略规则。它只对还没被版本记录保存的文件生效；已经保存过的文件不会因此消失，已经泄露的密钥也必须立即更换。 先知道 Git 环境变量 Env Var
quote: There are files I don't want Git to track, like secret keys and dependency packages. How do I exclude them?
zhQuote: 有些文件我不想让 Git 管，比如密钥和依赖包，怎么排除掉？

name: Diff
title: Diff
description: See exactly what changed between two states · A diff shows added, removed, and modified lines between the working tree, staged changes, commits, or branches. Read it before committing and reviewing so accidental edits, secrets, and unrelated changes are caught early. Know first Git Commit
zhDescription: 把改动前后的内容逐行摆在一起，标出删了什么、加了什么 · 例如 AI 修改首页后，对比视图会用 - 标出删除的旧内容，用 + 标出新增内容。保存版本前要检查还没选入清单和已经选入清单的两部分变化，避免把误删、调试内容或密钥一起保存。 先知道 Git 提交 Commit
quote: Show me exactly what changed this time—what lines were added and what lines were removed.
zhQuote: 帮我看看这次到底改了哪几行，加了什么、删了什么。

name: Merge Conflict
title: Merge Conflict
description: When the same content was changed differently on two branches, Git cannot choose and a person must decide what to keep · When Git cannot automatically reconcile changes while merging main and feature/new-nav—for example, both changed the same heading in index.html—it pauses and writes both versions with conflict markers. Review the surrounding page and understand each branch's intent, then choose or reconcile the heading while retaining the other branch's needed navigation. Remove the markers, finish the merge, and reopen the page to verify the result. Markers do not say which side is correct. Know first Merge
zhDescription: 两边改动无法自动合并时，Git 会暂停并标出需要人判断的内容 · 合并 main 和 feature/new-nav 时，如果双方把 index.html 的同一处标题改成了不同文字，Git 会在文件里留下两版内容和冲突标记，暂停完成合并。先结合页面上下文理解两边改动，再保留合适的标题，同时留下对方新增且仍需要的导航；删除标记并完成合并后，重新打开页面确认结果。冲突标记本身不会告诉你哪一边正确。 先知道 合并 Merge
quote: After pulling, Git stopped with a conflict. Which file do I open, and which section do I change?
zhQuote: 拉取新版本后 Git 停下来说有冲突，我该打开哪个文件、改哪一段？

name: Remote Repository
title: Remote Repository
description: A repository accessible elsewhere that exchanges commits with a local repository · You commit B locally, while remote main (origin) on GitHub still points to A; B exists only on your computer until push sends it to the remote. A teammate can then build commit C on the remote history. If the remote has commits missing locally, a direct push is rejected. Pull fetches first, then integrates remote commits using the configured merge or rebase behavior. origin is a common remote name; pushing to a repository does not mean a website has been deployed. Know first Push
zhDescription: 位于另一处、可通过网络访问并与本地仓库交换提交的仓库 · 你在本地提交了 B，GitHub 上的远程 main（origin）仍指向 A；提交只在本地，直到 push 把它发送到远程。之后同事可以基于远程历史提交 C；如果远程比本地多了提交，直接 push 会被拒绝。pull 会先 fetch，再按当前配置用 merge 或 rebase 集成远程提交。origin 只是常见的远程名称；推送到仓库不等于网页已经部署。 先知道 推送 Push
quote: My commits only exist on my computer. How can others see them?
zhQuote: 我的提交只在自己电脑上，怎么让别人也能看到？

name: Reset & Revert
title: Reset & Revert
description: Reset moves the current branch and handles changes by mode; revert adds a commit that offsets an earlier change · Suppose B adjusts navigation and C accidentally adds a debug entry. If C is only local, reset can move the branch pointer; --soft keeps changes staged, the default --mixed resets the index but leaves working-tree files, and --hard also replaces tracked working-tree files. If C is on a shared branch and teammates may have based work on it, revert usually appends a commit that offsets C while preserving later history. If later edits overlap with C, revert may also require conflict resolution. Know first Commit Push
zhDescription: reset 移动当前分支指针并按模式处理改动；revert 追加一条抵消旧改动的新提交 · 例如 main 上的 B 是正常改动，C 误加了调试入口：若 C 还只在本地，可用 reset 移动分支指针；--soft 保留暂存内容，默认的 --mixed 重置暂存区但保留工作区文件，--hard 会一并覆盖已跟踪文件的工作区改动。若 C 已推到共享分支、同事可能已经基于它工作，通常用 revert 追加一条抵消 C 的提交，保留原提交与后续历史；若后续改动和 C 重叠，revert 也可能需要解决冲突。 先知道 提交 Commit 推送 Push
quote: A shared commit added a debug entry. How can I undo that and keep later work?
zhQuote: 误加调试代码的提交已经和同事共享了，我想撤掉它、保留后来的改动，怎么做？

name: Minimalism
title: Minimalism
description: Remove what does not help the task and make the remaining hierarchy clear · Modern minimalism uses restrained color, type, spacing, and decoration so the content and actions are easy to find.
