It is not simply an empty white page. Every remaining element needs a clear role, and the layout still needs contrast, rhythm, and feedback.
zhDescription: 现代简约是一种减少非必要装饰、突出内容和操作的视觉风格 · 它通常用留白、清楚的字号层级、少量颜色和一致组件来组织页面。圆角、阴影和间距没有固定配方，仍要根据品牌、内容密度和使用场景决定。
quote: Keep it clean and uncluttered, with the content and buttons doing the talking.
zhQuote: 干干净净的，不要花里胡哨，重点突出内容和按钮。

name: Apple HIG
title: Apple HIG
description: Use precise hierarchy, generous space, and polished product imagery · Apple-style web design combines large, controlled type, focused storytelling, high-quality product visuals, and restrained motion. The useful lesson is the clarity of the presentation, not copying Apple's fonts, hardware shapes, glass effects, or page transitions.
zhDescription: 苹果风是一种借鉴 Apple 产品界面和官网表达方式的设计风格 · 常见做法包括充足留白、清楚的单屏重点、连续圆角和克制的半透明材质。想做出这种风格，素材质量、文字对比度和内容节奏比照抄圆角或模糊数值更重要。
quote: I want that polished Apple website feel: big images, big type, and lots of white space.
zhQuote: 就想要苹果官网那种高级感：大图、大字、大量留白。

name: Notion Style
title: Notion Style
description: Use document-like structure, quiet surfaces, and practical controls · Notion-style interfaces feel close to an editable document: clear text hierarchy, compact icons, neutral colors, and blocks that can be arranged. It works well for knowledge and productivity tools, but copying the appearance without the underlying content model produces a plain page with weak interaction.
zhDescription: Notion 风是一种以文档阅读和编辑为中心的轻量界面风格 · 它常用浅色画布、简洁图标、细分割线和按需出现的次要操作，适合笔记、知识库和协作工具。隐藏操作不能只在鼠标悬停时出现，还要让键盘和触屏用户找得到。
quote: Make it feel like Notion—clean, text-first, and inviting to write in.
zhQuote: 像 Notion 那样，清爽、以文字为主，看着就想写字。

name: Bento Grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Arrange different kinds of content in a clear modular grid · A bento grid places feature cards of different sizes into one structured composition. Larger cells signal priority while smaller cells add supporting facts, media, or actions. The grid needs a reading order and responsive plan; varied card sizes alone do not create useful hierarchy.
zhDescription: Bento 便当格是一种用大小不同的卡片组织并列信息的网格布局 · 它常把重要功能放进大卡片，把补充数据或次要信息放进小卡片，适合产品总览和仪表盘。列数、圆角和卡片数量没有固定答案，手机上通常需要重新排序并减少列数。
quote: Use one of those trendy feature sections made of differently sized tiles.
zhQuote: 那种大小不一的格子拼在一起的功能介绍区，现在很流行的。

name: Glassmorphism
title: Glassmorphism
description: Use translucent, blurred surfaces to separate layered content · Glassmorphism combines transparent color, backdrop blur, light borders, and layered backgrounds. It can make floating controls feel connected to the scene behind them. Readability depends on the background, so important text needs a stable surface and sufficient contrast.
zhDescription: 玻璃拟态是一种用半透明和背景模糊表现前后层次的视觉风格 · 它常在导航、浮层和展示页面中配合边界高光与柔和阴影使用。文字对比度要先于材质效果，并为低性能或不支持滤镜的设备准备实色背景。
quote: Use translucent frosted-glass panels where you can faintly see the background through them.
zhQuote: 半透明的磨砂玻璃块，后面隐约透出背景那种。

name: Neo-Brutalism
title: Neo-Brutalism
description: Use direct structure, strong contrast, and deliberately exposed construction · Neo-brutalist web design uses heavy outlines, bold type, simple shapes, hard shadows, and obvious interaction. It can feel energetic and candid when the hierarchy remains disciplined. Random misalignment and aggressive color do not become a design system just because they look unconventional.
zhDescription: 新粗野是一种用粗描边、硬阴影和高对比色建立强烈识别的视觉风格 · 它常见于活动页、数字商品和独立产品，也会配合大号粗体与按压位移。视觉冲击不能盖过核心任务，描边、阴影和字重也要随组件尺寸调整。
quote: Go bold and expressive with thick black borders, bright color blocks, and hard shadows.
zhQuote: 粗黑边框、大色块、硬阴影，特别张扬有个性的那种。

name: Swiss Style
title: Swiss Style
description: Build clarity through grid, typography, and objective visual order · Swiss Style uses a strong grid, sans-serif type, asymmetric composition, and disciplined spacing to make information easy to scan. Its clean appearance comes from exact relationships, not from centering everything or removing all personality.
zhDescription: 瑞士排版是一种用严格网格、无衬线字体和清楚对齐组织信息的设计风格 · 它适合作品集、展览、年报和海报式页面，重点是让信息层级客观有序。左对齐与黑白红只是经典例子；开始设计前仍要先整理内容优先级。
quote: Use a strict grid, big type, and precise alignment so it feels clean like a poster.
zhQuote: 规整的网格、大字、严格对齐，像海报一样干净利落。

name: Editorial
title: Editorial
description: Use publication-style typography, imagery, and pacing to tell a story · Editorial web design borrows from magazines through expressive headlines, considered image crops, captions, columns, and varied pacing. It works when the content deserves sustained reading. The layout should adapt without turning mobile into a squeezed print spread.
zhDescription: 杂志编辑风是一种借用纸媒排版方法组织网页内容的视觉风格 · 它常用衬线标题、分栏、图注和明显的字号对比，适合品牌故事、长文和年报。这些元素不必全部出现，行宽、行距和栏数要分别按语言与屏幕测试。
quote: Lay it out like a fashion magazine, with images and text woven together.
zhQuote: 像时尚杂志那样的排版，图文穿插，有编辑感。

name: Skeuomorphism
title: Skeuomorphism
description: Use familiar real-world form and material to explain a digital control · Skeuomorphism makes digital objects resemble physical ones through shape, texture, light, and behavior. It can make an unfamiliar interaction easier to understand or give a focused experience character. Literal leather, wood, and metal on every surface quickly add noise and age poorly.
zhDescription: 拟物化是一种模仿现实物体外观和操作线索的界面设计风格 · 它会借用皮革、金属、纸张、旋钮和实体按钮等熟悉线索帮助用户理解操作。现在多用于复古主题、乐器类应用和局部装饰，材质细节不能压过文字和功能。
quote: Give it that early iPhone look, where buttons look like real buttons and notes look like actual notebooks.
zhQuote: 早期 iPhone 那种，按钮像真按钮、笔记本像真本子。

name: Flat Design
title: Flat Design
description: Use simple shapes, clear color, and minimal surface decoration · Flat design removes realistic texture and depth in favor of icons, type, color blocks, and direct layout. It scales well and keeps visual noise low, but interactive elements still need recognizable shapes, contrast, and states. Pure flatness that hides what is clickable is not useful simplicity.
zhDescription: 扁平化是一种减少立体材质、用纯色和简化图形组织界面的设计风格 · 它适合响应式产品和工具页面，通常依靠排版、色块和清楚分区建立层级。阴影和纹理减少以后，可点击状态更需要通过文字、边界和交互反馈表达。
quote: No depth or shadows—just solid colors and simple shapes.
zhQuote: 不要立体不要阴影，纯色块加简单图形，平平的那种。

name: Material Design
title: Material Design
description: Use a systematic component language with clear layers and motion · Material Design is Google's design system for components, layout, color, type, elevation, and motion. Its value is the shared behavior and accessibility guidance, not making every product look like a Google app. Customize it through a consistent theme while keeping states and structure clear.
zhDescription: Material Design 是 Google 推出的一套跨设备界面设计系统 · 它用颜色、组件、表面层级和动效统一 Android 与其他平台上的界面体验。实际项目应参考当前版本和所用平台的组件，不必照搬早期纸张隐喻或固定配色。
quote: Give it an Android-style look with layered cards and a ripple when people tap.
zhQuote: 安卓手机那种风格，卡片有层次、按下去有涟漪。

name: Neumorphism
title: Neumorphism
description: Use paired soft shadows to make controls appear pressed from one surface · Neumorphism, or Soft UI, uses highlights and shadows on nearly identical foreground and background colors. It can create a distinctive decorative object, but the low contrast often makes buttons, states, and boundaries difficult to perceive. Use it sparingly and test accessibility in real conditions.
zhDescription: 新拟态是一种用同色背景和明暗双阴影表现凸凹质感的视觉风格 · 它会让按钮和卡片看起来像从背景中凸出或凹下，但边界和可点击状态容易不清楚。它更适合展示页面或局部装饰，关键操作要先保证对比度和识别性。
quote: Make the buttons look like they're softly raised out of the background in the same color palette.
zhQuote: 按钮像从背景里凸出来，同色系、软软的那种质感。

name: SaaS Marketing Site
title: SaaS Marketing Site
description: Place the value, product proof, and next action on one clear reading path · A SaaS marketing site is a common website pattern, not a formal visual movement. It organizes a conversion path around the problem the product solves: a focused hero states the promise, real product views and customer evidence build trust, and a consistent call to action moves the visitor toward a trial or conversation. The visual style can vary, but decoration cannot replace product proof or a clear next step.
zhDescription: SaaS 产品官网是一种面向软件订阅产品的营销网站类型 · 它通常先说明产品为谁解决什么问题，再用真实界面、客户案例和数据建立信任，最后引导访客试用或咨询。页面可以采用不同视觉风格，但产品证据和行动路径不能被装饰取代。
quote: Make it look like a software company website: a big hero headline, product screenshots, customer logos, and pricing.
zhQuote: 就是那种软件官网：首屏大标题、功能截图、客户 logo、定价表。

name: B2B Corporate Site
title: B2B Corporate Site
description: Build confidence through stable structure, concrete evidence, and real business context · A B2B corporate site is a website type for organizational buying, not a fixed visual style. It often supports a longer decision involving several people, so clear navigation, industry context, customer stories, compliance, and service information must work together to establish trust. The visual language can feel powerful, but every ambitious claim needs evidence from data, a case, or a real product capability.
zhDescription: B2B 企业官网是一种面向组织采购决策的网站类型 · 企业客户往往需要多人评估产品、合规、实施和服务，因此页面要提供清楚导航、行业场景、客户案例与信任信息。视觉表达可以有力量，但每项主张都要有数据、案例或产品能力支撑。
quote: This site is for business customers, so it needs to feel professional, steady, and trustworthy.
zhQuote: 给公司客户看的网站，要专业、稳重、值得信任。

name: DTC E-commerce
title: DTC E-commerce
description: Let product, brand feeling, and buying information work together toward a decision · DTC, or direct-to-consumer, describes a business model rather than a visual style. This example shows a common branded e-commerce pattern: the product leads visually while price, options, reviews, delivery, and the purchase action remain easy to understand. Lifestyle imagery and editorial typography can create desire, but the page cannot behave like a lookbook alone.
zhDescription: DTC 品牌电商是一种由品牌直接面向消费者销售商品的网站类型 · 页面通常把商品作为视觉中心，同时说明价格、规格、评价、配送和退换信息，并提供稳定的购买路径。生活方式摄影可以建立品牌感受，但不能让网站只像画册而无法完成购买。
quote: This is a brand's store, so it should have personality, tell a story, and make people want to buy.
zhQuote: 品牌自己卖货的网站，要有调性、有故事、能让人下单。

name: Dark UI
title: Dark UI
description: Build clear hierarchy with a dark color scheme instead of simply turning the page black · Dark UI is an interface color scheme built primarily from dark backgrounds and light foregrounds; it is not synonymous with technology design or cyberpunk. It is common in media, creative tools, developer products, and interfaces that support sustained focus. Layered grays, sufficient text contrast, and limited signal colors matter most, while content, status, and controls remain the visual subject.
zhDescription: 深色界面是一种以深色背景和浅色前景为主的界面配色方案 · 它常见于影音、创作工具和开发者产品，但不等于科技风或赛博朋克。设计时要用分层灰度区分表面，保证文字对比度，并把高亮色留给真正重要的状态和操作。
quote: Give it a high-tech look with a black background, like a code editor.
zhQuote: 黑色背景那种科技感，像代码编辑器那样。

name: Playful Illustration
title: Playful Illustration
description: Use distinctive character, shape, and feedback to make a product feel friendly and alive · Playful illustration is a visual direction that builds brand character through illustrated people, scenes, and exaggerated forms; it is more specific than using bright color or large rounded corners. It often pairs with expressive but clear typography and light motion, working well for learning, creative, and young consumer products. Illustration cannot excuse weak information or unclear interaction states.
zhDescription: 趣味插画是一种用角色、场景和夸张图形建立品牌个性的视觉方向 · 它常与鲜明配色、圆润形状和轻量动效搭配，适合教育、创作和年轻消费产品。插画负责表达语气，不能遮挡正文、表单和主要操作。
quote: Make it more playful with fun illustrations and characters. Don't make it too serious.
zhQuote: 活泼一点，配上有趣的插画和角色，别太严肃。

name: Organic Design
title: Organic Design
description: Create warmth through natural material, real people, and a gentler pace · Organic design uses flowing curves, irregular shapes, material texture, and earth colors drawn from nature, contrasting with strictly geometric form. It often appears in food, wellness, home, and sustainability-oriented brands, but organic describes a formal visual language and does not automatically mean environmentally responsible. Product origin, service promises, and the next action still need specific expression.
zhDescription: 有机设计是一种借用自然形状、材料纹理和大地色的视觉风格 · 它常见于食品、健康、家居和可持续品牌，并用流动曲线与不规则轮廓弱化机械感。“有机”只描述形式语言，不自动代表环保，产品来源和服务承诺仍要具体说明。
quote: Give it a more natural feel with earth tones, rounded shapes, and a handmade touch.
zhQuote: 自然一点的感觉：大地色、圆润的形状、像手作的。

name: Y2K
title: Y2K
description: Use glossy digital optimism, bright plastic color, and early-2000s references · Y2K design draws from the late 1990s and early 2000s: translucent plastic, chrome, bubbles, bright pink and blue, compact gadgets, and optimistic ideas of the digital future. Use specific references and a controlled palette so the result feels intentional rather than a pile of retro effects.
zhDescription: Y2K 是一种重新演绎千禧年前后数字文化的复古视觉风格 · 它常用金属银、半透明塑料、糖果色和圆润轮廓，适合音乐、时尚和主题活动页面。这些元素用来表达年代感，不是一套必须照抄的颜色与圆角公式。
quote: Give it a Y2K retro-future feel with metallics, bubblegum colors, and translucent plastic.
zhQuote: 千禧年那种复古未来感：金属色、泡泡糖色、半透明塑料。

name: Memphis
title: Memphis
description: Use bold geometry, pattern, and asymmetry for an energetic composition · Memphis design uses geometric shapes, dots, squiggles, contrasting color, and playful imbalance. On the web it works best as a controlled visual language around clear content. Filling every gap with shapes makes the page harder to read and weakens the style's rhythm.
zhDescription: 孟菲斯是一种用鲜明配色、几何图案和不对称构图表达活力的设计风格 · 它常用波点、三角和波浪线打破严肃秩序，适合活动、教育和创意品牌。装饰可以活跃画面，但正文、表单和主要操作仍要保持稳定清楚。
quote: Use colorful geometric shapes, squiggles, and dots for an '80s feel.
zhQuote: 那种五颜六色的几何图形、波浪线、波点，很 80 年代。

name: Terminal Aesthetic
title: Terminal Aesthetic
description: Borrow command-line language to feel direct, technical, and tool-like · A terminal aesthetic uses monospaced type, prompts, command output, and a restrained palette. It suits developer tools and API documentation when the commands are real, searchable, and copyable. The whole page does not need to become green text on black.
zhDescription: 终端极客风是一种借用命令行界面元素的网页视觉风格 · 它常用等宽字体、提示符、命令输出、ASCII 分隔线和有限色彩，适合开发者工具与 API 文档。命令应保留为可复制的真实文字，整页也不必全部做成黑底绿字。
quote: Make it feel like a hacker terminal: black background, green text, monospace type, and command-line vibes.
zhQuote: 像黑客终端那样：黑底绿字、等宽字体、敲命令的感觉。

name: Wabi-sabi
title: Wabi-sabi
description: Use natural material, space, and asymmetry to create a quiet pace · Wabi-sabi-inspired web design draws from natural color, material texture, negative space, and hand-made variation to acknowledge time and imperfection. It is not one brand's style or a fixed beige-and-serif template. Real content, photography, and material should guide the choices.
zhDescription: 侘寂风是一种用自然材料、留白和不对称表达时间与不完美的视觉风格 · 它常见于家居、器物、旅宿和慢阅读页面，会使用低刺激色彩、材料肌理与手工细节放慢节奏。它不等同于某个品牌，也不是米白配宋体的固定模板。
quote: Make it a little more understated and weathered, with lots of open space and a quiet sense of age.
zhQuote: 素一点、旧一点、留白多一点，有种安静的时间感。

name: Bauhaus
title: Bauhaus
description: Organize the page with basic geometry, honest materials, and function · Exhibition and brand pages often let circles, squares, and triangles carry division, direction, and emphasis directly, with color only marking those functional relationships. If a page just spreads red, yellow, and blue blocks while the content organization stays unchanged, it borrowed the palette, not the Bauhaus.
zhDescription: 包豪斯是一种用基础几何形、材料特性和功能需求组织画面的现代主义设计流派 · 展览官网和品牌页常用圆、方、三角直接承担分区、指示和强调，颜色只标记这些功能关系。如果页面只是铺了红黄蓝色块、内容组织没有任何变化，那借用了配色，不是包豪斯。
quote: I want a geometric page—circles, squares, triangles—and every shape has to do a job, not just some color blocks.
zhQuote: 想要几何感的页面，圆的方的三角的，每个形状都得有用处，别只贴几个色块。

name: Art Deco
title: Art Deco
description: Express modern luxury through symmetry, stepped contours, and radiating motifs · Hotel, jewelry, and event pages often organize the page around a mirrored central axis, ziggurat-like stepped shapes, and sunburst rays, with metallic color as only the final sheen. A page that merely turns its headings and buttons gold while the skeleton stays ordinary is not Art Deco.
zhDescription: 装饰艺术是一种用几何对称、阶梯轮廓和放射纹样表现现代奢华的设计流派 · 酒店、珠宝和活动页常用中轴对称的骨架、层层收分的阶梯形和太阳光芒式的放射线组织画面，金属色只是最后的光泽。只把标题和按钮改成金色、骨架仍然普通的页面，并不是装饰艺术。
quote: I want a vintage-luxury page—symmetrical composition with geometric motifs, like an old theater poster, not just gold text.
zhQuote: 想要复古奢华点的页面，对称构图加几何纹样，像老剧院海报那种，不是光把字改成金色。
